local function Build_Default_Manifest(language_id, manager_id, project_name, options)
	local manifest = {
		directories = {},
		files = {},
		entry = Get_Language_File(language_id),
	}

	-- Use the central layout system for shared defaults,
	-- language commands, credits, and selected layouts.
	local built = Layouts.Build_Manifest(language_id, "", project_name)

	if type(built) == "table" then
		manifest = built
		manifest.directories = manifest.directories or {}
		manifest.files = manifest.files or {}
	end

	-- Keep all paths relative to the new project root.
	local entry = manifest.entry or Get_Language_File(language_id)

	if not manifest.files[entry] then
		manifest.files[entry] = Get_Source_Template(language_id)
	end

	if options.create_readme and not manifest.files["README.md"] then
		manifest.files["README.md"] = Build_Readme(project_name, language_id, manager_id)
	end

	if options.create_gitignore and not manifest.files[".gitignore"] then
		manifest.files[".gitignore"] = [[build/
dist/
out/
*.o
*.obj
*.exe
*.class
__pycache__/
.venv/
venv/
node_modules/
target/
]]
	end

	if options.create_default_directories then
		local defaults = { "src", "tests", "docs" }

		for _, directory in ipairs(defaults) do
			if not vim.tbl_contains(manifest.directories, directory) then
				manifest.directories[#manifest.directories + 1] = directory
			end
		end
	end

	local manager_files = Get_Manager_Files(language_id, manager_id)

	for path, content in pairs(manager_files) do
		if not manifest.files[path] then
			manifest.files[path] = content
		end
	end

	return manifest
end

local function Build_Layout_Manifest(language_id, layout_id, project_name, manager_id, options)
	if not layout_id or layout_id == "" then
		return Build_Default_Manifest(language_id, manager_id, project_name, options)
	end

	local manifest = Layouts.Build_Manifest(language_id, layout_id, project_name)

	if type(manifest) ~= "table" then
		return nil, "Could not build layout manifest."
	end

	manifest.directories = manifest.directories or {}
	manifest.files = manifest.files or {}

	-- The layout may already contain its own manager files.
	-- Add missing files for the selected manager without replacing them.
	local manager_files = Get_Manager_Files(language_id, manager_id)

	for path, content in pairs(manager_files) do
		if not manifest.files[path] then
			manifest.files[path] = content
		end
	end

	if options.create_readme and not manifest.files["README.md"] then
		manifest.files["README.md"] = Build_Readme(project_name, language_id, manager_id)
	end

	if options.create_gitignore and not manifest.files[".gitignore"] then
		manifest.files[".gitignore"] = [[build/
dist/
out/
*.o
*.obj
*.exe
*.class
__pycache__/
.venv/
venv/
node_modules/
target/
]]
	end

	return manifest
end

-- =========================================================
-- PROGRESS AND MANIFEST WRITING
-- =========================================================

local function Add_Manifest_Task(tasks, root, relative_path, kind, content)
	if not Is_Safe_Relative_Path(relative_path) then
		return false, "Unsafe project path: " .. tostring(relative_path)
	end

	tasks[#tasks + 1] = {
		type = kind,
		relative_path = relative_path,
		full_path = Join_Path(root, relative_path),
		content = content,
	}

	return true
end

local function Create_From_Manifest(root, manifest, options)
	local tasks = {}
	local directories = {}
	local directory_seen = {}

	local function Add_Directory(relative_path)
		if not Is_Safe_Relative_Path(relative_path) then
			return false, "Unsafe directory path: " .. tostring(relative_path)
		end

		if not directory_seen[relative_path] then
			directory_seen[relative_path] = true
			directories[#directories + 1] = relative_path
		end

		return true
	end

	for _, directory in ipairs(manifest.directories or {}) do
		local ok, err = Add_Directory(directory)

		if not ok then
			return false, err
		end
	end

	for relative_path in pairs(manifest.files or {}) do
		if not Is_Safe_Relative_Path(relative_path) then
			return false, "Unsafe file path: " .. tostring(relative_path)
		end

		local parent = vim.fn.fnamemodify(relative_path, ":h")

		if parent ~= "." then
			local current = ""

			for part in parent:gmatch("[^/]+") do
				current = current == "" and part or (current .. "/" .. part)

				local ok, err = Add_Directory(current)

				if not ok then
					return false, err
				end
			end
		end
	end

	table.sort(directories, function(a, b)
		local a_depth = select(2, a:gsub("/", ""))
		local b_depth = select(2, b:gsub("/", ""))

		if a_depth ~= b_depth then
			return a_depth < b_depth
		end

		return a < b
	end)

	-- Directories are counted as work too.
	for _, directory in ipairs(directories) do
		tasks[#tasks + 1] = {
			type = "directory",
			relative_path = directory,
			full_path = Join_Path(root, directory),
		}
	end

	local file_paths = {}

	for relative_path in pairs(manifest.files or {}) do
		file_paths[#file_paths + 1] = relative_path
	end

	table.sort(file_paths)

	for _, relative_path in ipairs(file_paths) do
		local ok, err = Add_Manifest_Task(tasks, root, relative_path, "file", manifest.files[relative_path])

		if not ok then
			return false, err
		end
	end

	local total = #tasks
	local completed = 0

	if options.show_progress then
		Progress.Start("Creating project", total)
		Progress.Log("Project: " .. root)
	end

	local function Update_Progress(task)
		completed = completed + 1

		if options.show_progress then
			Progress.Update(task.type .. ": " .. task.relative_path, completed, total)
		end
	end

	-- Preflight before writing: do not overwrite existing files.
	for _, task in ipairs(tasks) do
		if task.type == "file" and uv.fs_stat(task.full_path) then
			if options.show_progress then
				Progress.Finish(false, "File already exists.")
				Progress.Log(task.full_path)
			end

			return false, "Refusing to overwrite existing file: " .. task.full_path
		end
	end

	local ok, err = Ensure_Directory(root)

	if not ok then
		if options.show_progress then
			Progress.Finish(false, err)
		end

		return false, err
	end

	for _, task in ipairs(tasks) do
		local task_ok, task_err

		if task.type == "directory" then
			task_ok, task_err = Ensure_Directory(task.full_path)
		else
			task_ok, task_err = Write_New_File(task.full_path, task.content or "")
		end

		if not task_ok then
			if options.show_progress then
				Progress.Log("ERROR: " .. task.relative_path)
				Progress.Log(tostring(task_err))
				Progress.Finish(false, "Project creation failed.")
			end

			return false, task_err
		end

		Update_Progress(task)
	end

	if options.show_progress then
		Progress.Finish(true, "Project created successfully.")
	end

	return true
end

-- =========================================================
-- MANAGER VALIDATION
-- =========================================================

local function Get_Manager_Name(language_id, manager_id)
	local manager = Managers.Get(language_id, manager_id)

	if type(manager) == "table" then
		return manager.name or manager_id
	end

	return manager_id
end

local function Check_Manager(language_id, manager_id, callback)
	local manager = Managers.Get(language_id, manager_id)

	if type(manager) ~= "table" then
		callback(true)
		return
	end

	-- Native means no separate project manager is required.
	if manager_id == "native" or not manager.executable then
		callback(true)
		return
	end

	if vim.fn.executable(manager.executable) == 1 then
		callback(true)
		return
	end

	Confirm(Get_Manager_Name(language_id, manager_id) .. " does not appear to be installed. Continue anyway?", callback)
end

-- =========================================================
-- OPEN PROJECT
-- =========================================================

local function Open_Project(root, entry, options)
	if not options.open_after_create then
		return
	end

	local relative_entry = entry or ""

	if relative_entry ~= "" and Is_Safe_Relative_Path(relative_entry) then
		local path = Join_Path(root, relative_entry)

		if Is_File(path) then
			vim.cmd("edit " .. vim.fn.fnameescape(path))
			return
		end
	end

	Dashboard.Open(root)
end

-- =========================================================
-- CREATE PROJECT
-- =========================================================

local function Create_Project(options, language_id, manager_id, root, project_name, layout_id)
	local language = Languages.Get(language_id)

	if options.remember_last_project ~= false then
		Config.options.last_project_path = root
		Config.save()
	end

	if not language then
		Notify("Unknown language: " .. language_id, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return
	end

	local manager = Managers.Get(language_id, manager_id)

	if not manager then
		Notify("Unknown manager '" .. manager_id .. "' for " .. language_id, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return
	end

	local manifest, manifest_err = Build_Layout_Manifest(language_id, layout_id, project_name, manager_id, options)

	if not manifest then
		Notify("Could not prepare project: " .. tostring(manifest_err), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return
	end

	local entry = manifest.entry or Get_Language_File(language_id)

	local ok, err = Create_From_Manifest(root, manifest, options)

	if not ok then
		Notify("Project creation failed: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return
	end

	-- Initialize HyperMax project metadata after the files exist.
	local hmc_ok, hmc_result = Project_Config.Create(root, {
		name = project_name,
		language = language_id,
		manager = manager_id,
		creator = os.getenv("USER") or "unknown",
		entry_file = entry,
		entry_function = "main",
	})

	if not hmc_ok then
		Notify("Project created, but .hmc initialization failed: " .. tostring(hmc_result), vim.log.levels.WARN)
	else
		Notify("Created project and .hmc configuration: " .. root)
	end

	Open_Project(root, entry, options)
end

-- QUICK PROJECT CREATION

function Project.Quick_Create()
	local global, global_err = Project_Config.Get_Global()

	if not global then
		Notify("Could not load global configuration: " .. tostring(global_err), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return
	end

	local options = vim.tbl_deep_extend("force", {}, Config.options or {})

	-- Use global defaults for quick creation.
	local language_id = global.preferred_language or "c"
	local manager_id = "native"
	local location = vim.fn.expand(global.base_location or "~/Projects")

	Input("Quick project name: ", "", function(project_name)
		if project_name == nil then
			return
		end

		project_name = vim.trim(project_name)

		if project_name == "" or project_name:find("[/\\]") or project_name == "." or project_name == ".." then
			Notify("Invalid project name.", vim.log.levels.ERROR)
			return
		end

		local language = Languages.Get(language_id)

		if not language then
			Notify("Unknown preferred language: " .. language_id, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
			return
		end

		local manager = Managers.Get(language_id, manager_id)

		if not manager then
			Notify("The native manager is not available for " .. language_id, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
			return
		end

		local root = Join_Path(location, project_name)

		if uv.fs_stat(root) then
			Notify("Project path already exists: " .. root, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
			return
		end

		-- Use the normal project generator with no custom layout.
		-- This preserves templates, progress, README, and gitignore
		-- settings configured in HyperMax.
		Check_Manager(language_id, manager_id, function(continue)
			if not continue then
				Notify("Quick project creation cancelled.")
				return
			end

			Create_Project(options, language_id, manager_id, root, project_name, "")
		end)
	end)
end

-- PROJECT WIZARD
-- =========================================================

function Project.Create(user_options)
	local options = vim.tbl_deep_extend("force", {}, Config.options or {}, user_options or {})

	local language_ids = Get_Language_Choices(options)

	Select_Item(language_ids, "Choose project language", function(id)
		local favourite = vim.tbl_contains(options.favourite_languages or {}, id)

		return (favourite and "★ " or "  ") .. Get_Language_Name(id) .. " (" .. id .. ")"
	end, function(language_id)
		if not language_id then
			return
		end

		local manager_ids = Managers.Get_IDs(language_id)

		if type(manager_ids) ~= "table" or #manager_ids == 0 then
			manager_ids = { "native" }
		end

		local default_manager = options.default_manager or "native"

		-- Put the configured default manager first.
		table.sort(manager_ids, function(a, b)
			if a == default_manager then
				return true
			end

			if b == default_manager then
				return false
			end

			return a < b
		end)

		Select_Item(manager_ids, "Choose project manager", function(id)
			return Get_Manager_Name(language_id, id) .. " (" .. id .. ")"
		end, function(manager_id)
			if not manager_id then
				return
			end

			local default_location = options.project_dir or vim.fn.expand("~/Projects")

			Input("Project starting location: ", default_location, function(location)
				if location == nil then
					return
				end

				location = vim.trim(location)

				if location == "" then
					Notify("Project location cannot be empty.", vim.log.levels.ERROR)
					return
				end

				location = vim.fn.expand(location)

				Input("Project name: ", "MyProject", function(project_name)
					if project_name == nil then
						return
					end

					project_name = vim.trim(project_name)

					if
						project_name == ""
						or project_name:find("[/\\]")
						or project_name == "."
						or project_name == ".."
					then
						Notify("Invalid project name.", vim.log.levels.ERROR)
						return
					end

					local layouts = Layouts.Get_For_Language(language_id) or {}

					local choices = {
						{
							id = "",
							name = "Default project",
							description = "Use the standard project structure.",
						},
					}

					for _, layout in ipairs(layouts) do
						if type(layout) == "string" then
							local item = Layouts.Get(layout)

							if item then
								choices[#choices + 1] = item
							end
						elseif type(layout) == "table" then
							choices[#choices + 1] = layout
						end
					end

					local preferred_layout = options.default_layout or ""

					table.sort(choices, function(a, b)
						if a.id == preferred_layout then
							return true
						end

						if b.id == preferred_layout then
							return false
						end

						return (a.name or a.id) < (b.name or b.id)
					end)

					Select_Item(choices, "Choose project layout", function(layout)
						local name = layout.name or layout.id or "Default project"

						local description = layout.description

						if description and description ~= "" then
							return name .. " — " .. description
						end

						return name
					end, function(layout)
						if not layout then
							return
						end

						local layout_id = layout.id or ""

						local root = Join_Path(location, project_name)

						if uv.fs_stat(root) then
							Notify("Project path already exists: " .. root, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
							return
						end

						local function Continue()
							Check_Manager(language_id, manager_id, function(continue)
								if not continue then
									Notify("Project creation cancelled.")
									return
								end

								Create_Project(options, language_id, manager_id, root, project_name, layout_id)
							end)
						end

						if options.confirm_before_create then
							Confirm("Create " .. project_name .. " in " .. root .. "?", function(confirmed)
								if confirmed then
									Continue()
								else
									Notify("Project creation cancelled.")
								end
							end)
						else
							Continue()
						end
					end)
				end)
			end)
		end)
	end)
end

-- =========================================================
-- LIST EXISTING PROJECTS
-- =========================================================

function Project.List()
	local options = Config.options or {}
	local root = vim.fn.expand(options.project_dir or "~/Projects")
	local entries = uv.fs_scandir(root)

	if not entries then
		Notify("Project directory does not exist: " .. root, vim.log.levels.WARN)
		return
	end

	local projects = {}

	while true do
		local name, kind = uv.fs_scandir_next(entries)

		if not name then
			break
		end

		if kind == "directory" and name:sub(1, 1) ~= "." then
			local path = Join_Path(root, name)

			projects[#projects + 1] = {
				name = name,
				path = path,
			}
		end
	end

	table.sort(projects, function(a, b)
		return a.name:lower() < b.name:lower()
	end)

	Select_Item(projects, "Choose project", function(project)
		return project.name
	end, function(project)
		if not project then
			return
		end
		vim.cmd("tcd " .. vim.fn.fnameescape(project.path))
		Dashboard.Open(project.path)
		Notify("Opened project: " .. project.path)
	end)
end

-- =========================================================
-- OPEN LAST PROJECT
-- =========================================================

function Project.Open_Last()
	local options = Config.options or {}
	local path = options.last_project_path

	-- Check whether a last project has been saved.
	if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" then
		Notify("No last project has been saved yet.", vim.log.levels.WARN)
		return
	end

	-- Convert the saved path into an absolute path.
	path = vim.fn.fnamemodify(vim.fn.expand(path), ":p")

	-- Check whether the project directory still exists.
	if not Is_Directory(path) then
		Notify("Last project directory no longer exists: " .. path, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return
	end

	-- Check whether this is a valid HyperMax project.
	if not Dashboard.Is_Project(path) then
		Notify("Last project is not a valid HyperMax project: " .. path, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return
	end

	-- Switch to the project directory.
	vim.cmd("tcd " .. vim.fn.fnameescape(path))

	-- Always open the dashboard instead of a source file.
	if Dashboard.Open(path) then
		Notify("Opened project dashboard: " .. path)
	end
end

function Project.Load_Layout()

	local choices = {}

	for _, id in ipairs(ids) do

		if layout then
			choices[#choices + 1] = layout

	Select_Item(choices, "Choose layout", function(layout)

		Project.Create(options)
	end)

local function Scan_Directory(root)
	local layout = {
		name = vim.fn.fnamemodify(root, ":t"),
		description = "",
		directories = {},
		files = {},
	}

	local ignored = {
		[".git"] = true,
		[".hg"] = true,
		[".svn"] = true,
		["node_modules"] = true,
		["target"] = true,
		["build"] = true,
		["dist"] = true,
		[".venv"] = true,
		["venv"] = true,
		["__pycache__"] = true,
		[".idea"] = true,
		[".vscode"] = true,
	}

	local function Walk(directory, relative)
		local entries = uv.fs_scandir(directory)

		if not entries then
			return
		end

		while true do
			local name, kind = uv.fs_scandir_next(entries)

			if not name then
				break
			end

			if not ignored[name] and name:sub(1, 1) ~= "." then
				local relative_path = relative == "" and name or (relative .. "/" .. name)

				local full_path = Join_Path(directory, name)

				if kind == "directory" then
					if Is_Safe_Relative_Path(relative_path) then
						layout.directories[#layout.directories + 1] = relative_path

						Walk(full_path, relative_path)
					end
				elseif kind == "file" and Is_Safe_Relative_Path(relative_path) then
					local contents = Read_File(full_path)

					if contents ~= nil then
						layout.files[relative_path] = contents
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	Walk(root, "")

	return layout
end

function Project.Save_Layout()
	local current = vim.fn.getcwd()

	Input("Layout ID (letters, numbers, '_' or '-'): ", vim.fn.fnamemodify(current, ":t"), function(id)
		id = vim.trim(id or "")

		if not id:match("^[%w_-]+$") then
			Notify("Invalid layout ID.", vim.log.levels.ERROR)
			return
		end

		local layout = Scan_Directory(current)

		Input("Layout display name: ", layout.name, function(name)
			name = vim.trim(name or "")

			if name == "" then
				Notify("Layout name cannot be empty.", vim.log.levels.ERROR)
				return
			end

			layout.name = name

			Input("Description: ", layout.description, function(description)
				layout.description = description or ""

				Confirm("Save layout '" .. id .. "' to HyperMax?", function(save)
					if not save then
						Notify("Layout save cancelled.")
						return
					end

					local ok, err = Layouts.Save(id, layout)

					if not ok then
						Notify("Could not save layout: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
						return
					end

					Notify("Saved layout '" .. id .. "' from " .. current)
				end)
			end)
		end)
	end)
end

","type":"file"},{"path":"lua/hypermax/project_config.lua","content_saved":true,"content":"local Project_Config = {}

local uv = vim.uv or vim.loop

local DATA_VERSION = 1
local HISTORY_HEADER = "HMXHIST\0" .. string.char(0, 0, 0, DATA_VERSION)

local IGNORED_DIRECTORIES = {
	[".git"] = true,
	[".hmc"] = true,
	["node_modules"] = true,
	["vendor"] = true,
	["target"] = true,
	["build"] = true,
	[".venv"] = true,
	["venv"] = true,
}

local MAX_LAYOUT_FILE_SIZE = 1024 * 1024

-- =========================================================
-- PATHS
-- =========================================================

local function Join(...)
	return table.concat({ ... }, "/"):gsub("/+", "/")
end

local function Get_Global_Directory()
	return Join(vim.fn.stdpath("data"), "hypermax")
end

local function Get_Global_Config_Path()
	return Join(Get_Global_Directory(), "config.json")
end

local function Get_HMC_Directory(project_root)
	return Join(project_root, ".hmc")
end

local function Get_HMC_Paths(project_root)
	local directory = Get_HMC_Directory(project_root)

	return {
		directory = directory,
		layout = Join(directory, "layout.json"),
		config = Join(directory, "config.json"),
		basics = Join(directory, "basics.json"),
		history = Join(directory, "project.bin"),
	}
end

-- =========================================================
-- FILESYSTEM
-- =========================================================

local function Ensure_Directory(path)
	if vim.fn.isdirectory(path) == 1 then
		return true
	end

	local result = vim.fn.mkdir(path, "p")

	if result == 0 and vim.fn.isdirectory(path) ~= 1 then
		return false, "Could not create directory: " .. path
	end

	return true
end

local function Read_File(path)
	local file = io.open(path, "rb")

	if not file then
		return nil
	end

	local content = file:read("*a")
	file:close()

	return content
end

local function Write_File(path, content)
	local file, err = io.open(path, "wb")

	if not file then
		return false, err
	end

	local ok, write_err = file:write(content)

	if not ok then
		file:close()
		return false, write_err
	end

	local closed, close_err = file:close()

	if closed == nil then
		return false, close_err
	end

	return true
end

local function Read_JSON(path, fallback)
	local content = Read_File(path)

	if not content or content == "" then
		return vim.deepcopy(fallback)
	end

	local ok, data = pcall(vim.json.decode, content)

	if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
		return nil, "Invalid JSON: " .. path
	end

	return data
end

local function Write_JSON(path, data)
	local ok, encoded = pcall(vim.json.encode, data)

	if not ok then
		return false, encoded
	end

	return Write_File(path, encoded .. "\n")
end

-- =========================================================
-- DIRECTORY CAPTURE
-- =========================================================

local function Capture_Directory(project_root)
	local entries = {}
	local errors = {}

	local function Scan(directory, relative)
		local handle, err = uv.fs_scandir(directory)

		if not handle then
			errors[#errors + 1] = tostring(err)
			return
		end

		while true do
			local name, kind = uv.fs_scandir_next(handle)

			if not name then
				break
			end

			if not (kind == "directory" and IGNORED_DIRECTORIES[name]) then
				local relative_path = relative == "" and name or relative .. "/" .. name

				local full_path = Join(directory, name)

				if kind == "directory" then
					entries[#entries + 1] = {
						path = relative_path,
						type = "directory",
					}

					Scan(full_path, relative_path)
				elseif kind == "file" then
					local stat = uv.fs_stat(full_path)

					local entry = {
						path = relative_path,
						type = "file",
						content_saved = false,
					}

					if stat and stat.size <= MAX_LAYOUT_FILE_SIZE then
						local content = Read_File(full_path)

						-- Avoid saving likely binary files as text.
						if content and not content:find("\0", 1, true) then
							entry.content = content
							entry.content_saved = true
						end
					end

					entries[#entries + 1] = entry
				end
			end
		end
	end

	Scan(project_root, "")

	table.sort(entries, function(a, b)
		return a.path < b.path
	end)

	return {
		version = DATA_VERSION,
		entries = entries,
		capture_errors = errors,
		captured_at = os.time(),
	}
end

-- DEFAULT CONFIGURATIONS

local function Default_Project_Config()
	return {

local function Default_Basics(metadata)

	local git_enabled = vim.fn.isdirectory(git_directory) == 1

			creator = metadata.creator or os.getenv("USER") or "unknown",

			entry_point = {

				["function"] = metadata.entry_function or "main",
			},
		},
		git = {
			enabled = git_enabled,
		},
		conversion = metadata.conversion and {
			kind = metadata.conversion.kind or "folder_conversion",
			created_by = "hypermax",
			created_at = os.time(),
		} or nil,
	}
end

-- PUBLIC PATH AND EXISTENCE FUNCTIONS
-- =========================================================

function Project_Config.Get_Paths(project_root)
	project_root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(project_root, ":p")
	return Get_HMC_Paths(project_root)
end

-- Checks whether the project's .hmc directory exists.
function Project_Config.Exists(project_root)
	project_root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(project_root, ":p")

	local hmc_directory = Get_HMC_Directory(project_root)

	return vim.fn.isdirectory(hmc_directory) == 1
end

-- =========================================================
-- GLOBAL CONFIGURATION
-- =========================================================

function Project_Config.Get_Global()
	local path = Get_Global_Config_Path()
	local parent = Get_Global_Directory()

	local ok, err = Ensure_Directory(parent)

	if not ok then
		return nil, err
	end

	if vim.fn.filereadable(path) == 0 then
		local saved, save_err = Write_JSON(path, Default_Global_Config())

		if not saved then
			return nil, save_err
		end
	end

	return Read_JSON(path, Default_Global_Config())
end

function Project_Config.Save_Global(data)
	local ok, err = Ensure_Directory(Get_Global_Directory())

	if not ok then
		return false, err
	end

	data.version = DATA_VERSION

	return Write_JSON(Get_Global_Config_Path(), data)
end

-- =========================================================
-- CREATE PROJECT CONFIGURATION
-- =========================================================

function Project_Config.Create(project_root, metadata)
	project_root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(project_root, ":p")
	metadata = vim.deepcopy(metadata or {})
	metadata.root = project_root

	local paths = Get_HMC_Paths(project_root)

	if vim.fn.isdirectory(project_root) ~= 1 then
		return false, "Project directory does not exist: " .. project_root
	end

	if Project_Config.Exists(project_root) then
		return false, "This project already has a .hmc directory"
	end

	local ok, err = Ensure_Directory(paths.directory)

	if not ok then
		return false, err
	end

	local files = {
		{
			path = paths.basics,
			data = Default_Basics(metadata),
		},
		{
			path = paths.config,
			data = Default_Project_Config(),
		},
		{
			path = paths.layout,
			data = Capture_Directory(project_root),
		},
	}

	for _, item in ipairs(files) do
		local saved, save_err = Write_JSON(item.path, item.data)

		if not saved then
			pcall(vim.fn.delete, paths.directory, "rf")
			return false, save_err
		end
	end

	local history_saved, history_err = Write_File(paths.history, HISTORY_HEADER)

	if not history_saved then
		pcall(vim.fn.delete, paths.directory, "rf")
		return false, history_err
	end

	return true, paths
end

-- LOAD PROJECT CONFIGURATION

local function Read_Legacy_Basics(paths)
	local candidates = {
		paths.basics,
		Join(paths.directory, "basic.json"),
		Join(paths.directory, "project.json"),
		Join(paths.directory, "metadata.json"),
		Join(paths.directory, "project_config.json"),
		Join(paths.directory, "hypermax.json"),
	}
	local empty_data
	for _, path in ipairs(candidates) do
		if vim.fn.filereadable(path) == 1 then
			local data, err = Read_JSON(path, {})
			if not data then return nil, err end
			if type(data.project) ~= "table" or next(data.project) == nil then
				local project_keys = { "name", "root", "language", "manager", "creator", "created_at", "entry_file", "entry_function", "entry_point", "project_name", "project_root" }
				local project = {}
				for _, key in ipairs(project_keys) do
					if data[key] ~= nil then project[key] = data[key] end
				end
				project.name = project.name or data.project_name
				project.root = project.root or data.project_root
				if next(project) then data.project = project end
			end
			if type(data.project) == "table" and next(data.project) then
				data.project.entry_point = data.project.entry_point or {
					file = data.project.entry_file or data.entry_file or "",
					["function"] = data.project.entry_function or data.entry_function or "main",
				}
				data.git = data.git or { enabled = vim.fn.isdirectory(vim.fn.fnamemodify(paths.directory, ":h") .. "/.git") == 1 }
				return data
			end
			empty_data = data
		end
	end
	return empty_data or {}, nil
end

local function Read_Legacy_Config(paths)
	if vim.fn.filereadable(paths.config) == 1 then
		return Read_JSON(paths.config, Default_Project_Config())
	end
	for _, path in ipairs({ Join(paths.directory, "settings.json"), Join(paths.directory, "options.json") }) do
		if vim.fn.filereadable(path) == 1 then
			local data, err = Read_JSON(path, Default_Project_Config())
			if not data then return nil, err end
			if type(data.settings) ~= "table" then data = { version = data.version or DATA_VERSION, settings = data } end
			return data
		end
	end
	return Default_Project_Config(), nil
end

local function Read_Legacy_Layout(paths)
	local candidates = { paths.layout, Join(paths.directory, "tree.json"), Join(paths.directory, "files.json"), Join(paths.directory, "project_layout.json") }
	for _, path in ipairs(candidates) do
		if vim.fn.filereadable(path) == 1 then
			local data, err = Read_JSON(path, { version = DATA_VERSION, entries = {} })
			if not data then return nil, err end
			if type(data.entries) ~= "table" and type(data.files) == "table" then data.entries = data.files end
			data.entries = data.entries or {}
			data.version = data.version or DATA_VERSION
			return data
		end
	end
	return { version = DATA_VERSION, entries = {} }, nil
end

function Project_Config.Load(project_root)
	project_root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(project_root, ":p")

	local paths = Get_HMC_Paths(project_root)

	if not Project_Config.Exists(project_root) then
		return nil, "No .hmc directory exists in this project"
	end

	local basics, basics_err = Read_Legacy_Basics(paths)
	local config, config_err = Read_Legacy_Config(paths)
	local layout, layout_err = Read_Legacy_Layout(paths)

	if not basics then
		return nil, basics_err
	end

	if not config then
		return nil, config_err
	end

	if not layout then
		return nil, layout_err
	end

	return {
		root = project_root,
		paths = paths,
		basics = basics,
		config = config,
		layout = layout,
	}
end

-- =========================================================
-- PROJECT CONVERSION / SCRAPING
-- =========================================================

function Project_Config.Convert_Folder(project_root, metadata)
	project_root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(vim.fn.expand(project_root or ""), ":p")
	if project_root == "" or vim.fn.isdirectory(project_root) ~= 1 then
		return false, "Choose an existing folder to convert"
	end
	if Project_Config.Exists(project_root) then return false, "Folder is already a HyperMax project" end
	metadata = vim.deepcopy(metadata or {})
	metadata.name = metadata.name or vim.fs.basename(project_root)
	metadata.language = metadata.language or "unknown"
	metadata.manager = metadata.manager or "native"
	metadata.entry_file = metadata.entry_file or ""
	metadata.entry_function = metadata.entry_function or "main"
	metadata.conversion = { kind = "folder_conversion" }
	return Project_Config.Create(project_root, metadata)
end

local function Remove_HMC(project_root, require_conversion)
	project_root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(vim.fn.expand(project_root or ""), ":p")
	local loaded, err = Project_Config.Load(project_root)
	if not loaded then return false, err end
	if require_conversion and not (loaded.basics.conversion and loaded.basics.conversion.kind == "folder_conversion") then
		return false, "This project was not created by folder conversion; refusing to undo it"
	end
	local directory = loaded.paths.directory
	local stat = uv.fs_lstat(directory)
	if not stat or stat.type ~= "directory" then return false, "The .hmc metadata path is not a real directory" end
	local backup = directory .. ".backup-" .. os.date("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
	local renamed, rename_err = uv.fs_rename(directory, backup)
	if not renamed then return false, "Could not safely back up .hmc: " .. tostring(rename_err) end
	return true, backup
end

function Project_Config.Undo_Conversion(project_root)
	return Remove_HMC(project_root, true)
end

function Project_Config.Scrape(project_root)
	return Remove_HMC(project_root, false)
end

-- =========================================================
-- PROJECT SETTINGS
-- =========================================================

function Project_Config.Save_Project_Settings(project_root, settings)
	local paths = Get_HMC_Paths(vim.fn.fnamemodify(project_root, ":p"))

	if not Project_Config.Exists(project_root) then
		return false, "This project has no .hmc directory"
	end

	local config, err = Read_JSON(paths.config, Default_Project_Config())

	if not config then
		return false, err
	end

	config.settings = config.settings or {}

	for key, value in pairs(settings) do
		config.settings[key] = value
	end

	return Write_JSON(paths.config, config)
end

function Project_Config.Save_Setting(project_root, key, value)
	vim.ui.select({
		"This project only",
		"Global HyperMax defaults",
		"Cancel",
	}, {
		prompt = "Where should this setting be saved?",
	}, function(choice)
		if choice == "This project only" then
			local ok, err = Project_Config.Save_Project_Settings(project_root, { [key] = value })

			if not ok then
				vim.notify("HyperMax: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
				return
			end

			vim.notify("Saved to project configuration")
		elseif choice == "Global HyperMax defaults" then
			local global, err = Project_Config.Get_Global()

			if not global then
				vim.notify("HyperMax: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
				return
			end

			global.settings = global.settings or {}
			global.settings[key] = value

			local ok, save_err = Project_Config.Save_Global(global)

			if not ok then
				vim.notify("HyperMax: " .. tostring(save_err), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
				return
			end

			vim.notify("Saved to global HyperMax configuration")
		end
	end)
end

return Project_Config
","type":"file"},{"path":"lua/hypermax/settings.lua","content_saved":true,"content":"local Config = require("hypermax.config")
local Languages = require("hypermax.languages")

local Settings = {}

local Boolean_Settings = {
	create_missing_dir = "Create missing project directories",
	open_after_create = "Open project after creation",
	show_progress = "Show progress window",
	show_command_output = "Show command output",
	confirm_before_create = "Confirm before creating projects",
	create_readme = "Generate README.md",
	create_gitignore = "Generate .gitignore",
	create_credits = "Generate CREDITS.md",
	create_default_directories = "Generate default directories",
	remember_last_language = "Remember last language",
	remember_last_manager = "Remember last manager",
}

local function Notify(message)
	vim.notify("HyperMax: " .. message)
end

local function Save(key, value)
	Config.set(key, value)
	Notify("Saved " .. key .. ".")
end

local function Edit_Text(key, label)
	vim.ui.input({
		prompt = label .. ": ",
		default = tostring(Config.get(key) or ""),
	}, function(value)
		if value == nil then
			return
		end

		Save(key, value)
	end)
end

local function Edit_Boolean(key, label)
	local current = Config.get(key)

	vim.ui.select({ "Yes", "No" }, {
		prompt = label,
		format_item = function(item)
			if (item == "Yes") == current then
				return item .. "  (current)"
			end

			return item
		end,
	}, function(choice)
		if choice == nil then
			return
		end

		Save(key, choice == "Yes")
	end)
end

local function Edit_Language()
	local ids = Languages.Get_IDs()
	local favourites = Config.get("favourite_languages") or {}

	table.sort(ids, function(a, b)
		local function Is_Favourite(id)
			return vim.tbl_contains(favourites, id)
		end

		if Is_Favourite(a) ~= Is_Favourite(b) then
			return Is_Favourite(a)
		end

		return a < b
	end)

	vim.ui.select(ids, {
		prompt = "Choose default language",
		format_item = function(id)
			if vim.tbl_contains(favourites, id) then
				return "★ " .. id
			end

			return id
		end,
	}, function(choice)
		if choice then
			Save("default_language", choice)
		end
	end)
end

local function Edit_Favourites()
	local current = table.concat(Config.get("favourite_languages") or {}, ", ")

	vim.ui.input({
		prompt = "Favourite languages (comma-separated): ",
		default = current,
	}, function(value)
		if value == nil then
			return
		end

		local favourites = {}
		local seen = {}

		for id in value:gmatch("[^,]+") do
			id = vim.trim(id)

			if Languages.Exists(id) and not seen[id] then
				favourites[#favourites + 1] = id
				seen[id] = true
			elseif id ~= "" and not Languages.Exists(id) then
				Notify("Unknown language ignored: " .. id)
			end
		end

		Save("favourite_languages", favourites)
	end)
end

local function Edit_Manager()
	local Managers = require("hypermax.managers")
	local language = Config.get("default_language")
	local managers = Managers.Get_IDs(language)

	if #managers == 0 then
		Notify("No managers registered for " .. language .. ".")
		return
	end

	vim.ui.select(managers, {
		prompt = "Default manager for " .. language,
	}, function(choice)
		if choice then
			Save("default_manager", choice)
		end
	end)
end

local function Edit_Setting(key, label)
	if Boolean_Settings[key] then
		Edit_Boolean(key, label)
	elseif key == "default_language" then
		Edit_Language()
	elseif key == "favourite_languages" then
		Edit_Favourites()
	elseif key == "default_manager" then
		Edit_Manager()
	elseif key == "project_dir" then
		Edit_Text(key, label)
	elseif key == "default_layout" then
		Edit_Text(key, label)
	end
end

function Settings.Open()
	local entries = {
		{ label = "Default language", key = "default_language" },
		{ label = "Project starting location", key = "project_dir" },
		{ label = "Favourite languages", key = "favourite_languages" },
		{ label = "Default manager", key = "default_manager" },
		{ label = "Default layout ID", key = "default_layout" },
	}

	for key, label in pairs(Boolean_Settings) do
		entries[#entries + 1] = {
			label = label,
			key = key,
		}
	end

	table.sort(entries, function(a, b)
		return a.label < b.label
	end)

	local choices = {}

	for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
		local value = Config.get(entry.key)

		if type(value) == "table" then
			value = table.concat(value, ", ")
		end

		choices[#choices + 1] = {
			entry = entry,
			text = entry.label .. " = " .. tostring(value),
		}
	end

	choices[#choices + 1] = {
		reset = true,
		text = "Reset all settings to defaults",
	}

	vim.ui.select(choices, {
		prompt = "HyperMax Settings",
		format_item = function(item)
			return item.text
		end,
	}, function(choice)
		if not choice then
			return
		end

		if choice.reset then
			vim.ui.select({ "Cancel", "Reset" }, {
				prompt = "Reset all HyperMax settings?",
			}, function(answer)
				if answer == "Reset" then
					Config.reset()
					Notify("Settings reset.")
					Settings.Open()
				end
			end)

			return
		end

		Edit_Setting(choice.entry.key, choice.entry.label)
	end)
end

return Settings

-- HYPERMAX TEST RUNNER
-- =========================================================
package.path = "./tests/?.lua;" .. package.path
local source = debug.getinfo(1, "S").source

if source:sub(1, 1) == "@" then
	source = source:sub(2)
end

local test_directory = vim.fs.dirname(vim.fn.fnamemodify(source, ":p"))
local plugin_root = vim.fs.dirname(test_directory)

-- Make the plugin and test helper files discoverable.
vim.opt.rtp:prepend(plugin_root)

package.path = table.concat({
	plugin_root .. "/?.lua",
	plugin_root .. "/?/init.lua",
	package.path,
}, ";")

-- Tests expect the repository root as the working directory.
vim.fn.chdir(plugin_root)

local Test = require("tests.testlib")

-- =========================================================
-- TEST SUITES
-- =========================================================

local test_files = {
	"tests/test_file.lua",
	"tests/test_connections.lua",
	"tests/test_languages.lua",
	"tests/test_managers.lua",
	"tests/test_layout.lua",
	"tests/test_progress.lua",
	"tests/test_filesystem.lua",
	"tests/test_project_lifecycle.lua",
	"tests/test_git.lua",
	"tests/test_dashboard.lua",
	"tests/test_dashboard_deep.lua",
}

-- =========================================================
-- EXECUTE EACH TEST SUITE
-- =========================================================

print("")
print("[INFO] HyperMax repository: " .. plugin_root)
print("[INFO] Starting health checks...")
print("")

for _, relative_path in ipairs(test_files) do
	local full_path = plugin_root .. "/" .. relative_path
	local chunk, load_error = loadfile(full_path)

	if not chunk then
		Test.Run("Load " .. relative_path, function()
			error("Could not load test file:\n" .. tostring(load_error))
		end)
	else
		local ok, err = xpcall(chunk, debug.traceback)

		if not ok then
			Test.Run("Execute " .. relative_path, function()
				error("Test file crashed:\n" .. tostring(err))
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- =========================================================
-- FINAL RESULT AND PROCESS EXIT CODE
-- =========================================================

local success = Test.Finish()

if success then
	vim.cmd("qa!")
else
	-- A failed health check must return a non-zero exit code.
	vim.cmd("cquit 1")
end

","type":"file"},{"path":"tests/test_dashboard.lua","content_saved":true,"content":"-- =========================================================
-- HYPERMAX DASHBOARD RUNTIME TESTS
-- =========================================================
--
-- Run from the repository root:
-- nvim --headless -u NONE -c "set rtp+=." -c "luafile tests/test_dashboard.lua"
--
-- These tests exercise real Neovim buffers and keymaps.
-- They are not substitutes for testing with your normal UI
-- plugin configuration (such as dressing.nvim).
-- =========================================================

local Passed = 0
local Failed = 0
local Failures = {}

local function Test(Name, Callback)
	local ok, err = xpcall(Callback, debug.traceback)

	if ok then
		Passed = Passed + 1
		print("[PASS] Dashboard: " .. Name)
	else
		Failed = Failed + 1
		Failures[#Failures + 1] = {
			name = Name,
			error = tostring(err),
		}

		print("[FAIL] Dashboard: " .. Name)
		print(tostring(err))
	end
end

local function Assert(Value, Message)
	if not Value then
		error(Message or "Assertion failed", 2)
	end
end

local function Assert_Valid_Buffer(Buffer, Message)
	Assert(type(Buffer) == "number" and vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(Buffer), Message or "Expected a valid Neovim buffer")
end

local function Flush_Scheduled_Callbacks()
	-- Let queued Neovim callbacks run.
	vim.wait(100, function()
		return false
	end)
end

local function Create_Test_Directory()
	local Path = vim.fn.fnamemodify(vim.fn.tempname(), ":p")
	vim.fn.mkdir(Path .. "/.hmc", "p")

	local Basics = {
		version = 1,
		project = {
			name = "DashboardTest",
			root = Path,
			language = "c",
			manager = "native",
			creator = "tests",
			created_at = os.time(),
			entry_point = {
				file = "src/main.c",
				["function"] = "main",
			},
		},
		git = { enabled = false },
	}

	vim.fn.mkdir(Path .. "/src", "p")

	local config_file = assert(io.open(Path .. "/.hmc/basics.json", "w"))
	config_file:write(vim.json.encode(Basics))
	config_file:close()

	local main_file = assert(io.open(Path .. "/src/main.c", "w"))
	main_file:write("int main(void) { return 0; }\n")
	main_file:close()

	return Path
end

local function Remove_Test_Directory(Path)
	if Path and Path ~= "" then
		vim.fn.delete(Path, "rf")
	end
end

-- Make sure the plugin modules can be loaded.
Test("dashboard module loads", function()
	package.loaded["hypermax.dashboard"] = nil

	local Dashboard = require("hypermax.dashboard")

	Assert(type(Dashboard) == "table", "Dashboard module did not return a table")
	Assert(type(Dashboard.Open) == "function", "Dashboard.Open is missing")
	Assert(type(Dashboard.Is_Project) == "function", "Dashboard.Is_Project is missing")
end)

-- Opening a dashboard must not attempt to set keymaps on a
-- deleted or invalid buffer.
Test("opening dashboard does not use an invalid buffer", function()
	local Dashboard = require("hypermax.dashboard")
	local Root = Create_Test_Directory()

	local ok, err = pcall(Dashboard.Open, Root)

	Flush_Scheduled_Callbacks()
	Remove_Test_Directory(Root)

	Assert(ok, "Dashboard.Open raised an error: " .. tostring(err))

	Assert_Valid_Buffer(vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf(), "Current buffer became invalid after opening the dashboard")
end)

-- Opening the same project more than once must not raise
-- E95: Buffer with this name already exists.
Test("opening the same dashboard repeatedly is safe", function()
	local Dashboard = require("hypermax.dashboard")
	local Root = Create_Test_Directory()

	local ok1, err1 = pcall(Dashboard.Open, Root)
	Flush_Scheduled_Callbacks()

	Assert(ok1, "First open failed: " .. tostring(err1))

	local ok2, err2 = pcall(Dashboard.Open, Root)
	Flush_Scheduled_Callbacks()

	Remove_Test_Directory(Root)

	Assert(ok2, "Second open failed: " .. tostring(err2))
	Assert_Valid_Buffer(vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf())
end)

-- Simulate a dashboard buffer being deleted and then opened
-- again. This helps detect stale buffer IDs in keymap setup.
local Dashboard = require("hypermax.dashboard")
Test("Dashboard: dashboard can reopen after its buffer is deleted", function()
	local Root = Create_Test_Directory()
	local ok, err = pcall(Dashboard.Open, Root)
	Assert(ok, "Dashboard open failed: " .. tostring(err))

	local state = Dashboard.Get_State()
	local old_buffer = state.buffer
	local old_window = state.window

	Assert(vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(old_buffer), "Dashboard buffer should initially be valid")
	Assert(vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(old_window), "Dashboard panel window should initially be valid")

	local editor_window
	for _, win in ipairs(vim.api.nvim_tabpage_list_wins(0)) do
		if win ~= old_window then
			editor_window = win
			break
		end
	end
	Assert(editor_window ~= nil, "Dashboard should leave an editor window beside the panel")
	vim.api.nvim_set_current_win(editor_window)
	-- Neovim will keep a buffer alive while a window still displays it.
	-- Replace the panel's buffer first, then verify the old one can be wiped.
	local replacement_buffer = vim.api.nvim_create_buf(false, true)
	vim.api.nvim_win_set_buf(old_window, replacement_buffer)
	vim.api.nvim_buf_delete(old_buffer, { force = true })

	Assert(not vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(old_buffer), "Old dashboard buffer should be deleted")

	local reopened, reopen_err = pcall(Dashboard.Open, Root)
	Assert(reopened, "Dashboard should reopen after deletion: " .. tostring(reopen_err))
	Assert(vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf()), "Current buffer should be valid after reopening")
	if vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(replacement_buffer) then
		pcall(vim.api.nvim_buf_delete, replacement_buffer, { force = true })
	end

	Remove_Test_Directory(Root)
end)

Test("Dashboard: create files and folders and cycle sort modes", function()
	local Root = Create_Test_Directory()
	local Dashboard = require("hypermax.dashboard")
	Assert(Dashboard.Open(Root), "Dashboard should open")

	local ok_file, file_path, file_err = Dashboard.Create("file", "src/created.c")
	Assert(ok_file, "Dashboard should create a file: " .. tostring(file_err))
	Assert(vim.fn.filereadable(file_path) == 1, "Dashboard should create a file")

	local ok_folder, folder_path, folder_err = Dashboard.Create("folder", "src/new_folder")
	Assert(ok_folder, "Dashboard should create a folder: " .. tostring(folder_err))
	Assert(vim.fn.isdirectory(folder_path) == 1, "Dashboard should create a folder")

	local old_mode = Dashboard.Get_State().sort_mode
	local next_mode = Dashboard.Cycle_Sort()
	Assert(Dashboard.Get_State().sort_mode ~= old_mode, "Sort key should cycle to the next sorting mode")
	Assert(type(next_mode) == "string", "Sort mode should be a name")
	Remove_Test_Directory(Root)
end)

Test("Dashboard: Git status is detected for a repository", function()
	if vim.fn.executable("git") ~= 1 then
		print("[SKIP] Git is not installed")
		return
	end
	local Root = Create_Test_Directory()
	local result = vim.fn.systemlist({ "git", "-C", Root, "init" })
	Assert(vim.v.shell_error == 0, "Could not initialize test Git repository: " .. table.concat(result, "\n"))

	Remove_Test_Directory(Root)
end)

Test("Project metadata: basics.json records the entry file and main function", function()
	local Root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(vim.fn.tempname(), ":p")
	vim.fn.mkdir(Root .. "/src", "p")

	local main_file = assert(io.open(Root .. "/src/main.c", "w"))
	main_file:write("int main(void) { return 0; }\n")
	main_file:close()

	local Project_Config = require("hypermax.project_config")
	local ok, result = Project_Config.Create(Root, {
		name = "EntryPointTest",
		language = "c",
		manager = "native",
		entry_file = "src/main.c",
		entry_function = "main",
	})
	Assert(ok, "Could not create .hmc metadata: " .. tostring(result))

	local loaded, err = Project_Config.Load(Root)
	Assert(loaded ~= nil, "Could not reload .hmc metadata: " .. tostring(err))
	Assert(loaded.basics.project.entry_point.file == "src/main.c", "basics.json should record the entry file")
	Assert(loaded.basics.project.entry_point["function"] == "main", "basics.json should record the main function")

	Remove_Test_Directory(Root)
end)

Test("Dashboard: opening an entry file keeps the sidebar visible", function()
	local Root = Create_Test_Directory()
	Assert(Dashboard.Open(Root), "Dashboard should open for a valid project")

	local state = Dashboard.Get_State()
	local panel_window = state.window
	local panel_buffer = state.buffer
	local entry_path = vim.fn.fnamemodify(Root .. "/src/main.c", ":p")
	local entry_line = state.line_by_path[entry_path]

	Assert(entry_line ~= nil, "Entry file should appear in the project tree")
	Assert(state.metadata.entry_file == "src/main.c", "Entry file should load from basics.json")
	Assert(state.metadata.entry_function == "main", "Entry function should load from basics.json")

	vim.api.nvim_set_current_win(panel_window)
	vim.api.nvim_win_set_cursor(panel_window, { entry_line, 0 })
	vim.api.nvim_feedkeys(vim.api.nvim_replace_termcodes("<CR>", true, false, true), "x", false)

	local opened = vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf()

Test.Run("Dashboard: dashboard source files compile", function()
	local files = {

		"lua/hypermax/project.lua",

		"lua/hypermax/init.lua",
	}

	for _, path in ipairs(files) do
		local file = io.open(path, "r")

		Test.Not_Nil(file, "Could not open " .. path)

		local source = file:read("*a")

		local chunk, err = loadstring(source, "@" .. path)

		Test.Not_Nil(chunk, "Lua syntax error in " .. path .. ": " .. tostring(err))
	end
end)
","type":"file"},{"path":"tests/test_filesystem.lua","content_saved":true,"content":"-- Deep edge-case tests for project-relative file/folder creation.
local Test = require("tests.testlib")
local FS = require("hypermax.filesystem")
local uv = vim.uv or vim.loop

local function New_Root()
	local root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(vim.fn.tempname(), ":p")
	vim.fn.mkdir(root, "p")
	return root
end
local function Cleanup(root) if root then pcall(vim.fn.delete, root, "rf") end end
local function Exists(path) return uv.fs_lstat(path) ~= nil end

local unsafe = {
	{ "empty", "" }, { "spaces only", "   " }, { "dot", "." }, { "dot slash", "./file" },
	{ "parent", ".." }, { "parent prefix", "../escape" }, { "nested parent", "src/../../escape" },
	{ "absolute root", "/tmp/escape" }, { "tilde home", "~/escape" }, { "windows drive", "C:/escape" },
	{ "windows drive lower", "d:\\escape" }, { "backslash traversal", "..\\escape" },
	{ "embedded traversal", "src/../escape" }, { "nested dot", "src/./file" },
	{ "nul byte", "src/\0bad" }, { "newline", "src/bad\nname" }, { "tab", "src/bad\tname" },
	{ "escape twice", "../../../../escape" }, { "leading whitespace absolute", " /tmp/escape" },
	{ "only slash", "/" }, { "root slash", "//server/share" },
}
for _, case in ipairs(unsafe) do
	Test.Run("Filesystem rejects unsafe path: " .. case[1], function()
		local root = New_Root()
		local path, err = FS.Safe_Child(root, case[2])
		Test.Nil(path, "Unsafe input should not produce a path")
		Test.Type("string", err, "Unsafe path should explain the rejection")
		Cleanup(root)
	end)
end

local safe = {
	"main.c", "src/main.c", "include/player.h", "assets/texture.png", "a b/file name.txt",
	"folder.with.dots/file.ext", "under_score/file_name.c", "dash-name/file-name.c", "unicode/é.txt",
	"literal; punctuation/file $(name).txt", "leading-dash/-main.c",
	"UPPER/FILE.C", "deep/one/two/three.txt", "folder/123", "file..name.c", "space at end /name.txt",
}
for index, input in ipairs(safe) do
	Test.Run("Filesystem accepts safe relative path " .. index, function()
		local root = New_Root()
		local path, err = FS.Safe_Child(root, input)
		Test.Not_Nil(path, "Safe path rejected: " .. tostring(err))
		Test.True(FS.Is_Within(root, path), "Returned path must be inside root")
		Test.True(path:sub(1, #FS.Normalize(root) + 1) == FS.Normalize(root) .. "/")
		Cleanup(root)
	end)
end

local create_cases = {
	{ "simple file", "file", "main.c", "file" },
	{ "nested file", "file", "src/game/main.c", "file" },
	{ "file with spaces", "file", "assets/my texture.png", "file" },
	{ "unicode file", "file", "src/é.c", "file" },
	{ "simple folder", "folder", "src", "directory" },
	{ "nested folder", "folder", "src/game/player", "directory" },
	{ "folder with spaces", "folder", "assets/my textures", "directory" },
	{ "dot file", "file", ".gitignore", "file" },
	{ "folder with dot", "folder", "include.v2", "directory" },
	{ "multiple nested file parents", "file", "one/two/three/four.txt", "file" },
	{ "multiple nested folder parents", "folder", "one/two/three/four", "directory" },
}
for _, case in ipairs(create_cases) do
	Test.Run("Filesystem creates " .. case[1], function()
		local root = New_Root()
		local ok, path, err = FS.Create(root, case[2], case[3])
		Test.True(ok, "Creation failed: " .. tostring(err))
		Test.Not_Nil(path)
		local stat = uv.fs_stat(path)
		Test.Not_Nil(stat, "Created path must exist")
		Test.Equal(case[4], stat.type)
		Cleanup(root)
	end)
end

local failures = {
	{ "unknown type", "unknown", "file.txt" },
	{ "missing root", "file", "file.txt", nil },
	{ "non-string input", "file", 42 },
}
for _, case in ipairs(failures) do
	Test.Run("Filesystem handles invalid request: " .. case[1], function()
		local root = New_Root()
		local ok, path, err
		if case[1] == "missing root" then
			ok, path, err = FS.Create(nil, case[2], case[3])
		else
			ok, path, err = FS.Create(root, case[2], case[3])
		end
		Test.False(ok)
		Test.Nil(path)
		Test.Type("string", err)
		Cleanup(root)
	end)
end

Test.Run("Filesystem treats cancellation as non-error", function()
	local root = New_Root()
	local ok, path, err = FS.Create(root, "file", nil)
	Test.False(ok); Test.Nil(path); Test.Equal("cancelled", err)
	Cleanup(root)
end)

Test.Run("Filesystem refuses to overwrite an existing file", function()
	local root = New_Root(); local path = root .. "/existing.txt"
	local f = assert(io.open(path, "w")); f:write("keep"); f:close()
	local ok, _, err = FS.Create(root, "file", "existing.txt")
	Test.False(ok); Test.True(err:find("Already exists", 1, true) ~= nil)
	local read = assert(io.open(path, "r")); Test.Equal("keep", read:read("*a")); read:close()
	Cleanup(root)
end)

Test.Run("Filesystem refuses to overwrite an existing folder", function()
	local root = New_Root(); vim.fn.mkdir(root .. "/existing", "p")
	local ok, _, err = FS.Create(root, "folder", "existing")
	Test.False(ok); Test.True(err:find("Already exists", 1, true) ~= nil)
	Cleanup(root)
end)

Test.Run("Filesystem refuses a file where a parent folder is expected", function()
	local root = New_Root(); local f = assert(io.open(root .. "/blocker", "w")); f:close()
	local ok, _, err = FS.Create(root, "file", "blocker/child.txt")
	Test.False(ok); Test.Type("string", err)
	Cleanup(root)
end)

Test.Run("Filesystem normalizes root trailing slash", function()
	local root = New_Root()
	local path, err = FS.Safe_Child(root .. "/", "src/main.c")
	Test.Not_Nil(path, tostring(err)); Test.True(FS.Is_Within(root, path))
	Cleanup(root)
end)

Test.Run("Filesystem does not consider root itself a child", function()
	local root = New_Root()
	Test.False(FS.Is_Within(root, root))
	Cleanup(root)
end)

Test.Run("Filesystem rejects sibling sharing root prefix", function()
	local root = New_Root()
	Test.False(FS.Is_Within(root, root .. "-escape/file"))
	Cleanup(root)
end)

Test.Run("Filesystem handles a root path with spaces", function()
	local root = New_Root() .. " root with spaces"
	vim.fn.mkdir(root, "p")
	local ok, path, err = FS.Create(root, "file", "src/main.c")
	Test.True(ok, tostring(err)); Test.True(Exists(path))
	Cleanup(root)
end)

Test.Run("Filesystem rejects symlink escape when symlink support is available", function()
	local root, outside = New_Root(), New_Root()
	local link = root .. "/outside"
	local ok = pcall(uv.fs_symlink, outside, link, {})
	if ok and uv.fs_lstat(link) then
		local path, err = FS.Safe_Child(root, "outside/escape.txt")
		Test.Nil(path); Test.Type("string", err)
	else
		print("[SKIP] symlink creation is unavailable on this platform")
	end
	Cleanup(root); Cleanup(outside)
end)

-- These table-driven cases are intentionally separate test records so a failure
-- identifies the exact edge case instead of hiding behind a broad aggregate.
Test.Run("Filesystem normalization is idempotent for common paths", function()
	local root = New_Root()
	for _, path in ipairs({ root, root .. "/", root .. "/src/../src", root .. "/./src" }) do
		local first = FS.Normalize(path)
		Test.Not_Nil(first)
		Test.Equal(first, FS.Normalize(first))
	end
	Cleanup(root)
end)
","type":"file"},{"path":"tests/test_git.lua","content_saved":true,"content":"-- Deep tests for Git command execution, status parsing and repository edge cases.
local Test = require("tests.testlib")
local Git = require("hypermax.git")
local uv = vim.uv or vim.loop

local function New_Root(suffix)
	local root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(vim.fn.tempname(), ":p") .. (suffix or "")
	vim.fn.mkdir(root, "p")
	return root
end
local function Cleanup(root) if root then pcall(vim.fn.delete, root, "rf") end end
local function Write(path, content)
	vim.fn.mkdir(vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":h"), "p")
	local file = assert(io.open(path, "w")); file:write(content or "x\n"); file:close()
end
local function Has_Git() return vim.fn.executable("git") == 1 end

local status_cases = {
	{ "untracked file", { "?? new.c" }, "new.c", "??" },
	{ "modified file", { " M main.c" }, "main.c", " M" },
	{ "staged addition", { "A  add.c" }, "add.c", "A " },
	{ "staged modification", { "M  main.c" }, "main.c", "M " },
	{ "staged deletion", { "D  gone.c" }, "gone.c", "D " },
	{ "unstaged deletion", { " D gone.c" }, "gone.c", " D" },
	{ "staged and unstaged modification", { "MM both.c" }, "both.c", "MM" },
	{ "rename destination", { "R  old.c -> new.c" }, "new.c", "R " },
	{ "untracked nested file", { "?? src/main.c" }, "src/main.c", "??" },
	{ "space in path", { "?? src/my file.c" }, "src/my file.c", "??" },
	{ "dash in path", { "?? -main.c" }, "-main.c", "??" },
	{ "underscore in path", { "?? my_file.c" }, "my_file.c", "??" },
	{ "unicode path", { "?? src/é.c" }, "src/é.c", "??" },
	{ "dotfile", { "?? .gitignore" }, ".gitignore", "??" },
	{ "multiple status rows", { "?? one.c", " M two.c", "A  three.c" }, "three.c", "A " },
	{ "ignores malformed short row", { "?" }, "?", nil },
	{ "ignores empty row", { "" }, "", nil },
	{ "ignores header row", { "## main" }, "main", nil },
	{ "does not map parent traversal", { "?? ../escape.c" }, "../escape.c", nil },
	{ "maps nested directory", { "?? src/one/two.c" }, "src/one/two.c", "??" },
	{ "handles duplicate rows with last status", { "?? same.c", " M same.c" }, "same.c", " M" },
	{ "handles path beginning with dot", { "?? .config/app" }, ".config/app", "??" },
	{ "handles numeric filename", { "?? 123.c" }, "123.c", "??" },
	{ "handles extensionless filename", { "?? Makefile" }, "Makefile", "??" },
	{ "handles directory marker path", { "?? assets/" }, "assets", "??" },
	{ "handles type change", { " T script.sh" }, "script.sh", " T" },
	{ "filename containing arrow is not mistaken for rename", { "?? old -> new.txt" }, "old -> new.txt", "??" },
	{ "empty path is ignored", { "?? " }, "", nil },
	{ "decodes escaped newline filename", { [[?? "line\nfeed.c"]] }, "line\nfeed.c", "??" },
}
for _, case in ipairs(status_cases) do
	Test.Run("Git status parser: " .. case[1], function()
		local root = New_Root()
		local statuses = Git.Parse_Status(case[2], root)
		local expected_path = case[3] == "" and "" or (vim.fs and vim.fs.normalize and vim.fs.normalize(root .. "/" .. case[3]) or vim.fn.fnamemodify(root .. "/" .. case[3], ":p"))
		if case[4] then
			Test.Equal(case[4], statuses[expected_path], "Status code mismatch for " .. case[3])
		else
			Test.True(next(statuses) == nil, "Malformed or unsafe row should not be mapped")
		end
		Cleanup(root)
	end)
end

Test.Run("Git rejects missing root", function()
	local output, err = Git.Run(nil, { "status" })
	Test.Nil(output); Test.Type("string", err)
end)
Test.Run("Git rejects empty root", function()
	local output, err = Git.Run("", { "status" })
	Test.Nil(output); Test.Type("string", err)
end)
Test.Run("Git rejects empty argument list", function()
	local output, err = Git.Run("/tmp", {})
	Test.Nil(output); Test.Type("string", err)
end)
Test.Run("Git rejects non-table arguments", function()
	local output, err = Git.Run("/tmp", "status")
	Test.Nil(output); Test.Type("string", err)
end)
Test.Run("Git rejects non-string argument", function()
	local output, err = Git.Run("/tmp", { 12 })
	Test.Nil(output); Test.Type("string", err)
end)
Test.Run("Git reports a non-repository as unavailable", function()
	local root = New_Root()
	Test.False(Git.Is_Repository(root))
	local snapshot = Git.Snapshot(root)
	Test.False(snapshot.available); Test.Nil(snapshot.branch); Test.Equal(0, vim.tbl_count(snapshot.statuses))
	Cleanup(root)
end)

if not Has_Git() then
	print("[SKIP] Git executable tests: Git is not installed")
else
	local integration = {
		{ "initializes repository", function(root) local out, err = Git.Init(root); Test.Not_Nil(out, tostring(err)); Test.True(Git.Is_Repository(root)) end },
		{ "snapshot detects newly initialized repository", function(root) Git.Init(root); local s = Git.Snapshot(root); Test.True(s.available); Test.Type("string", s.branch); end },
		{ "branch is available before first commit", function(root) Git.Init(root); local branch = Git.Branch(root); Test.Type("string", branch); Test.True(branch ~= "") end },
		{ "status detects untracked file", function(root) Git.Init(root); Write(root .. "/untracked.c"); local s = Git.Snapshot(root); Test.Not_Nil(s.statuses[vim.fn.fnamemodify(root .. "/untracked.c", ":p")]) end },
		{ "status detects nested untracked file", function(root) Git.Init(root); Write(root .. "/src/main.c"); local s = Git.Snapshot(root); Test.Not_Nil(s.statuses[vim.fn.fnamemodify(root .. "/src/main.c", ":p")]) end },
		{ "stage all succeeds", function(root) Git.Init(root); Write(root .. "/a.c"); local out, err = Git.Add_All(root); Test.Not_Nil(out, tostring(err)); end },
		{ "stage all removes untracked state", function(root) Git.Init(root); Write(root .. "/a.c"); Git.Add_All(root); local s = Git.Snapshot(root); Test.Equal("A ", s.statuses[vim.fn.fnamemodify(root .. "/a.c", ":p")]) end },
		{ "empty commit message is rejected", function(root) Git.Init(root); local out, err = Git.Commit(root, " "); Test.Nil(out); Test.True(err:find("cannot be empty", 1, true) ~= nil) end },
		{ "commit with no staged files fails cleanly", function(root) Git.Init(root); local out = Git.Commit(root, "empty"); Test.Nil(out) end },
		{ "commit message is passed as one argument", function(root) Git.Init(root); vim.fn.systemlist({ "git", "-C", root, "config", "user.email", "tests@example.invalid" }); vim.fn.systemlist({ "git", "-C", root, "config", "user.name", "HyperMax Tests" }); Write(root .. "/a.c"); Git.Add_All(root); local out, err = Git.Commit(root, "message with spaces; punctuation!"); Test.Not_Nil(out, tostring(err)) end },
		{ "recent log handles no commits", function(root) Git.Init(root); local out = Git.Recent(root, 5); Test.Nil(out) end },
		{ "recent log shows committed change", function(root) Git.Init(root); vim.fn.systemlist({ "git", "-C", root, "config", "user.email", "tests@example.invalid" }); vim.fn.systemlist({ "git", "-C", root, "config", "user.name", "HyperMax Tests" }); Write(root .. "/a.c"); Git.Add_All(root); local out, err = Git.Commit(root, "first"); Test.Not_Nil(out, tostring(err)); local log = Git.Recent(root, 5); Test.Not_Nil(log); Test.True(table.concat(log, "\n"):find("first", 1, true) ~= nil) end },
		{ "detached HEAD is distinguished from unborn repository", function(root) Git.Init(root); vim.fn.systemlist({ "git", "-C", root, "config", "user.email", "tests@example.invalid" }); vim.fn.systemlist({ "git", "-C", root, "config", "user.name", "HyperMax Tests" }); Write(root .. "/a.c"); Git.Add_All(root); local out, err = Git.Commit(root, "first"); Test.Not_Nil(out, tostring(err)); local checkout = vim.fn.systemlist({ "git", "-C", root, "checkout", "--detach", "HEAD" }); Test.Equal(0, vim.v.shell_error, table.concat(checkout, "\n")); Test.True(Git.Branch(root):match("^detached@") ~= nil) end },
		{ "path with spaces is handled as argv", function(root) Git.Init(root); Write(root .. "/folder with spaces/file name.c"); local s = Git.Snapshot(root); Test.Not_Nil(s.statuses[vim.fs.normalize(root .. "/folder with spaces/file name.c")]) end },
		{ "repository path with shell punctuation is handled literally", function(root) local odd = root .. "/project ; $(literal)"; vim.fn.mkdir(odd, "p"); local out, err = Git.Init(odd); Test.Not_Nil(out, tostring(err)); Test.True(Git.Is_Repository(odd)) end },
		{ "commit message cannot execute shell substitutions", function(root) Git.Init(root); vim.fn.systemlist({ "git", "-C", root, "config", "user.email", "tests@example.invalid" }); vim.fn.systemlist({ "git", "-C", root, "config", "user.name", "HyperMax Tests" }); Write(root .. "/safe.c"); Git.Add_All(root); local marker = root .. "/should-not-exist"; local out, err = Git.Commit(root, "$(touch " .. marker .. ")"); Test.Not_Nil(out, tostring(err)); Test.Nil(uv.fs_lstat(marker)) end },
		{ "Git command failure returns an error", function(root) Git.Init(root); local out, err = Git.Run(root, { "not-a-real-git-subcommand" }); Test.Nil(out); Test.Type("string", err) end },
		{ "snapshot refreshes after creating a file", function(root) Git.Init(root); local first = Git.Snapshot(root); Test.Equal(0, vim.tbl_count(first.statuses)); Write(root .. "/later.c"); local second = Git.Snapshot(root); Test.Equal(1, vim.tbl_count(second.statuses)) end },
		{ "nested root path works", function(root) local nested = root .. "/deep project"; vim.fn.mkdir(nested, "p"); Git.Init(nested); Test.True(Git.Is_Repository(nested)) end },
		{ "finds parent repository root for nested project", function(root) Git.Init(root); local nested = root .. "/nested/project"; vim.fn.mkdir(nested, "p"); Test.Equal(vim.fs.normalize(root), Git.Repository_Root(nested)) end },
		{ "status paths remain absolute to parent repository", function(root) Git.Init(root); local nested = root .. "/nested/project"; Write(nested .. "/main.c"); local status = Git.Status(nested); Test.Not_Nil(status[vim.fs.normalize(nested .. "/main.c")]) end },
	}
	for _, case in ipairs(integration) do
		Test.Run("Git integration: " .. case[1], function()
			local root = New_Root()
			local ok, err = pcall(case[2], root)
			Cleanup(root)
			if not ok then error(err) end
		end)
	end
end

-- Count and contract checks for every public API; kept separate for precise failures.
local api = { "Run", "Repository_Root", "Is_Repository", "Branch", "Parse_Status", "Status", "Snapshot", "Init", "Add_All", "Commit", "Recent" }
for _, name in ipairs(api) do
	Test.Run("Git public API exists: " .. name, function() Test.Type("function", Git[name]) end)
end

for _, count in ipairs({ -5, 0, 1, 5, 100, 1000, "3", "not-number" }) do
	Test.Run("Git recent-log count is bounded: " .. tostring(count), function()
		-- Git.Recent clamps the count before constructing a command. A missing
		-- repository provides a stable failure result without depending on history.
		if Has_Git() then
			local root = New_Root(); local _, err = Git.Recent(root, count); Test.Type("string", err); Cleanup(root)
		else
			Test.True(true)
		end
	end)
end
","type":"file"},{"path":"tests/test_languages.lua","content_saved":true,"content":"local Test = require("tests.testlib")
local Languages = require("hypermax.languages")
local Managers = require("hypermax.managers")

local Version_Flags = {
	"--version",
	"-v",
	"-V",
}

local No_Version_Check = {
	html = true,
	sql = true,
	assembly = true,
	tcl = true,
}

local No_Manager_Version_Check = {
	tclsh = true,
}

local function Is_Executable(executable)
	return executable ~= nil and executable ~= "" and vim.fn.executable(executable) == 1
end

local function Get_Version(executable)
	for _, flag in ipairs(Version_Flags) do
		local output = vim.fn.systemlist({ executable, flag })
		local exit_code = vim.v.shell_error

		if exit_code == 0 and output and #output > 0 then
			return true, table.concat(output, "\n"), flag
		end
	end

	return false, nil, nil
end

local function First_Line(text)
	if not text then
		return ""
	end

	return text:match("([^\n]*)") or ""
end

-- =========================================================
-- INSTALLED LANGUAGE ENVIRONMENT
-- =========================================================

Test.Run("Environment: inspect registered language executables", function()
	local installed = 0
	local missing = 0
	local skipped = 0
	local version_failed = 0

	for _, id in ipairs(Languages.Get_IDs()) do
		local executable = Languages.Get_Executable(id)

		if No_Version_Check[id] then
			skipped = skipped + 1
			print("[NO VERSION CHECK] " .. id)
		elseif not executable or executable == "" then
			skipped = skipped + 1
			print("[UNCONFIGURED] " .. id .. " has no executable")
		elseif not Is_Executable(executable) then
			missing = missing + 1
			print("[MISSING] " .. id .. " -> " .. executable)
		else
			installed = installed + 1

			local ok, version, flag = Get_Version(executable)

			if ok then
				print("[INSTALLED] " .. id .. " -> " .. executable .. " [" .. flag .. "] " .. First_Line(version))
			else
				version_failed = version_failed + 1

				print("[VERSION FAILED] " .. id .. " -> " .. executable .. " (tried --version, -v, -V)")
			end
		end
	end

	print("")
	print("Language environment summary:")
	print("  Installed:       " .. installed)
	print("  Missing:         " .. missing)
	print("  Skipped:         " .. skipped)
	print("  Version failures:" .. version_failed)
end)

-- =========================================================
-- INSTALLED PROJECT MANAGER ENVIRONMENT
-- =========================================================

Test.Run("Environment: inspect registered manager executables", function()
	local seen = {}
	local installed = 0
	local missing = 0
	local skipped = 0
	local version_failed = 0

	for language_id, manager_entries in pairs(Managers.registry) do
		for manager_id, manager in pairs(manager_entries) do
			local executable = manager.executable

			if not executable or executable == "" then
				skipped = skipped + 1
			elseif seen[executable] then
				-- Test each unique executable only once.
			else
				seen[executable] = true

				if not Is_Executable(executable) then
					missing = missing + 1

					print(
						"[MISSING MANAGER] "
							.. manager_id
							.. " -> "
							.. executable
							.. " (language: "
							.. language_id
							.. ")"
					)
				elseif No_Manager_Version_Check[executable] then
					skipped = skipped + 1

					print("[NO VERSION CHECK] " .. executable .. " (manager)")
				else
					installed = installed + 1

					local ok, version, flag = Get_Version(executable)

					if ok then
						print(
							"[INSTALLED MANAGER] "
								.. manager_id
								.. " -> "
								.. executable
								.. " ["
								.. flag
								.. "] "
								.. First_Line(version)
						)
					else
						version_failed = version_failed + 1

						print("[MANAGER VERSION FAILED] " .. executable .. " (tried --version, -v, -V)")
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	print("")

","type":"file"},{"path":"tests/testlib.lua","content_saved":true,"content":"-- Tiny pure-Lua test runner for HyperMax.
-- No third-party test framework.

local Test = {
	passed = 0,
	failed = 0,
	total = 0,
	failures = {},
}

-- =========================================================
-- TERMINAL COLORS
-- =========================================================

local Colors = {
	Reset = "\27[0m",
	Red = "\27[31m",
	Green = "\27[32m",
	Yellow = "\27[33m",
	Blue = "\27[34m",
	Magenta = "\27[35m",
	Cyan = "\27[36m",
	Gray = "\27[90m",
}

-- =========================================================
-- STATUS COLORS
-- =========================================================

local Status_Colors = {
	["[PASS]"] = Colors.Green,
	["[FAIL]"] = Colors.Red,

	["[INSTALLED]"] = Colors.Green,
	["[MISSING]"] = Colors.Red,
	["[UNCONFIGURED]"] = Colors.Yellow,
	["[SKIPPED]"] = Colors.Yellow,

	["[NO VERSION CHECK]"] = Colors.Gray,
	["[VERSION FAILED]"] = Colors.Magenta,
	["[MANAGER VERSION FAILED]"] = Colors.Magenta,

	["[INSTALLED MANAGER]"] = Colors.Green,
	["[MISSING MANAGER]"] = Colors.Red,

	["[INFO]"] = Colors.Blue,
	["[WARNING]"] = Colors.Yellow,
	["[ERROR]"] = Colors.Red,
}

-- Longest tags first, so manager statuses are matched correctly.
local Status_Tags = {
	"[MANAGER VERSION FAILED]",
	"[INSTALLED MANAGER]",
	"[MISSING MANAGER]",
	"[NO VERSION CHECK]",
	"[VERSION FAILED]",
	"[UNCONFIGURED]",
	"[INSTALLED]",
	"[MISSING]",
	"[SKIPPED]",
	"[WARNING]",
	"[ERROR]",
	"[INFO]",
	"[PASS]",
	"[FAIL]",
}

-- =========================================================
-- OUTPUT HELPERS
-- =========================================================

local function Write_Line(message)
	io.stdout:write(tostring(message), "\n")
	io.stdout:flush()
end

local function Color_Status(message)
	for _, tag in ipairs(Status_Tags) do
		local color = Status_Colors[tag]

		if message:sub(1, #tag) == tag then
			return color .. tag .. Colors.Reset .. message:sub(#tag + 1)
		end
	end

	return message
end

-- Color status tags from all test files automatically.
-- Existing print("message") calls continue to work.
_G.print = function(...)
	local values = {}

	for i = 1, select("#", ...) do
		values[i] = tostring(select(i, ...))
	end

	local message = table.concat(values, "\t")
	Write_Line(Color_Status(message))
end

local function Value(value)
	if type(value) == "string" then
		return string.format("%q", value)
	end

	return tostring(value) .. " (" .. type(value) .. ")"
end

local function Print_Status(color, status, message)
	Write_Line(color .. "[" .. status .. "]" .. Colors.Reset .. " " .. message)
end

-- =========================================================
-- TEST RUNNER
-- =========================================================

function Test.Run(name, callback)
	Test.total = Test.total + 1

	local ok, err = xpcall(callback, debug.traceback)

	if ok then
		Test.passed = Test.passed + 1
		Print_Status(Colors.Green, "PASS", name)
		return true
	end

	Test.failed = Test.failed + 1

	Test.failures[#Test.failures + 1] = {
		name = name,
		error = tostring(err),
	}

	Print_Status(Colors.Red, "FAIL", name)

	Write_Line(Colors.Red .. "       " .. tostring(err):gsub("\n", "\n       ") .. Colors.Reset)

	return false
end

-- =========================================================
-- ASSERTIONS
-- =========================================================

function Test.Equal(expected, actual, message)
	if expected ~= actual then
		error(
			(message or "Values are not equal")
				.. "\n  expected: "
				.. Value(expected)
				.. "\n  actual:   "
				.. Value(actual),
			2
		)
	end
end

function Test.Not_Equal(expected, actual, message)
	if expected == actual then
		error(message or ("Expected values to differ, both were " .. Value(actual)), 2)
	end
end

function Test.True(value, message)
	if value ~= true then
		error((message or "Expected true") .. "; got " .. Value(value), 2)
	end
end

function Test.False(value, message)
	if value ~= false then
		error((message or "Expected false") .. "; got " .. Value(value), 2)
	end
end

function Test.Nil(value, message)
	if value ~= nil then
		error((message or "Expected nil") .. "; got " .. Value(value), 2)
	end
end

function Test.Not_Nil(value, message)
	if value == nil then
		error(message or "Expected a non-nil value", 2)
	end
end

function Test.Type(expected_type, value, message)
	if type(value) ~= expected_type then
		error((message or "Unexpected type") .. "; expected " .. expected_type .. ", got " .. type(value), 2)
	end
end

function Test.Error(callback, message)
	local ok, err = pcall(callback)

	if ok then
		error(message or "Expected function to raise an error", 2)
	end

	return err
end

-- =========================================================
-- TEST SUMMARY
-- =========================================================

function Test.Finish()
	Write_Line("")

	Write_Line(Colors.Cyan .. "============= HYPERMAX TEST RESULTS =============" .. Colors.Reset)

	Write_Line(Colors.Green .. "Passed: " .. Test.passed .. Colors.Reset)

	Write_Line((Test.failed > 0 and Colors.Red or Colors.Green) .. "Failed: " .. Test.failed .. Colors.Reset)

	Write_Line(Colors.Cyan .. "Total:  " .. Test.total .. Colors.Reset)

	Write_Line(Colors.Cyan .. "=================================================" .. Colors.Reset)

	if Test.failed > 0 then
		Write_Line(Colors.Red .. "Failures:" .. Colors.Reset)

		for _, failure in ipairs(Test.failures) do
			Write_Line(Colors.Red .. "- " .. failure.name .. ": " .. failure.error .. Colors.Reset)
		end

		return false
	end

	Write_Line(Colors.Green .. "All tests passed!" .. Colors.Reset)

	return true
end

return Test
