local function Apply_Highlights(lines, items, line_by_path)
	local buf = State.buffer
	vim.api.nvim_buf_clear_namespace(buf, Highlight_Namespace, 0, -1)

	for line_number, line in ipairs(lines) do
		local zero_line = line_number - 1

		if line:find("HYPERMAX", 1, true) then
			vim.api.nvim_buf_add_highlight(buf, Highlight_Namespace, "HyperMaxHeader", zero_line, 0, -1)
		elseif line:find("PROJECT EXPLORER", 1, true) then
			vim.api.nvim_buf_add_highlight(buf, Highlight_Namespace, "HyperMaxSubtitle", zero_line, 0, -1)
		elseif line:match("^  [%u%d ]+$") and line:match("%u") then
			vim.api.nvim_buf_add_highlight(buf, Highlight_Namespace, "HyperMaxSection", zero_line, 0, -1)
		elseif line:match("^  ─") or line:match("^  ═") then
			vim.api.nvim_buf_add_highlight(buf, Highlight_Namespace, "HyperMaxMuted", zero_line, 0, -1)
		end

		local item = items[line_number]
		if item then
			local group = item.path == State.entry_path and "HyperMaxEntry"
				or (item.type == "directory" and "HyperMaxDirectory" or "HyperMaxFile")
			vim.api.nvim_buf_add_highlight(buf, Highlight_Namespace, group, zero_line, 0, -1)
		end

		if line:match("^  [qrf] ") or line:match("^  Enter") then
			vim.api.nvim_buf_add_highlight(buf, Highlight_Namespace, "HyperMaxKey", zero_line, 0, -1)
		end
	end
end

local function Render()
	if not State.buffer or not vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(State.buffer) then
		return
	end

	local root = State.root
	local metadata = State.metadata
	local lines, items, line_by_path = {}, {}, {}

	local function Add(text)
		lines[#lines + 1] = text
	end

	Add("  ◆ HYPERMAX")
	Add("  PROJECT EXPLORER")
	Add("  ════════════════════════════════")
	Add("")
	Add("  " .. metadata.name)
	Add("  " .. metadata.language .. "  ·  " .. metadata.manager)
	Add("")

	Add("  ENTRY POINT")
	Add("  ────────────────────────────────")
	if metadata.entry_file ~= "" then
		Add("  ▶ " .. metadata.entry_file)
		Add("  ƒ " .. metadata.entry_function .. "()")
	else
		Add("  Not configured")
		Add("  Set project.entry_point in basics.json")
	end
	Add("")

	Add("  FILES  ·  " .. SORT_MODES[State.sort_mode])
	Add("  ────────────────────────────────────")

	if #State.tree == 0 then
		Add("  (empty project)")
	else
		Render_Tree(State.tree, 0, lines, items, line_by_path)
	end

	Add("")
	Add("  PROJECT")
	Add("  ────────────────────────────────")
	Add("  Created  " .. Format_Date(metadata.created_at))
	Add("  Git      " .. (State.git.available and ("branch " .. (State.git.branch or "?")) or "not initialized"))
	Add("  Changes  " .. tostring(vim.tbl_count(State.git.statuses)) .. " files")
	Add("  Root")
	Add("  " .. root)
	Add("")
	Add("  KEYS")
	Add("  ────────────────────────────────")
	Add("  Enter  Open / toggle folder")
	Add("  a      New file   A  New folder")
	Add("  R      Rename / move selected item")
	Add("  x      Cut item   p  Paste into folder")
	Add("  d      Delete item (confirmation)")
	Add("  s      Cycle sort order")
	Add("  g      Git menu    G  Init Git")
	Add("  m      Workspace  t  Task board  w  Run configurations")
	Add("  f      Find files  /  Search text")
	Add("  ? + -  Git markers: modified/untracked/added")
	Add("  r      Refresh   q  Close panel")

	local cursor_line = 1
	if State.window and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(State.window) then
		cursor_line = vim.api.nvim_win_get_cursor(State.window)[1]
	end

	vim.bo[State.buffer].modifiable = true
	vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(State.buffer, 0, -1, false, lines)
	vim.bo[State.buffer].modifiable = false
	vim.bo[State.buffer].modified = false

	State.items = items
	State.line_by_path = line_by_path
	Apply_Highlights(lines, items, line_by_path)

	if State.window and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(State.window) then
		vim.api.nvim_win_set_cursor(State.window, {
			math.min(cursor_line, #lines),
			0,
		})
	end
end

local function Get_Selected_Item()
	if not State.window or not vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(State.window) then
		return nil
	end

	local line = vim.api.nvim_win_get_cursor(State.window)[1]
	return State.items and State.items[line]
end

local function Get_Editor_Window()
	for _, win in ipairs(vim.api.nvim_tabpage_list_wins(0)) do
		if win ~= State.window and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(win) then
			return win
		end
	end

	-- If the panel is the only window, create an editor window to its right.
	if State.window and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(State.window) then
		vim.api.nvim_set_current_win(State.window)
		vim.cmd("rightbelow vsplit")
		return vim.api.nvim_get_current_win()
	end

	return vim.api.nvim_get_current_win()
end

local function Open_Selected()
	local entry = Get_Selected_Item()
	if not entry then
		return
	end

	if entry.type == "directory" then
		State.expanded[entry.path] = not State.expanded[entry.path]
		Render()

		local new_line = State.line_by_path[entry.path]
		if new_line and State.window and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(State.window) then
			vim.api.nvim_win_set_cursor(State.window, { new_line, 0 })
		end
		return
	end

	if not Is_File(entry.path) then
		Notify("File no longer exists: " .. entry.path, vim.log.levels.WARN)
		return
	end

	-- Open the selected file in the editor window, never in the panel.
	local editor_window = Get_Editor_Window()
	vim.api.nvim_set_current_win(editor_window)
	vim.cmd("edit " .. vim.fn.fnameescape(entry.path))
end

local function Refresh()
	local metadata, err = Get_Project_Metadata(State.root)
	if not metadata then
		Notify(tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return
	end

	State.metadata = metadata
	State.entry_path = metadata.entry_file ~= "" and Join(State.root, metadata.entry_file) or nil
	Refresh_Git()
	State.tree = Build_Tree(State.root, 0, { count = 0 })
	Render()
end

-- Refresh the sidebar after terminal-driven Git actions finish. Register this
-- before launching any terminal command so fast exits cannot race the handler.
local Git_Terminal_Augroup = vim.api.nvim_create_augroup("HyperMaxDashboardGitRefresh", { clear = true })
vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd("TermClose", {
	group = Git_Terminal_Augroup,
	callback = function()
		vim.schedule(function()
			if State.root and State.root ~= "" then Refresh() end
		end)
	end,
})

local function Reveal_Created_Path(kind, path)
	local root = Normalize_Path(State.root)
	local cursor = kind == "folder" and Normalize_Path(path) or Normalize_Path(vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":h"))
	while cursor and cursor ~= root and Filesystem.Is_Within(root, cursor) do
		State.expanded[cursor] = true
		local parent = Normalize_Path(vim.fn.fnamemodify(cursor, ":h"))
		if not parent or parent == cursor then break end
		cursor = parent
	end
	Refresh()
	local line = State.line_by_path[Normalize_Path(path)]
	if line and State.window and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(State.window) then
		vim.api.nvim_win_set_cursor(State.window, { line, 0 })
	end
end

local function Cycle_Sort()
	State.sort_mode = (State.sort_mode % #SORT_MODES) + 1
	Refresh()
	Notify("Sorting by " .. SORT_MODES[State.sort_mode])
end

local function Create_Item(kind)
	local label = kind == "file" and "New file path (relative to project):" or "New folder path (relative to project):"
	local input_ok, input_error = pcall(vim.ui.input, { prompt = label }, function(input)
		local call_ok, created, path_or_error, detail = pcall(Filesystem.Create, State.root, kind, input)
		if not call_ok then
			Notify("Could not create " .. kind .. ": " .. tostring(created), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
			return
		end
		if not created then
			local failure = path_or_error or detail
			if failure and failure ~= "cancelled" then
				Notify(tostring(failure), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
			end
			return
		end
		local created_path = path_or_error
		Reveal_Created_Path(kind, created_path)
		Notify((kind == "file" and "Created file: " or "Created folder: ") .. tostring(input))
	end)
	if not input_ok then
		Notify("Could not open input prompt: " .. tostring(input_error), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
	end
end

local function Relative_Path(path)
	local root = Normalize_Path(State.root)
	local full = Normalize_Path(path)
	if not root or not full or not Filesystem.Is_Within(root, full) then return nil end
	return full:sub(#root + 2)
end

local function Rename_Selected()
	local entry = Get_Selected_Item()
	if not entry then Notify("Select a file or folder first", vim.log.levels.WARN); return end
	local old_relative = Relative_Path(entry.path)
	if not old_relative then Notify("Selected path is outside the project", vim.log.levels.ERROR); return end
	vim.ui.input({ prompt = "Rename / move to project-relative path:", default = old_relative }, function(input)
		if not input or vim.trim(input) == "" then return end
		local ok, destination, err = Filesystem.Move(State.root, old_relative, input)
		if not ok then Notify("Rename/move failed: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR); return end
		if entry.type == "directory" then State.expanded[entry.path] = nil; State.expanded[destination] = true end
		Reveal_Created_Path(entry.type == "directory" and "folder" or "file", destination)
		Notify("Moved to " .. tostring(input))
	end)
end

local function Cut_Selected()
	local entry = Get_Selected_Item()
	if not entry then Notify("Select a file or folder first", vim.log.levels.WARN); return end
	local relative = Relative_Path(entry.path)
	if not relative then Notify("Selected path is outside the project", vim.log.levels.ERROR); return end
	State.cut_path = relative
	Notify("Cut: " .. relative .. " — navigate to a destination and press p")
end

local function Paste_Cut()
	if not State.cut_path then Notify("Nothing has been cut", vim.log.levels.WARN); return end
	local source = State.cut_path
	local name = source:match("([^/]+)$")
	vim.ui.input({ prompt = "Destination folder (relative; empty = project root):", default = "" }, function(input)
		if input == nil then return end
		input = vim.trim(input)
		local destination_directory = State.root
		if input ~= "" then
			local full, path_error = Filesystem.Safe_Child(State.root, input)
			if not full then Notify(tostring(path_error), vim.log.levels.ERROR); return end
			local stat = uv.fs_stat(full)
			if not stat or stat.type ~= "directory" then Notify("Destination is not an existing folder: " .. input, vim.log.levels.ERROR); return end
			destination_directory = full
		end
		local target = destination_directory == State.root and name or (input .. "/" .. name)
		local ok, destination, err = Filesystem.Move(State.root, source, target)
		if not ok then Notify("Paste failed: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR); return end
		State.cut_path = nil
		Reveal_Created_Path(Is_Directory(destination) and "folder" or "file", destination)
		Notify("Moved to " .. target)
	end)
end

local function Delete_Selected()
	local entry = Get_Selected_Item()
	if not entry then Notify("Select a file or folder first", vim.log.levels.WARN); return end
	local relative = Relative_Path(entry.path)
	if not relative then Notify("Selected path is outside the project", vim.log.levels.ERROR); return end
	vim.ui.select({ "Delete permanently", "Cancel" }, { prompt = "Delete " .. relative .. "?" }, function(choice)
		if choice ~= "Delete permanently" then return end
		local ok, err = Filesystem.Delete(State.root, relative)
		if not ok then Notify("Delete failed: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR); return end
		if State.cut_path == relative or (State.cut_path and State.cut_path:sub(1, #relative + 1) == relative .. "/") then State.cut_path = nil end
		State.expanded[entry.path] = nil
		Refresh()
		Notify("Deleted " .. relative)
	end)
end

local Initialize_Git

local function Run_Git_Terminal(action)
	local editor_window = Get_Editor_Window()
	vim.api.nvim_set_current_win(editor_window)
	vim.cmd("botright 12split")
	vim.cmd("terminal git -C " .. vim.fn.shellescape(State.root) .. " " .. action)
end

local function Show_Git_Output(title, lines)
	local buffer = vim.api.nvim_create_buf(false, true)
	vim.api.nvim_buf_set_name(buffer, "HyperMaxGit://" .. title .. "-" .. tostring(buffer))
	vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(buffer, 0, -1, false, (#lines > 0 and lines or { "(no output)" }))
	vim.bo[buffer].buftype = "nofile"
	vim.bo[buffer].bufhidden = "wipe"
	vim.bo[buffer].swapfile = false
	vim.bo[buffer].modifiable = false
	vim.cmd("botright 12split")
	vim.api.nvim_win_set_buf(0, buffer)
	vim.api.nvim_win_set_option(0, "wrap", false)
end

local function Report_Git_Result(label, output, err)
	if not output then
		Notify(label .. " failed: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return false
	end
	Notify(label .. " completed")
	Refresh()
	return true
end

local function Select_Git_Entry(items, prompt, callback)
	if not items or #items == 0 then
		Notify("No " .. prompt:lower() .. " found")
		return
	end
	vim.ui.select(items, { prompt = prompt }, callback)
end

local function Show_Branch_Menu()
	vim.ui.select({ "Switch branch", "Create branch", "Delete local branch", "List local and remote branches", "Cancel" }, {
		prompt = "Git branches",
	}, function(action)
		if not action or action == "Cancel" then return end
		if action == "Create branch" then
			vim.ui.input({ prompt = "New branch name: " }, function(name)
				if not name or vim.trim(name) == "" then return end
				local output, err = Git.Create_Branch(State.root, vim.trim(name))
				Report_Git_Result("Create branch", output, err)
			end)
		elseif action == "List local and remote branches" then
			local items, err = Git.Branches(State.root, true)
			if not items then Notify("Could not list branches: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR); return end
			Show_Git_Output("Branches", items)
		elseif action == "Switch branch" or action == "Delete local branch" then
			local items, err = Git.Branches(State.root, false)
			if not items then Notify("Could not list branches: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR); return end
			Select_Git_Entry(items, action == "Switch branch" and "Switch to branch" or "Delete branch", function(branch)
				if not branch then return end
				if action == "Switch branch" then
					local output, switch_error = Git.Switch_Branch(State.root, branch)
					Report_Git_Result("Switch branch", output, switch_error)
				else
					vim.ui.select({ "Delete branch", "Cancel" }, { prompt = "Delete local branch '" .. branch .. "'?" }, function(confirm)
						if confirm ~= "Delete branch" then return end
						local output, delete_error = Git.Delete_Branch(State.root, branch, false)
						Report_Git_Result("Delete branch", output, delete_error)
					end)
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
end

local function Show_Remote_Menu()
	local actions = { "List remote URLs", "Add remote", "Remove remote", "Open remote details in terminal", "Cancel" }
	vim.ui.select(actions, { prompt = "Git remotes" }, function(action)
		if not action or action == "Cancel" then return end
		if action == "List remote URLs" then
			local output, err = Git.Remote_Details(State.root)
			if not output then Notify("Could not list remotes: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR) else Show_Git_Output("Remotes", output) end
		elseif action == "Open remote details in terminal" then
			Run_Git_Terminal("remote -v")
		elseif action == "Add remote" then
			vim.ui.input({ prompt = "Remote name (for example origin): " }, function(name)
				if not name or vim.trim(name) == "" then return end
				vim.ui.input({ prompt = "Remote URL: " }, function(url)
					if not url or vim.trim(url) == "" then return end
					local output, err = Git.Add_Remote(State.root, vim.trim(name), vim.trim(url))
					Report_Git_Result("Add remote", output, err)
				end)
			end)
		elseif action == "Remove remote" then
			local remotes, err = Git.Remotes(State.root)
			if not remotes then Notify("Could not list remotes: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR); return end
			Select_Git_Entry(remotes, "Remove remote", function(name)
				if not name then return end
				vim.ui.select({ "Remove remote", "Cancel" }, { prompt = "Remove remote '" .. name .. "'?" }, function(confirm)
					if confirm ~= "Remove remote" then return end
					local output, remove_error = Git.Remove_Remote(State.root, name)
					Report_Git_Result("Remove remote", output, remove_error)
				end)
			end)
		end
	end)
end

local function Show_Stash_Menu()
	vim.ui.select({ "Create stash", "Apply stash", "Pop stash", "List stashes", "Cancel" }, {
		prompt = "Git stash",
	}, function(action)
		if not action or action == "Cancel" then return end
		if action == "Create stash" then
			vim.ui.input({ prompt = "Stash message (optional): " }, function(message)
				local output, err = Git.Stash(State.root, message or "")
				Report_Git_Result("Create stash", output, err)
			end)
		else
			local stashes, err = Git.Stashes(State.root)
			if not stashes then Notify("Could not list stashes: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR); return end
			if action == "List stashes" then Show_Git_Output("Stashes", stashes); return end
			Select_Git_Entry(stashes, action, function(stash)
				if not stash then return end
				local reference = stash:match("^(%S+)")
				local output, stash_error
				if action == "Apply stash" then output, stash_error = Git.Stash_Apply(State.root, reference)
				else output, stash_error = Git.Stash_Pop(State.root, reference) end
				Report_Git_Result(action, output, stash_error)
			end)
		end
	end)
end

local function Show_Tag_Menu()
	vim.ui.select({ "View tag", "Create tag", "Delete tag", "List tags", "Cancel" }, { prompt = "Git tags" }, function(action)
		if not action or action == "Cancel" then return end
		local tags, err = Git.Tags(State.root)
		if not tags then Notify("Could not list tags: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR); return end
		if action == "List tags" then Show_Git_Output("Tags", tags); return end
		if action == "Create tag" then
			vim.ui.input({ prompt = "New tag name: " }, function(tag)
				if not tag or vim.trim(tag) == "" then return end
				vim.ui.input({ prompt = "Annotation message (leave empty for lightweight tag): " }, function(message)
					local output, tag_error = Git.Create_Tag(State.root, vim.trim(tag), message or "")
					Report_Git_Result("Create tag", output, tag_error)
				end)
			end)
			return
		end
		Select_Git_Entry(tags, action == "Delete tag" and "Delete tag" or "View tag", function(tag)
			if not tag then return end
			if action == "Delete tag" then
				vim.ui.select({ "Delete tag", "Cancel" }, { prompt = "Delete tag '" .. tag .. "'?" }, function(confirm)
					if confirm ~= "Delete tag" then return end
					local output, delete_error = Git.Delete_Tag(State.root, tag)
					Report_Git_Result("Delete tag", output, delete_error)
				end)
			else
				local output, show_error = Git.Run(State.root, { "--no-pager", "show", "--stat", "--no-renames", tag })
				if not output then Notify("Could not show tag: " .. tostring(show_error), vim.log.levels.ERROR) else Show_Git_Output("Tag " .. tag, output) end
			end
		end)
	end)
end

local function Show_Git_Menu()
	Refresh_Git()
	local choices = State.git.available and {
		"Status", "Stage all changes", "Stage selected file", "Unstage selected file",
		"Commit staged changes", "Fetch", "Pull", "Push", "Branches", "Remotes",
		"Tags", "Stash", "Diff summary", "Recent commits", "Initialize repository",
	} or { "Initialize repository", "Cancel" }

	vim.ui.select(choices, { prompt = "HyperMax Git" }, function(choice)
		if not choice or choice == "Cancel" then return end
		if choice == "Initialize repository" then
			Initialize_Git()
		elseif choice == "Status" then
			local lines, err = Git_Command({ "status", "--short", "--branch" })
			if lines then Show_Git_Output("Status", lines) else Notify("Git status failed: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR) end
		elseif choice == "Stage all changes" then
			local output, err = Git.Add_All(State.root)
			Report_Git_Result("Stage all changes", output, err)
		elseif choice == "Stage selected file" or choice == "Unstage selected file" then
			local selected = Get_Selected_Item()
			if not selected then Notify("Select a file in the dashboard first", vim.log.levels.WARN); return end
			local relative = Relative_Path(selected.path)
			if not relative then Notify("Selected path is outside the project", vim.log.levels.ERROR); return end
			local output, err
			if choice == "Stage selected file" then output, err = Git.Stage(State.root, relative)
			else output, err = Git.Unstage(State.root, relative) end
			Report_Git_Result(choice, output, err)
		elseif choice == "Commit staged changes" then
			vim.ui.input({ prompt = "Commit message: " }, function(message)
				if not message or vim.trim(message) == "" then return end
				local output, err = Git.Commit(State.root, message)
				Report_Git_Result("Commit", output, err)
			end)
		elseif choice == "Fetch" then Run_Git_Terminal("fetch --all --prune")
		elseif choice == "Pull" then Run_Git_Terminal("pull")
		elseif choice == "Push" then Run_Git_Terminal("push")
		elseif choice == "Branches" then Show_Branch_Menu()
		elseif choice == "Remotes" then Show_Remote_Menu()
		elseif choice == "Tags" then Show_Tag_Menu()
		elseif choice == "Stash" then Show_Stash_Menu()
		elseif choice == "Diff summary" then
			local unstaged, err = Git.Diff(State.root, false)
			if not unstaged then Notify("Git diff failed: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR); return end
			local staged, staged_err = Git.Diff(State.root, true)
			if not staged then Notify("Git staged diff failed: " .. tostring(staged_err), vim.log.levels.ERROR); return end
			local lines = { "Unstaged changes:", "" }
			vim.list_extend(lines, unstaged)
			vim.list_extend(lines, { "", "Staged changes:", "" })
			vim.list_extend(lines, staged)
			Show_Git_Output("Diff summary", lines)
		elseif choice == "Recent commits" then
			local lines, err = Git.Log(State.root, 20)
			if lines then Show_Git_Output("Recent commits", lines) else Notify("Git log failed: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR) end
		end
	end)
end

Initialize_Git = function()
	if State.git.available then
		Notify("Git is already initialized on branch " .. (State.git.branch or "?"))
		return true
	end
	local output, err = Git_Command({ "init" })
	if not output then
		Notify("Git init failed: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return false, err
	end
	Refresh()
	Notify("Initialized Git repository")
	return true
end

local function Close_Panel()
	if State.window and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(State.window) then
		local panel = State.window
		State.window = nil
		pcall(vim.api.nvim_win_close, panel, true)
	end
end

local function Set_Keymaps(buf)
	local function Map(key, callback, description)
		vim.keymap.set("n", key, callback, {
			buffer = buf,
			silent = true,
			noremap = true,
			desc = description,
		})
	end

	Map("<CR>", Open_Selected, "HyperMax: open file or toggle folder")

function Dashboard.Is_Project(root)
	root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(root or vim.fn.getcwd(), ":p")
	return Is_Directory(Join(root, ".hmc"))
end

function Dashboard.Find_Project_Root(path)
	path = vim.fn.fnamemodify(vim.fn.expand(path or vim.fn.getcwd()), ":p")

	if Is_File(path) then
		path = vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":h")
	end

	while path and path ~= "" do
		if Dashboard.Is_Project(path) then
			return path
		end

		local parent = vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":h")
		if parent == path then
			break
		end
		path = parent
	end

	return nil
end

function Dashboard.Open(project_root)
	project_root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(vim.fn.expand(project_root or vim.fn.getcwd()), ":p")

	if not Dashboard.Is_Project(project_root) then
		Notify("Not a HyperMax project: " .. project_root, vim.log.levels.WARN)
		return false
	end

	local metadata, err = Get_Project_Metadata(project_root)
	if not metadata then
		Notify("Could not load project metadata: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return false
	end

	local registered, register_error = Project_Config.Mark_Project_Opened(project_root)
	if not registered then
		Notify("Project opened, but recent-project history could not be updated: " .. tostring(register_error), vim.log.levels.WARN)
	end

	Define_Highlights()

	local existing_window = State.window and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(State.window)
	if Normalize_Path(State.root or "") ~= Normalize_Path(project_root) then
		State.cut_path = nil
	end

	State.root = project_root
	State.metadata = metadata
	State.entry_path = metadata.entry_file ~= "" and Join(project_root, metadata.entry_file) or nil
	State.expanded = {}
	State.sort_mode = State.sort_mode or 1
	Refresh_Git()
	State.tree = Build_Tree(project_root, 0, { count = 0 })

	local buf = State.buffer
	if not buf or not vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(buf) then
		buf = vim.api.nvim_create_buf(false, true)
		State.buffer = buf
		vim.bo[buf].buftype = "nofile"
		vim.bo[buf].bufhidden = "hide"
		vim.bo[buf].swapfile = false
		vim.bo[buf].filetype = "hypermaxdashboard"
		pcall(vim.api.nvim_buf_set_name, buf, "HyperMax://" .. metadata.name)
	end

	if existing_window then
		-- Reuse the panel window if its buffer was deleted or changed.
		vim.api.nvim_set_current_win(State.window)
		vim.api.nvim_win_set_buf(State.window, buf)
	else
		-- Create a real left sidebar. The original editor remains to its right.
		vim.cmd("topleft " .. PANEL_WIDTH .. "vsplit")
		State.window = vim.api.nvim_get_current_win()
		vim.api.nvim_win_set_buf(State.window, buf)
	end

	pcall(vim.api.nvim_buf_set_name, buf, "HyperMax://" .. metadata.name)
	Configure_Panel_Window(State.window)
	Set_Keymaps(buf)
	Render()
	return true
end

function Dashboard.Open_Current_Project()
	return Dashboard.Open(vim.fn.getcwd())
end

function Dashboard.Convert_Folder(root)
	root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(vim.fn.expand(root or vim.fn.getcwd()), ":p")
	local ok, result = Project_Config.Convert_Folder(root, { name = vim.fs.basename(root) })
	if not ok then return false, result end
	State.cut_path = nil
	Dashboard.Open(root)
	return true, result
end

function Dashboard.Undo_Conversion(root)
	root = Dashboard.Find_Project_Root(root or vim.fn.getcwd()) or vim.fn.fnamemodify(root or vim.fn.getcwd(), ":p")
	local ok, result = Project_Config.Undo_Conversion(root)
	if ok and State.root == root then Close_Panel() end
	return ok, result
end

function Dashboard.Scrape(root)
	root = Dashboard.Find_Project_Root(root or vim.fn.getcwd()) or vim.fn.fnamemodify(root or vim.fn.getcwd(), ":p")
	local ok, result = Project_Config.Scrape(root)
	if ok and State.root == root then Close_Panel() end
	return ok, result
end

function Dashboard.Refresh()
	Refresh()
end

function Dashboard.Create(kind, input)
	local ok, path, err = Filesystem.Create(State.root, kind, input)
	if ok then Reveal_Created_Path(kind, path) end
	return ok, path, err
end

function Dashboard.Initialize_Git()
	return Initialize_Git()
end

function Dashboard.Cycle_Sort()
	Cycle_Sort()
	return SORT_MODES[State.sort_mode]
end

function Dashboard.Close()
	Close_Panel()
end

function Dashboard.Get_State()
	return State
end

return Dashboard

-- Safe project-relative filesystem operations for HyperMax.
local Filesystem = {}
local uv = vim.uv or vim.loop

local function Normalize(path)
	if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" then return nil end
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		if vim.fs and vim.fs.normalize then return vim.fs.normalize(path) end
		return vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":p")
	end)
	if not ok or type(result) ~= "string" then return nil end
	if result:sub(1, 1) ~= "/" then
		local absolute_ok, absolute = pcall(vim.fn.fnamemodify, result, ":p")
		if not absolute_ok or type(absolute) ~= "string" then return nil end
		result = absolute
	end
	if result ~= "/" then result = result:gsub("/+$", "") end
	return result
end

local function Is_Within(root, path)
	root, path = Normalize(root), Normalize(path)
	if not root or not path or path == root then return false end
	if root == "/" then return path:sub(1, 1) == "/" end
	return path:sub(1, #root + 1) == root .. "/"
end

local function Realpath(path)
	if uv.fs_realpath then
		local ok, result = pcall(uv.fs_realpath, path)
		if ok and result then return Normalize(result) end
	end
	return Normalize(path)
end

local function Has_Unsafe_Ancestor(root_path, root_real, path)
	local cursor = Normalize(vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":h"))
	while cursor do
		local stat = uv.fs_lstat(cursor)
		if stat then
			local real = Realpath(cursor)
			if real and real ~= root_real and not Is_Within(root_real, real) then
				return true, "Path crosses a symbolic link outside the project"
			end
			if cursor == root_path then break end
		end
		if cursor == root_path then break end
		local parent = Normalize(vim.fn.fnamemodify(cursor, ":h"))
		if not parent or parent == cursor then break end
		cursor = parent
	end
	return false
end

function Filesystem.Normalize(path)
	return Normalize(path)
end

function Filesystem.Is_Within(root, path)
	return Is_Within(root, path)
end

function Filesystem.Safe_Child(root, input)
	if type(root) ~= "string" or root == "" then return nil, "Project root is not set" end
	if type(input) ~= "string" then return nil, "Path must be text" end
	input = vim.trim(input):gsub("\\", "/")
	if input == "" then return nil, "Enter a non-empty relative path" end
	if input:find("%z") or input:find("[%c]") then return nil, "Path contains an invalid control character" end
	if input:sub(1, 1) == "/" or input:match("^%a:") or input:sub(1, 1) == "~" then
		return nil, "Enter a relative path inside the project"
	end
	for part in input:gmatch("[^/]+") do
		if part == "." or part == ".." then
			return nil, "Relative paths cannot contain . or .."
		end
	end
	local root_path = Normalize(root)
	if not root_path then return nil, "Project root is not a valid path" end
	local full_path = Normalize(root_path .. "/" .. input)
	if not full_path or not Is_Within(root_path, full_path) then
		return nil, "Path must stay inside the project"
	end
	local root_real = Realpath(root_path)
	local real_root = root_real or root_path
	local unsafe, reason = Has_Unsafe_Ancestor(root_path, real_root, full_path)
	if unsafe then return nil, reason end
	local existing = uv.fs_lstat(full_path)
	if existing and existing.type == "link" then
		local target = Realpath(full_path)
		if target and target ~= real_root and not Is_Within(real_root, target) then
			return nil, "Target symbolic link points outside the project"
		end
	end
	return full_path
end

local function Ensure_Directory(path)
	local stat = uv.fs_stat(path)
	if stat then
		if stat.type == "directory" then return true end
		return false, "A non-directory already exists in the path: " .. path
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(vim.fn.mkdir, path, "p")
	if not ok then return false, tostring(err) end
	stat = uv.fs_stat(path)
	if not stat or stat.type ~= "directory" then
		return false, "Could not create directory: " .. path
	end
	return true
end

function Filesystem.Create(root, kind, input)
	if input == nil or (type(input) == "string" and vim.trim(input) == "") then
		return false, nil, "cancelled"
	end
	if kind ~= "file" and kind ~= "folder" then
		return false, nil, "Unknown item type: " .. tostring(kind)
	end
	local path, path_error = Filesystem.Safe_Child(root, input)
	if not path then return false, nil, path_error end
	if uv.fs_lstat(path) then return false, nil, "Already exists: " .. tostring(input) end

	local root_path = Normalize(root)
	local parent = Normalize(vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":h"))
	if parent ~= root_path then
		local parent_ok, parent_error = Ensure_Directory(parent)
		if not parent_ok then return false, nil, parent_error end
	end

	if kind == "folder" then
		local ok, err = pcall(vim.fn.mkdir, path, "p")
		if not ok then return false, nil, "Could not create folder: " .. tostring(err) end
		local stat = uv.fs_stat(path)
		if not stat or stat.type ~= "directory" then
			return false, nil, "Could not create folder: " .. tostring(input)
		end
	else
		local fd, open_error = uv.fs_open(path, "wx", 420)
		if not fd then return false, nil, "Could not create file: " .. tostring(open_error) end
		local close_ok, close_error = uv.fs_close(fd)
		if close_ok == nil or close_ok == false then
			pcall(uv.fs_unlink, path)
			return false, nil, "Could not close new file: " .. tostring(close_error)
		end
	end
	return true, path
end


local function Is_Protected_Relative(relative)
	for part in relative:gsub("\\", "/"):gmatch("[^/]+") do
		if part == ".hmc" or part == ".git" then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function Relative_Path(root, full)
	local normalized_root, normalized_full = Normalize(root), Normalize(full)
	if not normalized_root or not normalized_full or not Is_Within(normalized_root, normalized_full) then return nil end
	return normalized_full:sub(#normalized_root + 2)
end

function Filesystem.Move(root, source_input, destination_input)
	if type(root) ~= "string" or root == "" then return false, nil, "Project root is not set" end
	if type(source_input) ~= "string" or vim.trim(source_input) == "" then return false, nil, "Source path is required" end
	if type(destination_input) ~= "string" or vim.trim(destination_input) == "" then return false, nil, "Destination path is required" end
	local source, source_error = Filesystem.Safe_Child(root, source_input)
	if not source then return false, nil, source_error end
	local destination, destination_error = Filesystem.Safe_Child(root, destination_input)
	if not destination then return false, nil, destination_error end
	local source_relative = Relative_Path(root, source)
	local destination_relative = Relative_Path(root, destination)
	if not source_relative or not destination_relative then return false, nil, "Paths must remain inside the project" end
	if Is_Protected_Relative(source_relative) or Is_Protected_Relative(destination_relative) then
		return false, nil, "Git and HyperMax metadata paths cannot be moved from the dashboard"
	end
	local source_stat = uv.fs_lstat(source)
	if not source_stat then return false, nil, "Source does not exist: " .. source_input end
	if source == destination then return false, nil, "Source and destination are the same path" end
	if uv.fs_lstat(destination) then return false, nil, "Destination already exists: " .. destination_input end
	if source_stat.type == "directory" and Is_Within(source, destination) then
		return false, nil, "A folder cannot be moved into itself or one of its descendants"
	end
	local parent = Normalize(vim.fn.fnamemodify(destination, ":h"))
	local parent_stat = parent and uv.fs_stat(parent)
	if not parent_stat or parent_stat.type ~= "directory" then
		return false, nil, "Destination folder does not exist: " .. tostring(parent)
	end
	local ok, err = uv.fs_rename(source, destination)
	if not ok then return false, nil, "Move failed: " .. tostring(err) end
	return true, destination
end

function Filesystem.Delete(root, input)
	if type(root) ~= "string" or root == "" then return false, "Project root is not set" end
	if type(input) ~= "string" or vim.trim(input) == "" then return false, "Path is required" end
	local path, path_error = Filesystem.Safe_Child(root, input)
	if not path then return false, path_error end
	local relative = Relative_Path(root, path)
	if not relative then return false, "Path must be inside the project" end
	if Is_Protected_Relative(relative) then return false, "Git and HyperMax metadata cannot be deleted from the dashboard" end
	if not uv.fs_lstat(path) then return false, "Path does not exist: " .. input end
	local ok, result = pcall(vim.fn.delete, path, "rf")
	if not ok or result ~= 0 then return false, "Delete failed: " .. tostring(result) end
	return true
end

function Filesystem.Exists(root, input)
	local path = Filesystem.Safe_Child(root, input)
	return path ~= nil and uv.fs_lstat(path) ~= nil
end

return Filesystem

-- HyperMax project task board and run configurations.
-- All project-specific state is stored under .hmc/workspace.json.
local Flow = {}

local SCHEMA_VERSION = 1
local STATUS = { "todo", "doing", "done" }
local PRIORITY = { "low", "normal", "high" }
local active = { root = nil, buffer = nil, window = nil, mode = nil, items = {}, lines = {} }

local function Join(...)
	return table.concat({ ... }, "/"):gsub("/+", "/")
end

local function Normalize_Root(root)
	if not root or root == "" then
		local current_buffer = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_name(0)
		root = current_buffer ~= "" and current_buffer or vim.fn.getcwd()
	end
	return vim.fn.fnamemodify(vim.fn.expand(root), ":p"):gsub("/+$", "")
end

local function Is_Project(root)
	local metadata_directory = Join(root, ".hmc")
	if vim.fn.isdirectory(metadata_directory) ~= 1 then return false end
	-- .hmc is the trust boundary for project-local state. Do not follow a
	-- symlink here: otherwise workspace.json could be written outside the root.
	local stat = (vim.uv or vim.loop).fs_lstat(metadata_directory)
	return stat ~= nil and stat.type == "directory"
end

local function Find_Root(path)
	path = Normalize_Root(path)
	if vim.fn.filereadable(path) == 1 then path = vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":h") end
	while path and path ~= "" do
		if Is_Project(path) then return path end
		local parent = vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":h")
		if parent == path then break end
		path = parent
	end
	return nil
end

local function Data_Path(root)
	return Join(root, ".hmc", "workspace.json")
end

local function Clean_String(value, fallback, limit)
	if type(value) ~= "string" then return fallback end
	value = vim.trim(value)
	if value == "" then return fallback end
	return value:sub(1, limit or 2000)
end

local function Includes(list, value)
	for _, candidate in ipairs(list) do if candidate == value then return true end end
	return false
end

local function Normalize_Data(data)
	data = type(data) == "table" and data or {}
	local normalized = { version = SCHEMA_VERSION, tasks = {}, runners = {} }
	local task_ids, runner_ids = {}, {}

	for index, item in ipairs(type(data.tasks) == "table" and data.tasks or {}) do
		if type(item) == "table" then
			local id = Clean_String(item.id, "task-" .. index, 100)
			if not task_ids[id] then
				task_ids[id] = true
				local status = Includes(STATUS, item.status) and item.status or "todo"
				local priority = Includes(PRIORITY, item.priority) and item.priority or "normal"
				normalized.tasks[#normalized.tasks + 1] = {
					id = id,
					title = Clean_String(item.title, "Untitled task", 180),
					detail = Clean_String(item.detail, "", 4000),
					status = status,
					priority = priority,
					created_at = tonumber(item.created_at) or os.time(),
					updated_at = tonumber(item.updated_at) or tonumber(item.created_at) or os.time(),
				}
			end
		end
	end

	for index, item in ipairs(type(data.runners) == "table" and data.runners or {}) do
		if type(item) == "table" then
			local id = Clean_String(item.id, "run-" .. index, 100)
			local command = Clean_String(item.command, nil, 4000)
			if command and not runner_ids[id] then
				runner_ids[id] = true
				local cwd = Clean_String(item.cwd, ".", 500):gsub("\\", "/")
				if cwd == "" then cwd = "." end
				normalized.runners[#normalized.runners + 1] = {
					id = id,
					name = Clean_String(item.name, "Run configuration " .. index, 120),
					command = command,
					cwd = cwd,
					description = Clean_String(item.description, "", 500),
					last_run = tonumber(item.last_run),
					last_exit_code = tonumber(item.last_exit_code),
				}
			end
		end
	end

	return normalized
end

local function Read_Data(root)
	local path = Data_Path(root)
	local stat = (vim.uv or vim.loop).fs_lstat(path)
	if stat and stat.type == "link" then
		return nil, "Refusing to read a symlinked project workspace file: " .. path
	end
	local file = io.open(path, "rb")
	if not file then return Normalize_Data({}) end
	local content = file:read("*a")
	file:close()
	if not content or content == "" then return Normalize_Data({}) end
	local ok, decoded = pcall(vim.json.decode, content)
	if not ok or type(decoded) ~= "table" then
		return nil, "Project workspace data is invalid JSON: " .. path
	end
	return Normalize_Data(decoded)
end

local function Write_Data(root, data)
	if not Is_Project(root) then return false, "Open a HyperMax project before changing its workspace data" end
	local normalized = Normalize_Data(data)
	local ok, encoded = pcall(vim.json.encode, normalized)
	if not ok then return false, "Could not encode project workspace data: " .. tostring(encoded) end
	local path = Data_Path(root)
	local temporary = path .. ".tmp"
	local temporary_stat = (vim.uv or vim.loop).fs_lstat(temporary)
	if temporary_stat and temporary_stat.type == "link" then
		return false, "Refusing to write through a symlinked workspace temporary file"
	end
	local file, err = io.open(temporary, "wb")
	if not file then return false, "Could not write workspace data: " .. tostring(err) end
	local wrote, write_error = file:write(encoded, "\n")
	local closed, close_error = file:close()
	if not wrote or closed == nil then
		pcall(os.remove, temporary)
		return false, "Could not finish writing workspace data: " .. tostring(write_error or close_error)
	end
	local renamed, rename_error = (vim.uv or vim.loop).fs_rename(temporary, path)
	if not renamed then
		pcall(os.remove, temporary)
		return false, "Could not replace workspace data: " .. tostring(rename_error)
	end
	return true
end

local function Load(root)
	root = Find_Root(root)
	if not root then return nil, "No HyperMax project found. Convert or create a project first." end
	local data, err = Read_Data(root)
	if not data then return nil, err end
	return data, nil, root
end

local function Save(root, data)
	root = Find_Root(root)
	if not root then return false, "No HyperMax project found" end
	return Write_Data(root, data)
end

local function New_ID(prefix, list)
	local base = prefix .. "-" .. tostring(os.time())
	local id, suffix = base, 1
	while true do
		local exists = false
		for _, item in ipairs(list or {}) do if item.id == id then exists = true; break end end
		if not exists then return id end
		suffix = suffix + 1
		id = base .. "-" .. suffix
	end
end

local function Find_Item(list, id)
	for index, item in ipairs(list or {}) do if item.id == id then return item, index end end
	return nil
end

function Flow.Normalize_Data(data)
	return Normalize_Data(data)
end

function Flow.Load(root)
	return Load(root)
end

function Flow.Save(root, data)
	return Save(root, data)
end

function Flow.Get_Summary(root)
	local data, err = Load(root)
	if not data then return nil, err end
	local summary = { total = #data.tasks, todo = 0, doing = 0, done = 0, runners = #data.runners }
	for _, task in ipairs(data.tasks) do summary[task.status] = (summary[task.status] or 0) + 1 end
	return summary
end

function Flow.Add_Task(root, title, detail, priority)
	local data, err, actual_root = Load(root)
	if not data then return false, err end
	title = Clean_String(title, nil, 180)
	if not title then return false, "Task title cannot be empty" end
	local task = {
		id = New_ID("task", data.tasks), title = title,
		detail = Clean_String(detail, "", 4000),
		status = "todo", priority = Includes(PRIORITY, priority) and priority or "normal",
		created_at = os.time(), updated_at = os.time(),
	}
	data.tasks[#data.tasks + 1] = task
	local ok, save_error = Save(actual_root, data)
	if not ok then return false, save_error end
	return true, task
end

function Flow.Update_Task(root, id, changes)
	local data, err, actual_root = Load(root)
	if not data then return false, err end
	local task = Find_Item(data.tasks, id)
	if not task then return false, "Task no longer exists" end
	changes = type(changes) == "table" and changes or {}
	if changes.title ~= nil then
		local title = Clean_String(changes.title, nil, 180)
		if not title then return false, "Task title cannot be empty" end
		task.title = title
	end
	if changes.detail ~= nil then task.detail = Clean_String(changes.detail, "", 4000) end
	if Includes(STATUS, changes.status) then task.status = changes.status end
	if Includes(PRIORITY, changes.priority) then task.priority = changes.priority end
	task.updated_at = os.time()
	return Save(actual_root, data)
end

function Flow.Delete_Task(root, id)
	local data, err, actual_root = Load(root)
	if not data then return false, err end
	local _, index = Find_Item(data.tasks, id)
	if not index then return false, "Task no longer exists" end
	table.remove(data.tasks, index)
	return Save(actual_root, data)
end

local function Is_Safe_CWD(cwd)
	if type(cwd) ~= "string" or cwd == "" or cwd:find("[%c]") or cwd:find("\\") then return false end
	if cwd:sub(1, 1) == "/" or cwd:match("^%a:") then return false end
	for part in cwd:gmatch("[^/]+") do if part == ".." then return false end end
	return true
end

local function Is_Contained_Directory(root, path)
	local uv = vim.uv or vim.loop
	local real_root = uv.fs_realpath(root)
	local real_path = uv.fs_realpath(path)
	if not real_root or not real_path then return false end
	real_root = real_root:gsub("[/\\]+$", "")
	local separator = package.config:sub(1, 1)
	if separator == "\\" then
		real_root, real_path = real_root:lower(), real_path:lower()
	end
	return real_path == real_root or real_path:sub(1, #real_root + 1) == real_root .. separator
end

function Flow.Add_Runner(root, name, command, cwd, description)
	local data, err, actual_root = Load(root)
	if not data then return false, err end
	name = Clean_String(name, nil, 120)
	command = Clean_String(command, nil, 4000)
	if not name then return false, "Run configuration name cannot be empty" end
	if not command then return false, "Command cannot be empty" end
	cwd = Clean_String(cwd, ".", 500):gsub("\\", "/")
	if not Is_Safe_CWD(cwd) then return false, "Working directory must be a safe project-relative path" end
	local full_cwd = cwd == "." and actual_root or (actual_root .. "/" .. cwd)
	if vim.fn.isdirectory(full_cwd) ~= 1 then return false, "Working directory does not exist: " .. cwd end
	if not Is_Contained_Directory(actual_root, full_cwd) then
		return false, "Working directory resolves outside the project (including through symlinks)"
	end
	local runner = { id = New_ID("run", data.runners), name = name, command = command, cwd = cwd, description = Clean_String(description, "", 500) }
	data.runners[#data.runners + 1] = runner
	local ok, save_error = Save(actual_root, data)
	if not ok then return false, save_error end
	return true, runner
end

function Flow.Update_Runner(root, id, changes)
	local data, err, actual_root = Load(root)
	if not data then return false, err end
	local runner = Find_Item(data.runners, id)
	if not runner then return false, "Run configuration no longer exists" end
	changes = type(changes) == "table" and changes or {}
	if changes.name ~= nil then
		runner.name = Clean_String(changes.name, nil, 120)
		if not runner.name then return false, "Name cannot be empty" end
	end
	if changes.command ~= nil then
		runner.command = Clean_String(changes.command, nil, 4000)
		if not runner.command then return false, "Command cannot be empty" end
	end
	if changes.cwd ~= nil then
		local cwd = Clean_String(changes.cwd, ".", 500):gsub("\\", "/")
		if not Is_Safe_CWD(cwd) then return false, "Working directory must be a safe project-relative path" end
		local full_cwd = cwd == "." and actual_root or (actual_root .. "/" .. cwd)
		if vim.fn.isdirectory(full_cwd) ~= 1 then return false, "Working directory does not exist: " .. cwd end
		if not Is_Contained_Directory(actual_root, full_cwd) then
			return false, "Working directory resolves outside the project (including through symlinks)"
		end
		runner.cwd = cwd
	end
	if changes.description ~= nil then runner.description = Clean_String(changes.description, "", 500) end
	return Save(actual_root, data)
end

function Flow.Delete_Runner(root, id)
	local data, err, actual_root = Load(root)
	if not data then return false, err end
	local _, index = Find_Item(data.runners, id)
	if not index then return false, "Run configuration no longer exists" end
	table.remove(data.runners, index)
	return Save(actual_root, data)
end

local function Notify(message, level)
	vim.notify("HyperMax: " .. message, level or vim.log.levels.INFO)
end

local function Close_Window()
	if active.window and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(active.window) then
		local win = active.window
		active.window = nil
		pcall(vim.api.nvim_win_close, win, true)
	end
end

local function Open_Window(title, height)
	Close_Window()
	local width = math.max(24, math.min(100, vim.o.columns - 4))
	height = math.min(height or 28, math.max(10, vim.o.lines - 6))
	local buf = vim.api.nvim_create_buf(false, true)
	vim.bo[buf].buftype = "nofile"
	vim.bo[buf].bufhidden = "wipe"
	vim.bo[buf].swapfile = false
	vim.bo[buf].filetype = "hypermaxflow"
	local win = vim.api.nvim_open_win(buf, true, {
		relative = "editor", style = "minimal", border = "rounded",
		width = width, height = height,
		row = math.max(1, math.floor((vim.o.lines - height) / 2) - 1),
		col = math.max(1, math.floor((vim.o.columns - width) / 2)),
		title = "  " .. title .. "  ", title_pos = "center",
	})
	vim.wo[win].number = false
	vim.wo[win].relativenumber = false
	vim.wo[win].signcolumn = "no"
	vim.wo[win].wrap = false
	vim.wo[win].cursorline = true
	vim.wo[win].winhl = "Normal:NormalFloat,FloatBorder:FloatBorder,CursorLine:CursorLine"
	active.buffer, active.window = buf, win
	return buf, win
end

local function Set_Lines(lines)
	if not active.buffer or not vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(active.buffer) then return end
	vim.api.nvim_set_hl(0, "HyperMaxFlowTitle", { link = "Title", default = true })
	vim.api.nvim_set_hl(0, "HyperMaxFlowSection", { link = "Special", default = true })
	vim.api.nvim_set_hl(0, "HyperMaxFlowMuted", { link = "Comment", default = true })
	vim.api.nvim_set_hl(0, "HyperMaxFlowHigh", { link = "DiagnosticError", default = true })
	vim.api.nvim_set_hl(0, "HyperMaxFlowDone", { link = "DiagnosticOk", default = true })
	vim.bo[active.buffer].modifiable = true
	vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(active.buffer, 0, -1, false, lines)
	vim.bo[active.buffer].modifiable = false
	vim.bo[active.buffer].modified = false
	local namespace = vim.api.nvim_create_namespace("HyperMaxFlowHighlights")
	vim.api.nvim_buf_clear_namespace(active.buffer, namespace, 0, -1)
	for index, line in ipairs(lines) do
		local group
		if index == 1 then group = "HyperMaxFlowTitle"
		elseif line:match("^  TODO$") or line:match("^  IN PROGRESS$") or line:match("^  DONE$") then group = "HyperMaxFlowSection"
		elseif line:match("^  %-+") or line:match("^  Configurations are stored") then group = "HyperMaxFlowMuted"
		elseif line:find("[HIGH]", 1, true) or line:find("!!!", 1, true) then group = "HyperMaxFlowHigh"
		elseif line:match("^  %s*%d+%s+") then group = "HyperMaxFlowSection" end
		if group then vim.api.nvim_buf_add_highlight(active.buffer, namespace, group, index - 1, 0, -1) end
	end
end

local function Map(key, callback, description)
	vim.keymap.set("n", key, callback, { buffer = active.buffer, silent = true, nowait = true, desc = description })
end

local function Current_Item()
	if not active.window or not vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(active.window) then return nil end
	local line = vim.api.nvim_win_get_cursor(active.window)[1]
	return active.items[line]
end

local function Focus_Editor_Window()
	for _, win in ipairs(vim.api.nvim_tabpage_list_wins(0)) do
		if vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(win) and win ~= active.window then
			local config = vim.api.nvim_win_get_config(win)
			if not config.relative or config.relative == "" then
				vim.api.nvim_set_current_win(win)
				Close_Window()
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	Close_Window()
	local current = vim.api.nvim_get_current_win()
	if not current or not vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(current) then return false end
	local config = vim.api.nvim_win_get_config(current)
	return not config.relative or config.relative == ""
end

local function Render_Tasks()
	local data, err = Load(active.root)
	if not data then Notify(tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR); return end
	active.items = {}
	local lines = {
		"  PLAN  /  TRACK  /  FINISH",
		"  Project: " .. vim.fs.basename(active.root),
		"  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────",
		"  TODO",
	}
	local function Add_Group(status, label)
		local count = 0
		for _, task in ipairs(data.tasks) do if task.status == status then count = count + 1 end end
		if status ~= "todo" then lines[#lines + 1] = ""; lines[#lines + 1] = "  " .. label end
		lines[#lines + 1] = "  " .. string.rep("─", 76)
		if count == 0 then lines[#lines + 1] = "    Nothing here yet" end
		for _, task in ipairs(data.tasks) do
			if task.status == status then
				local marker = task.priority == "high" and "!!!" or (task.priority == "low" and " · " or " ! ")
				lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("  %s  [%s] %s", marker, task.priority:upper(), task.title)
				active.items[#lines] = task
			end
		end
	end
	Add_Group("todo", "TODO")
	Add_Group("doing", "IN PROGRESS")
	Add_Group("done", "DONE")
	lines[#lines + 1] = ""
	lines[#lines + 1] = "  a Add  e Edit  s Move status  p Priority  d Mark done  x Delete  Enter Details  q Close"
	Set_Lines(lines)
	if active.window and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(active.window) then
		vim.api.nvim_win_set_cursor(active.window, { math.min(vim.api.nvim_win_get_cursor(active.window)[1], #lines), 0 })
	end
end

local function Add_Task_UI()
	vim.ui.input({ prompt = "Task title: " }, function(title)
		if not title or vim.trim(title) == "" then return end
		vim.ui.input({ prompt = "Details (optional): " }, function(detail)
			local ok, result = Flow.Add_Task(active.root, title, detail or "")
			if not ok then Notify(tostring(result), vim.log.levels.ERROR) else Render_Tasks() end
		end)
	end)
end

local function Edit_Task_UI()
	local task = Current_Item()
	if not task then Notify("Select a task first", vim.log.levels.WARN); return end
	vim.ui.input({ prompt = "Task title: ", default = task.title }, function(title)
		if not title then return end
		vim.ui.input({ prompt = "Details: ", default = task.detail }, function(detail)
			local ok, err = Flow.Update_Task(active.root, task.id, { title = title, detail = detail or "" })
			if not ok then Notify(tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR) else Render_Tasks() end

function Flow.Open_Tasks(root)
	root = Find_Root(root)
	if not root then Notify("Open or convert a project before using its task board", vim.log.levels.WARN); return false end
	active.root, active.mode = root, "tasks"
	Open_Window("HyperMax  ·  Task Board", 30)
	Map("q", Close_Window, "Close task board")
	Map("r", Render_Tasks, "Refresh task board")
	Map("a", Add_Task_UI, "Add task")
	Map("e", Edit_Task_UI, "Edit selected task")
	Map("s", function()
		local task = Current_Item(); if not task then return end
		local index = 1; for i, value in ipairs(STATUS) do if value == task.status then index = i end end
		local next_status = STATUS[index % #STATUS + 1]
		local ok, err = Flow.Update_Task(active.root, task.id, { status = next_status })
		if not ok then Notify(tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR) else Render_Tasks() end
	end, "Move task to next status")
	Map("p", function()
		local task = Current_Item(); if not task then return end
		local index = 1; for i, value in ipairs(PRIORITY) do if value == task.priority then index = i end end
		local ok, err = Flow.Update_Task(active.root, task.id, { priority = PRIORITY[index % #PRIORITY + 1] })
		if not ok then Notify(tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR) else Render_Tasks() end
	end, "Cycle task priority")
	Map("d", function()
		local task = Current_Item(); if not task then return end
		local status = task.status == "done" and "todo" or "done"
		local ok, err = Flow.Update_Task(active.root, task.id, { status = status })
		if not ok then Notify(tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR) else Render_Tasks() end
	end, "Toggle task done")
	Map("x", function()
		local task = Current_Item(); if not task then return end
		vim.ui.select({ "Delete", "Cancel" }, { prompt = "Delete task: " .. task.title .. "?" }, function(choice)
			if choice ~= "Delete" then return end
			local ok, err = Flow.Delete_Task(active.root, task.id)
			if not ok then Notify(tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR) else Render_Tasks() end
		end)
	end, "Delete selected task")
	Map("<CR>", function()
		local task = Current_Item(); if task then Notify(task.detail ~= "" and task.detail or "No additional details") end
	end, "Show task details")
	Render_Tasks()
	return true
end

local function Render_Runners()
	local data, err = Load(active.root)
	if not data then Notify(tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR); return end
	active.items = {}
	local lines = {
		"  BUILD  /  TEST  /  RUN",
		"  Project: " .. vim.fs.basename(active.root),
		"  Configurations are stored in .hmc/workspace.json",
		"  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────",
	}
	if #data.runners == 0 then
		lines[#lines + 1] = ""
		lines[#lines + 1] = "  No run configurations yet. Press a to create one."

	for index, runner in ipairs(data.runners) do
		lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("  %2d  %s", index, runner.name)

function Flow.Run_Runner(root, id)
	local data, err, actual_root = Load(root)
	if not data then return false, err end
	local runner = Find_Item(data.runners, id)
	if not runner then return false, "Run configuration no longer exists" end
	if not Is_Safe_CWD(runner.cwd) then return false, "Run configuration has an unsafe working directory" end
	local cwd = runner.cwd == "." and actual_root or (actual_root .. "/" .. runner.cwd)
	if vim.fn.isdirectory(cwd) ~= 1 then return false, "Working directory no longer exists: " .. runner.cwd end
	if not Is_Contained_Directory(actual_root, cwd) then
		return false, "Working directory now resolves outside the project; refusing to run"
	end

	-- Commands are user-authored project data and execute only after an explicit
	-- Run action. The command intentionally runs through the selected system shell.
	local shell, args
	if vim.fn.has("win32") == 1 then shell, args = "cmd.exe", { "/d", "/s", "/c", runner.command }
	else shell, args = "sh", { "-lc", runner.command } end
	if vim.fn.executable(shell) ~= 1 then return false, "Required shell is not available: " .. shell end
	if not Focus_Editor_Window() then return false, "Could not find an editor window for the run configuration" end
	vim.cmd("botright 14new")
	local terminal_buffer = vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf()
	vim.bo[terminal_buffer].bufhidden = "hide"
	table.insert(args, 1, shell)
	local started, job = pcall(vim.fn.termopen, args, {
		cwd = cwd,
		on_exit = function(_, exit_code)
			vim.schedule(function()
				local latest = Load(actual_root)
				if not latest then return end
				local completed = Find_Item(latest.runners, id)
				if not completed then return end
				completed.last_run = os.time()
				completed.last_exit_code = tonumber(exit_code) or -1
				Save(actual_root, latest)
				if active.mode == "runners" and active.root == actual_root then Render_Runners() end
			end)
		end,
	})
	if not started or type(job) ~= "number" or job <= 0 then
		pcall(vim.cmd, "stopinsert")
		pcall(vim.cmd, "bwipeout!")
		return false, "Could not start the run configuration terminal: " .. tostring(job)
	end
	vim.cmd("startinsert")
	runner.last_run = os.time()
	Save(actual_root, data)
	return true
end

-- Small, testable Git wrapper used by the HyperMax dashboard.
local Git = {}
local uv = vim.uv or vim.loop

local function Normalize(path)
	if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" then return nil end
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		if vim.fs and vim.fs.normalize then return vim.fs.normalize(path) end
		return vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":p")
	end)
	if not ok or type(result) ~= "string" or result == "" then return nil end
	if result:sub(1, 1) ~= "/" then
		local absolute_ok, absolute = pcall(vim.fn.fnamemodify, result, ":p")
		if not absolute_ok or type(absolute) ~= "string" then return nil end
		result = absolute
	end
	if result ~= "/" then result = result:gsub("/+$", "") end
	return result
end

function Git.Run(root, args)
	if type(root) ~= "string" or root == "" then return nil, "Project root is not set" end
	if type(args) ~= "table" or #args == 0 then return nil, "Git arguments must be a non-empty list" end
	if vim.fn.executable("git") ~= 1 then return nil, "Git is not installed or not on PATH" end
	local normalized_root = Normalize(root)
	if not normalized_root then return nil, "Project root is not a valid path" end
	local command = { "git", "-C", normalized_root }
	for _, arg in ipairs(args) do
		if type(arg) ~= "string" then return nil, "Git arguments must all be strings" end
		command[#command + 1] = arg
	end
	local ok, output = pcall(vim.fn.systemlist, command)
	if not ok then return nil, tostring(output) end
	local exit_code = vim.v.shell_error
	if exit_code ~= 0 then return nil, table.concat(output or {}, "\n"), exit_code end
	return output or {}, nil, 0
end

function Git.Repository_Root(root)
	local output = Git.Run(root, { "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel" })
	if not output or not output[1] or output[1] == "" then return nil end
	return Normalize(output[1])
end

function Git.Is_Repository(root)
	return Git.Repository_Root(root) ~= nil
end

function Git.Branch(root)
	local output = Git.Run(root, { "branch", "--show-current" })
	if not output then return nil end
	if output[1] and output[1] ~= "" then return output[1] end
	local commit = Git.Run(root, { "rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD" })
	if commit and commit[1] and commit[1] ~= "" then return "detached@" .. commit[1] end
	return "unborn"
end

local function Unquote_Path(path)
	if path:sub(1, 1) ~= '"' or path:sub(-1) ~= '"' then return path end
	path = path:sub(2, -2)
	path = path:gsub("\\(%d%d%d)", function(octal)
		return string.char(tonumber(octal, 8))
	end)
	path = path:gsub('\\([\\"tnr])', function(char)
		local replacements = { ["\\"] = "\\", ['"'] = '"', t = "\t", n = "\n", r = "\r" }
		return replacements[char] or char
	end)
	return path
end

function Git.Parse_Status(lines, root)
	local statuses = {}
	root = Normalize(root)
	if not root then return statuses end
	for _, row in ipairs(lines or {}) do
		if type(row) == "string" and #row >= 3 then
			local code, path = row:sub(1, 2), row:sub(4)
			local valid_code = code ~= "##" and code:match("^[ MADRCTU?!][ MADRCTU?!]$") ~= nil
			if valid_code and path ~= "" then
				if (code:find("R", 1, true) or code:find("C", 1, true)) and path:find(" -> ", 1, true) then
					path = path:match(" -> (.+)$") or path
				end
				path = Unquote_Path(path)
				local full = Normalize(root .. "/" .. path)
				if full ~= root and full:sub(1, #root + 1) == root .. "/" then
					statuses[full] = code
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return statuses
end

function Git.Status(root)
	local output, err = Git.Run(root, { "-c", "core.quotepath=false", "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all" })
	if not output then return nil, err end
	local repository_root = Git.Repository_Root(root) or Normalize(root)
	return Git.Parse_Status(output, repository_root), nil, output
end

function Git.Snapshot(root)
	local snapshot = { available = false, branch = nil, statuses = {}, repository_root = nil }
	local repository_root = Git.Repository_Root(root)
	if not repository_root then return snapshot end
	snapshot.available = true
	snapshot.repository_root = repository_root
	snapshot.branch = Git.Branch(root) or "unborn"
	snapshot.statuses = Git.Status(root) or {}
	return snapshot
end

function Git.Init(root)
	return Git.Run(root, { "init" })
end

function Git.Add_All(root)
	return Git.Run(root, { "add", "-A" })
end

function Git.Commit(root, message)
	if type(message) ~= "string" or vim.trim(message) == "" then return nil, "Commit message cannot be empty" end
	return Git.Run(root, { "commit", "-m", message })
end

function Git.Recent(root, count)
	count = tonumber(count) or 5
	if count ~= count or count == math.huge or count == -math.huge then count = 5 end
	count = math.max(1, math.min(100, math.floor(count)))
	return Git.Run(root, { "--no-pager", "log", "-" .. tostring(count), "--oneline", "--decorate" })
end

-- =========================================================
-- BRANCHES, REMOTES, TAGS AND STASHES
-- =========================================================

local function Split_Lines(output)
	local items = {}
	for _, line in ipairs(output or {}) do
		line = vim.trim(line)
		if line ~= "" then items[#items + 1] = line end
	end
	return items
end

function Git.Branches(root, include_remote)
	local args = { "branch", "--format=%(refname:short)" }
	if include_remote then args = { "branch", "--all", "--format=%(refname:short)" } end
	local output, err = Git.Run(root, args)
	if not output then return nil, err end
	return Split_Lines(output)
end

function Git.Remotes(root)
	local output, err = Git.Run(root, { "remote" })
	if not output then return nil, err end
	return Split_Lines(output)
end

function Git.Remote_Details(root)
	local output, err = Git.Run(root, { "remote", "-v" })
	if not output then return nil, err end
	return Split_Lines(output)
end

function Git.Tags(root)
	local output, err = Git.Run(root, { "tag", "--list" })
	if not output then return nil, err end
	return Split_Lines(output)
end

function Git.Stashes(root)
	local output, err = Git.Run(root, { "stash", "list", "--format=%gd%x09%gs" })
	if not output then return nil, err end
	return Split_Lines(output)
end

function Git.Log(root, count)
	count = tonumber(count) or 10
	if count ~= count or count == math.huge or count == -math.huge then count = 10 end
	count = math.max(1, math.min(100, math.floor(count)))
	return Git.Run(root, { "--no-pager", "log", "-" .. tostring(count), "--format=%h%x09%s%x09%an%x09%ar" })
end

function Git.Diff(root, staged)
	local args = { "--no-pager", "diff", "--stat" }
	if staged then args[#args + 1] = "--cached" end
	return Git.Run(root, args)
end

function Git.Diff_Name_Status(root, staged)
	local args = { "--no-pager", "diff", "--name-status" }
	if staged then args[#args + 1] = "--cached" end
	return Git.Run(root, args)
end

-- =========================================================
-- COMMON MUTATIONS
-- =========================================================

local function Is_Safe_Relative_Path(path)
	if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" or path:find("[%c]") or path:find("\\") then return false end
	if path:sub(1, 1) == "/" or path:match("^%a:") then return false end
	for part in path:gmatch("[^/]+") do
		if part == "." or part == ".." then return false end
	end
	return true
end

function Git.Stage(root, relative_path)
	if not Is_Safe_Relative_Path(relative_path) then return nil, "A safe project-relative path is required" end
	return Git.Run(root, { "add", "--", relative_path })
end

function Git.Unstage(root, relative_path)
	if not Is_Safe_Relative_Path(relative_path) then return nil, "A safe project-relative path is required" end
	-- git restore --staged needs HEAD. On an unborn repository, remove the
	-- staged entry from the index without touching the working-tree file.
	local head = Git.Run(root, { "rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD" })
	if not head then return Git.Run(root, { "rm", "--cached", "--", relative_path }) end
	return Git.Run(root, { "restore", "--staged", "--", relative_path })
end

function Git.Fetch(root, remote)
	local args = { "fetch", "--all", "--prune" }
	if type(remote) == "string" and remote ~= "" then args = { "fetch", remote, "--prune" } end
	return Git.Run(root, args)
end

function Git.Push(root, remote, branch)
	local args = { "push" }
	if type(remote) == "string" and remote ~= "" then args[#args + 1] = remote end
	if type(branch) == "string" and branch ~= "" then args[#args + 1] = branch end
	return Git.Run(root, args)
end

function Git.Pull(root, remote, branch)
	local args = { "pull" }
	if type(remote) == "string" and remote ~= "" then args[#args + 1] = remote end
	if type(branch) == "string" and branch ~= "" then args[#args + 1] = branch end
	return Git.Run(root, args)
end

local function Validate_Branch_Name(root, branch)
	if type(branch) ~= "string" or branch == "" or branch:sub(1, 1) == "-" or branch:find("[%c]") then
		return false, "Invalid branch name"
	end
	-- Let Git validate its complete ref-name grammar instead of imposing a
	-- narrower ASCII-only whitelist. The value is still a single argv item.
	local checked = Git.Run(root, { "check-ref-format", "refs/heads/" .. branch })
	if not checked then return false, "Invalid branch name" end
	return true
end

function Git.Switch_Branch(root, branch)
	local valid, err = Validate_Branch_Name(root, branch)
	if not valid then return nil, err end
	return Git.Run(root, { "switch", branch })
end

function Git.Create_Branch(root, branch)
	local valid, err = Validate_Branch_Name(root, branch)
	if not valid then return nil, err end
	return Git.Run(root, { "switch", "-c", branch })
end

function Git.Delete_Branch(root, branch, force)
	local valid, err = Validate_Branch_Name(root, branch)
	if not valid then return nil, err end
	return Git.Run(root, { "branch", force and "-D" or "-d", branch })
end

local function Validate_Tag(root, tag)
	if type(tag) ~= "string" or tag == "" or tag:sub(1, 1) == "-" or tag:find("[%c%s]") then
		return false, "Invalid tag name"
	end
	local checked, err = Git.Run(root, { "check-ref-format", "refs/tags/" .. tag })
	if not checked then return false, err or "Invalid tag name" end
	return true
end

function Git.Create_Tag(root, tag, message)
	local valid, err = Validate_Tag(root, tag)
	if not valid then return nil, err end
	if type(message) == "string" and vim.trim(message) ~= "" then
		return Git.Run(root, { "tag", "-a", tag, "-m", message })
	end
	return Git.Run(root, { "tag", tag })
end

function Git.Delete_Tag(root, tag)
	local valid, err = Validate_Tag(root, tag)
	if not valid then return nil, err end
	return Git.Run(root, { "tag", "-d", tag })
end

function Git.Stash(root, message)
	local args = { "stash", "push", "--include-untracked" }
	if type(message) == "string" and vim.trim(message) ~= "" then
		args[#args + 1] = "-m"
		args[#args + 1] = message
	end
	return Git.Run(root, args)
end

local function Is_Safe_Stash_Reference(reference)
	return type(reference) == "string" and (reference == "refs/stash" or reference:match("^stash@{%d+}$") ~= nil)
end

function Git.Stash_Pop(root, reference)
	local args = { "stash", "pop" }
	if reference ~= nil and reference ~= "" then
		if not Is_Safe_Stash_Reference(reference) then return nil, "Invalid stash reference" end
		args[#args + 1] = reference
	end
	return Git.Run(root, args)
end

function Git.Stash_Apply(root, reference)
	local args = { "stash", "apply" }
	if reference ~= nil and reference ~= "" then
		if not Is_Safe_Stash_Reference(reference) then return nil, "Invalid stash reference" end
		args[#args + 1] = reference
	end
	return Git.Run(root, args)
end

function Git.Add_Remote(root, name, url)
	if type(name) ~= "string" or not name:match("^[%w_.-]+$") or name:sub(1, 1) == "-" then return nil, "Invalid remote name" end
	if type(url) ~= "string" or vim.trim(url) == "" or vim.trim(url):sub(1, 1) == "-" then return nil, "A valid remote URL is required" end
	return Git.Run(root, { "remote", "add", name, vim.trim(url) })
end

function Git.Remove_Remote(root, name)
	if type(name) ~= "string" or not name:match("^[%w_.-]+$") or name:sub(1, 1) == "-" then return nil, "Invalid remote name" end
	return Git.Run(root, { "remote", "remove", name })
end

return Git

-- =========================================================
-- HEALTH CHECK
-- =========================================================

local function Run_Health_Check()
	-- Find the plugin root from this file's location.
	local source = debug.getinfo(1, "S").source

	if source:sub(1, 1) == "@" then
		source = source:sub(2)
	end

	local plugin_root = vim.fs.dirname(vim.fs.dirname(vim.fs.dirname(source)))

	local test_file = plugin_root .. "/tests/run.lua"

	if vim.fn.filereadable(test_file) ~= 1 then
		vim.notify("HyperMax: Could not find tests/run.lua\n" .. test_file, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return
	end

	vim.notify("HyperMax: Running health checks...", vim.log.levels.INFO)

	-- Run tests in a clean Neovim process.
	vim.system({
		vim.v.progpath,
		"--headless",
		"-u",
		"NONE",
		"-c",
		"set rtp^=.",
		"-c",
		"luafile tests/run.lua",
		"-c",
		"qa!",
	}, {
		cwd = plugin_root,
		text = true,
	}, function(result)
		vim.schedule(function()
			local output = {
				"HyperMax Health Check",
				"=====================",
				"",
				"Exit code: " .. tostring(result.code),
				"",
			}

			vim.list_extend(
				output,
				vim.split(result.stdout or "", "\n", {
					plain = true,
					trimempty = true,
				})
			)

			if result.stderr and result.stderr ~= "" then
				vim.list_extend(output, { "", "Errors:" })
				-- nvim_buf_set_lines accepts one line per array item. Never insert
				-- the complete stderr string as one item: it may contain newlines.
				vim.list_extend(output, vim.split(result.stderr, "\n", { plain = true, trimempty = true }))
			end

			-- Display results in a scratch buffer.
			vim.cmd("botright new")

			local buffer = vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf()

			vim.bo[buffer].buftype = "nofile"
			vim.bo[buffer].bufhidden = "wipe"
			vim.bo[buffer].swapfile = false
			vim.bo[buffer].filetype = "text"

			vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(buffer, 0, -1, false, output)

			vim.bo[buffer].modifiable = false

			if result.code == 0 then
				vim.notify("HyperMax: Health checks passed", vim.log.levels.INFO)
			else
				vim.notify(
					"HyperMax: Health checks failed (exit code " .. tostring(result.code) .. ")",
					vim.log.levels.ERROR
				)
			end
		end)
	end)
end

local function Map(key, action, description)

-- =========================================================

local function Current_Path(argument)
	return vim.fn.fnamemodify(vim.fn.expand((argument and argument ~= "") and argument or vim.fn.getcwd()), ":p")
end

local function Confirm_Action(prompt, action)
	vim.ui.select({ "Confirm", "Cancel" }, { prompt = prompt }, function(choice)
		if choice ~= "Confirm" then return end
		local ok, result = action()
		if not ok then
			vim.notify("HyperMax: " .. tostring(result), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		else
			vim.notify("HyperMax: " .. tostring(result or "Operation completed"), vim.log.levels.INFO)
		end
	end)
end

local function Convert_Folder(path)
	local Dashboard = require("hypermax.dashboard")
	local ok, result = Dashboard.Convert_Folder(path)
	if not ok then return false, result end
	return true, "Converted folder to HyperMax project: " .. path
end

local function Undo_Conversion(path)
	local Dashboard = require("hypermax.dashboard")
	local ok, result = Dashboard.Undo_Conversion(path)
	if not ok then return false, result end
	return true, "Conversion undone. Metadata backup: " .. tostring(result)
end

local function Scrape_Project(path)
	local Dashboard = require("hypermax.dashboard")
	local ok, result = Dashboard.Scrape(path)
	if not ok then return false, result end
	return true, "Project metadata removed. Backup: " .. tostring(result)
end

function Keymaps.Setup(Project, Settings, Layouts)
	-- Register the health-check command.
	pcall(vim.api.nvim_del_user_command, "HyperMaxHealthCheck")

	vim.api.nvim_create_user_command("HyperMaxHealthCheck", Run_Health_Check, {
		desc = "Run HyperMax health checks",
	})
	for _, command in ipairs({ "HyperMaxConvert", "HyperMaxUndoConversion", "HyperMaxScrape" }) do
		pcall(vim.api.nvim_del_user_command, command)
	end
	vim.api.nvim_create_user_command("HyperMaxConvert", function(opts)
		local path = Current_Path(opts.args)
		local ok, result = Convert_Folder(path)
		vim.notify("HyperMax: " .. tostring(result), ok and vim.log.levels.INFO or vim.log.levels.ERROR)
	end, { nargs = "?", complete = "dir", desc = "Convert an existing folder into a HyperMax project" })
	vim.api.nvim_create_user_command("HyperMaxUndoConversion", function(opts)
		local path = Current_Path(opts.args)
		Confirm_Action("Undo folder conversion? Existing files will remain; .hmc will be backed up", function() return Undo_Conversion(path) end)
	end, { nargs = "?", complete = "dir", desc = "Undo a HyperMax folder conversion" })
	vim.api.nvim_create_user_command("HyperMaxScrape", function(opts)
		local path = Current_Path(opts.args)
		Confirm_Action("Remove HyperMax metadata from this project? A backup will be kept", function() return Scrape_Project(path) end)
	end, { nargs = "?", complete = "dir", desc = "Remove HyperMax metadata from a project" })

	-- =====================================================
	-- MAIN MENU
	-- =====================================================

	Map("+", function()
		vim.ui.select({
			"Projects",
			"Settings",
			"Load layout",
			"Save current project as layout",
			"Edit saved layout",
			"Open last project",
			"List layouts",
			"Health Check",
			"Convert current folder into project",
			"Undo folder conversion",
			"Remove project metadata (scrape)",
		}, {
			prompt = "HyperMax",
		}, function(choice)
			if not choice then
				return
			end

			if choice == "Projects" then
				Project.List()
			elseif choice == "Settings" then
				Settings.Open()
			elseif choice == "Load layout" then
				Project.Load_Layout()
			elseif choice == "Save current project as layout" then
				Project.Save_Layout()
			elseif choice == "Edit saved layout" then
				Project.Edit_Layout()
			elseif choice == "Open last project" then
				Project.Open_Last()
			elseif choice == "List layouts" then
				local ids = Layouts.Get_IDs()
				local choices = {}

				for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
					local layout = Layouts.Get(id)

					if layout then
						choices[#choices + 1] = layout
					end
				end

				if #choices == 0 then
					vim.notify("HyperMax: No layouts are available", vim.log.levels.WARN)
					return
				end

				vim.ui.select(choices, {
					prompt = "Choose layout",
					format_item = function(layout)
						local name = layout.name or layout.id

						if layout.description and layout.description ~= "" then
							return name .. " — " .. layout.description
						end

						return name
					end,
				}, function(layout)
					if not layout then
						return
					end

					Project.Create(
						vim.tbl_deep_extend(
							"force",
							{},
							require("hypermax.config").options or {},
							{ default_layout = layout.id }
						)
					)
				end)
			elseif choice == "Health Check" then
				Run_Health_Check()
			elseif choice == "Convert current folder into project" then
				local path = Current_Path(nil)
				local ok, result = Convert_Folder(path)
				vim.notify("HyperMax: " .. tostring(result), ok and vim.log.levels.INFO or vim.log.levels.ERROR)
			elseif choice == "Undo folder conversion" then
				local path = Current_Path(nil)
				Confirm_Action("Undo folder conversion? Existing files will remain; .hmc will be backed up", function() return Undo_Conversion(path) end)
			elseif choice == "Remove project metadata (scrape)" then
				local path = Current_Path(nil)
				Confirm_Action("Remove HyperMax metadata? A backup will be kept", function() return Scrape_Project(path) end)
			end
		end)
	end, "Open menu")

	end, "Convert current folder into project")
	Map("u", function()
		local path = Current_Path(nil)
		Confirm_Action("Undo folder conversion? Existing files will remain; .hmc will be backed up", function() return Undo_Conversion(path) end)
	end, "Undo folder conversion")
	Map("X", function()
		local path = Current_Path(nil)
		Confirm_Action("Remove HyperMax metadata? A backup will be kept", function() return Scrape_Project(path) end)
	end, "Scrape project metadata")
end
