function Project.List()
	local options = Config.options or {}
	local projects, err = Project_Config.List_Projects(options.project_dir or "~/Projects")
	if not projects then
		Notify("Could not load registered projects: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return
	end

	if #projects == 0 then
		Notify("No HyperMax projects found. Convert a folder with :HyperMaxConvert or create a project first.", vim.log.levels.WARN)
		return
	end

	Select_Item(projects, "Open HyperMax project (most recently used first)", function(project)
		local details = project.language and project.language ~= "unknown" and (" [" .. project.language .. "]") or ""
		local recent = tonumber(project.last_opened) and os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", project.last_opened) or "not opened yet"
		return (project.name or vim.fs.basename(project.path)) .. details .. " · " .. recent .. " — " .. project.path
	end, function(project)
		if not project then return end
		local marked, mark_error = Project_Config.Mark_Project_Opened(project.path)
		if not marked then Notify("Could not update project index: " .. tostring(mark_error), vim.log.levels.WARN) end
		Config.options.last_project_path = project.path
		Config.save()
		vim.cmd("tcd " .. vim.fn.fnameescape(project.path))
		Dashboard.Open(project.path)
		Notify("Opened project: " .. project.path)
	end)
end

-- =========================================================
-- OPEN LAST PROJECT
-- =========================================================

function Project.Open_Last()
	local options = Config.options or {}
	-- The project index is authoritative: converting a folder registers it as
	-- the latest project even when settings.json still points at an older one.
	local path = Project_Config.Get_Last_Project()
	if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" or not Is_Directory(path) or not Dashboard.Is_Project(path) then
		path = options.last_project_path
	end

	if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" then
		Notify("No registered HyperMax project is available. Press <leader>+p to choose a project.", vim.log.levels.WARN)
		return
	end

	path = vim.fn.fnamemodify(vim.fn.expand(path), ":p")
	if not Is_Directory(path) or not Dashboard.Is_Project(path) then
		Notify("Last project is no longer available: " .. path, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return
	end

	local marked, mark_error = Project_Config.Mark_Project_Opened(path)
	if not marked then Notify("Could not update project index: " .. tostring(mark_error), vim.log.levels.WARN) end
	Config.options.last_project_path = path
	Config.save()
	vim.cmd("tcd " .. vim.fn.fnameescape(path))
	if Dashboard.Open(path) then Notify("Opened project dashboard: " .. path) end
end

-- =========================================================
-- LOAD A LAYOUT INTO A NEW PROJECT
-- =========================================================

function Project.Load_Layout()
	local ids = Layouts.Get_IDs()
	local choices = {}

	for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
		local layout = Layouts.Get(id)

		if layout then
			choices[#choices + 1] = layout
		end
	end

	Select_Item(choices, "Choose layout", function(layout)
		return (layout.name or layout.id)
			.. (layout.description and layout.description ~= "" and " — " .. layout.description or "")
	end, function(layout)
		if not layout then
			return
		end

		local options = vim.tbl_deep_extend("force", {}, Config.options or {}, { default_layout = layout.id })

		Project.Create(options)
	end)
end

-- =========================================================
-- SAVE CURRENT DIRECTORY AS A LAYOUT
-- =========================================================

local function Scan_Directory(root)
	local layout = {
		name = vim.fn.fnamemodify(root, ":t"),
		description = "",
		directories = {},
		files = {},
		_capture = {
			root = root,
			skipped = {},
			max_file_size = 4 * 1024 * 1024,
		},
	}

	-- Repository and HyperMax metadata are never copied into a reusable layout.
	-- Hidden source/config files (for example .gitignore and .editorconfig) are kept.
	local ignored = {
		[".git"] = true,
		[".hmc"] = true,
		[".hg"] = true,
		[".svn"] = true,
		["node_modules"] = true,
		["vendor"] = true,
		["target"] = true,
		["build"] = true,
		["dist"] = true,
		[".venv"] = true,
		["venv"] = true,
		["__pycache__"] = true,
		[".pytest_cache"] = true,
		[".mypy_cache"] = true,
		[".ruff_cache"] = true,
		[".next"] = true,
		[".turbo"] = true,
		[".ssh"] = true,
		[".aws"] = true,
		[".gnupg"] = true,
	}

	local function Is_Sensitive_File(name)
		local lower = name:lower()
		if lower == ".env.example" or lower == ".env.sample" or lower == ".env.template" then return false end
		if lower == ".env" or lower:match("^%.env%.") then return true end
		if lower == ".npmrc" or lower == ".pypirc" or lower == ".netrc" then return true end
		if lower == "id_rsa" or lower == "id_ed25519" or lower:match("%.pem$") or lower:match("%.p12$") or lower:match("%.pfx$") or lower:match("%.key$") then return true end
		return false
	end

	local function Walk(directory, relative)
		local entries, scan_error = uv.fs_scandir(directory)
		if not entries then
			layout._capture.skipped[#layout._capture.skipped + 1] = {
				path = relative ~= "" and relative or ".",
				reason = "Could not read directory: " .. tostring(scan_error),
			}
			return
		end

		while true do
			local name, kind = uv.fs_scandir_next(entries)
			if not name then break end

			local relative_path = relative == "" and name or (relative .. "/" .. name)
			local full_path = Join_Path(directory, name)

			if not ignored[name] and Is_Safe_Relative_Path(relative_path) then
				if kind == "directory" then
					layout.directories[#layout.directories + 1] = relative_path
					Walk(full_path, relative_path)
				elseif kind == "file" then
					local stat = uv.fs_stat(full_path)
					if Is_Sensitive_File(name) then
						layout._capture.skipped[#layout._capture.skipped + 1] = { path = relative_path, reason = "Potential secret or credential file" }
					elseif not stat then
						layout._capture.skipped[#layout._capture.skipped + 1] = { path = relative_path, reason = "Could not stat file" }
					elseif stat.size > layout._capture.max_file_size then
						layout._capture.skipped[#layout._capture.skipped + 1] = { path = relative_path, reason = "File exceeds 4 MiB capture limit" }
					else
						local contents = Read_File(full_path)
						if contents == nil then
							layout._capture.skipped[#layout._capture.skipped + 1] = { path = relative_path, reason = "Could not read file" }
						elseif contents:find("\0", 1, true) then
							layout._capture.skipped[#layout._capture.skipped + 1] = { path = relative_path, reason = "Binary file is not included" }
						else
							layout.files[relative_path] = contents
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	Walk(root, "")
	table.sort(layout.directories)
	return layout
end

local function Is_Draft_Buffer(buffer)
	return vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(buffer) and vim.b[buffer].hypermax_layout_draft == true
end

local function Pretty_JSON(value, depth, force_object)
	depth = depth or 0
	local indent = string.rep(" ", depth * 2)
	local child_indent = string.rep(" ", (depth + 1) * 2)

	if type(value) == "string" then return vim.json.encode(value) end
	if type(value) == "number" or type(value) == "boolean" then return tostring(value) end
	if value == nil then return "null" end
	if type(value) ~= "table" then return "null" end

	local count, max_index, is_array = 0, 0, true
	for key in pairs(value) do
		count = count + 1
		if type(key) ~= "number" or key < 1 or key % 1 ~= 0 then is_array = false else max_index = math.max(max_index, key) end
	end
	if count == 0 then return force_object and "{}" or (is_array and "[]" or "{}") end
	if is_array and max_index ~= count then is_array = false end

	local lines = { is_array and "[" or "{" }
	if is_array then
		for index = 1, max_index do
			lines[#lines + 1] = child_indent .. Pretty_JSON(value[index], depth + 1) .. (index < max_index and "," or "")
		end
	else
		local keys = {}
		for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
		table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
		for index, key in ipairs(keys) do
			local object_value = key == "files" or key == "languages"
			lines[#lines + 1] = child_indent .. vim.json.encode(tostring(key)) .. ": " .. Pretty_JSON(value[key], depth + 1, object_value) .. (index < #keys and "," or "")
		end
	end
	lines[#lines + 1] = indent .. (is_array and "]" or "}")
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

local function Save_Layout_Draft(buffer)
	if not Is_Draft_Buffer(buffer) then return false, "Current buffer is not a HyperMax layout draft" end
	local path = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_name(buffer)
	local contents = table.concat(vim.api.nvim_buf_get_lines(buffer, 0, -1, false), "\n")
	local decoded_ok, data = pcall(vim.json.decode, contents)
	if not decoded_ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
		return false, "The layout draft is not valid JSON: " .. tostring(data)
	end

	local id = vim.b[buffer].hypermax_layout_id or data.id
	if type(id) ~= "string" or not id:match("^[%w_-]+$") then return false, "Invalid layout ID in draft" end
	local layout = {
		name = data.name,
		description = data.description or "",
		directories = data.directories or {},
		files = data.files or {},
	}
	if data.entry ~= nil then layout.entry = data.entry end
	if data.languages ~= nil then layout.languages = data.languages end

	local ok, err = Layouts.Save(id, layout)
	if not ok then return false, err end
	vim.b[buffer].hypermax_layout_saved = true
	return true, "Saved layout '" .. id .. "' from " .. path
end

local function Open_Layout_Draft(id, layout)
	local directory = Join_Path(vim.fn.stdpath("cache"), "hypermax", "layout-drafts")
	local mkdir_ok = vim.fn.mkdir(directory, "p")
	if mkdir_ok == 0 and not Is_Directory(directory) then
		Notify("Could not create layout draft directory: " .. directory, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return
	end

	local path = Join_Path(directory, id .. ".json")
	local file, err = io.open(path, "wb")
	if not file then Notify("Could not create layout draft: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR); return end
	file:write(Pretty_JSON(layout), "\n")
	file:close()

	vim.cmd("edit " .. vim.fn.fnameescape(path))
	local buffer = vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf()
	vim.bo[buffer].filetype = "json"
	vim.b[buffer].hypermax_layout_draft = true
	vim.b[buffer].hypermax_layout_id = id

	local group = vim.api.nvim_create_augroup("HyperMaxLayoutDraft_" .. id, { clear = true })
	vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd("BufWritePost", {
		group = group,
		buffer = buffer,
		callback = function(args)
			local ok, message = Save_Layout_Draft(args.buf)
			if ok then Notify(message .. " — edit and :write again to update")
			else Notify("Layout draft was not saved: " .. tostring(message), vim.log.levels.ERROR) end
		end,
	})

	vim.api.nvim_buf_create_user_command(buffer, "HyperMaxLayoutSave", function()
		local ok, message = Save_Layout_Draft(buffer)
		Notify(ok and message or ("Could not save layout: " .. tostring(message)), ok and vim.log.levels.INFO or vim.log.levels.ERROR)
	end, { desc = "Validate and save this HyperMax layout draft" })
	vim.api.nvim_buf_create_user_command(buffer, "HyperMaxLayoutCancel", function()
		local draft = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_name(buffer)
		vim.api.nvim_buf_delete(buffer, { force = true })
		pcall(os.remove, draft)
		Notify("Layout draft discarded")
	end, { desc = "Discard this HyperMax layout draft" })

	Notify("Layout draft opened: edit directories/files, then :write or :HyperMaxLayoutSave. :HyperMaxLayoutCancel discards it.")
end

function Project.Edit_Layout()
	local choices = {}
	for _, id in ipairs(Layouts.Get_IDs()) do
		local layout = Layouts.Get(id)
		if layout then choices[#choices + 1] = layout end
	end
	if #choices == 0 then Notify("No saved layouts to edit", vim.log.levels.WARN); return end

	Select_Item(choices, "Choose layout to edit", function(layout)
		return (layout.name or layout.id) .. " (" .. layout.id .. ")"
	end, function(layout)
		if not layout then return end
		Open_Layout_Draft(layout.id, {
			id = layout.id,
			name = layout.name or layout.id,
			description = layout.description or "",
			directories = layout.directories or {},
			files = layout.files or {},
			entry = layout.entry,
			languages = layout.languages,
		})
	end)
end

function Project.Save_Layout()
	local current = vim.fn.getcwd()
	local captured = Scan_Directory(current)
	captured._capture.source = nil
	captured._capture.root = nil

	local defaults = {
		id = vim.fn.fnamemodify(current, ":t"):lower():gsub("[^%w_-]", "_"):gsub("_+", "_"),
		name = vim.fn.fnamemodify(current, ":t"),
		description = "",
		directories = captured.directories,
		files = captured.files,
	}

	-- Capture project-specific language metadata without copying its .hmc files.
	local project_config = require("hypermax.project_config")
	if project_config.Exists(current) then
		local loaded = project_config.Load(current)
		local project = loaded and loaded.basics and loaded.basics.project or {}
		if project.language and project.language ~= "unknown" then defaults.languages = { project.language } end
		local entry_point = project.entry_point or {}
		local entry = entry_point.file or project.entry_file
		if type(entry) == "string" and entry ~= "" then defaults.entry = entry end
	end

	Input("Layout ID (letters, numbers, '_' or '-'): ", defaults.id, function(id)
		id = vim.trim(id or "")
		if not id:match("^[%w_-]+$") then Notify("Invalid layout ID.", vim.log.levels.ERROR); return end

		Input("Layout display name: ", defaults.name, function(name)
			name = vim.trim(name or "")
			if name == "" then Notify("Layout name cannot be empty.", vim.log.levels.ERROR); return end

			Input("Description: ", defaults.description, function(description)
				local draft = {
				id = id,
				name = name,
				description = description or "",
				directories = defaults.directories,
				files = defaults.files,
				_capture = captured._capture,
			}
				if defaults.languages then draft.languages = defaults.languages end
				if defaults.entry then draft.entry = defaults.entry end

				local function Open_Draft()
					Open_Layout_Draft(id, draft)
				end
				if Layouts.Exists(id) then
					Confirm("Layout '" .. id .. "' already exists. Replace it after editing the draft?", function(confirmed)
						if confirmed then Open_Draft() end
					end)
				else
					Open_Draft()
				end
			end)
		end)
	end)
end

return Project

local Project_Config = {}

local uv = vim.uv or vim.loop
Project_Config.global_path = nil

local DATA_VERSION = 1
local HISTORY_HEADER = "HMXHIST\0" .. string.char(0, 0, 0, DATA_VERSION)

local IGNORED_DIRECTORIES = {
	[".git"] = true,
	[".hmc"] = true,
	["node_modules"] = true,
	["vendor"] = true,
	["target"] = true,
	["build"] = true,
	[".venv"] = true,
	["venv"] = true,
	["dist"] = true,
	["__pycache__"] = true,
	[".pytest_cache"] = true,
	[".mypy_cache"] = true,
	[".ruff_cache"] = true,
	[".next"] = true,
	[".turbo"] = true,
	[".ssh"] = true,
	[".aws"] = true,
	[".gnupg"] = true,
}

local MAX_LAYOUT_FILE_SIZE = 4 * 1024 * 1024

-- =========================================================
-- PATHS
-- =========================================================

local function Join(...)
	return table.concat({ ... }, "/"):gsub("/+", "/")
end

local function Get_Global_Directory()
	return Join(vim.fn.stdpath("data"), "hypermax")
end

local function Get_Global_Config_Path()
	return Join(Get_Global_Directory(), "config.json")
end

local function Get_HMC_Directory(project_root)
	return Join(project_root, ".hmc")
end

local function Get_HMC_Paths(project_root)
	local directory = Get_HMC_Directory(project_root)

	return {
		directory = directory,
		layout = Join(directory, "layout.json"),
		config = Join(directory, "config.json"),
		basics = Join(directory, "basics.json"),
		history = Join(directory, "project.bin"),
	}
end

-- =========================================================
-- FILESYSTEM
-- =========================================================

local function Ensure_Directory(path)
	if vim.fn.isdirectory(path) == 1 then
		return true
	end

	local result = vim.fn.mkdir(path, "p")

	if result == 0 and vim.fn.isdirectory(path) ~= 1 then
		return false, "Could not create directory: " .. path
	end

	return true
end

local function Read_File(path)
	local file = io.open(path, "rb")

	if not file then
		return nil
	end

	local content = file:read("*a")
	file:close()

	return content
end

local function Write_File(path, content)
	local file, err = io.open(path, "wb")

	if not file then
		return false, err
	end

	local ok, write_err = file:write(content)

	if not ok then
		file:close()
		return false, write_err
	end

	local closed, close_err = file:close()

	if closed == nil then
		return false, close_err
	end

	return true
end

local function Read_JSON(path, fallback)
	local content = Read_File(path)

	if not content or content == "" then
		return vim.deepcopy(fallback)
	end

	local ok, data = pcall(vim.json.decode, content)

	if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
		return nil, "Invalid JSON: " .. path
	end

	return data
end

local function Write_JSON(path, data)
	local ok, encoded = pcall(vim.json.encode, data)

	if not ok then
		return false, encoded
	end

	return Write_File(path, encoded .. "\n")
end

-- =========================================================
-- DIRECTORY CAPTURE
-- =========================================================

local function Capture_Directory(project_root)
	local entries = {}
	local errors = {}

	local function Is_Sensitive_File(name)
		local lower = name:lower()
		if lower == ".env.example" or lower == ".env.sample" or lower == ".env.template" then return false end
		if lower == ".env" or lower:match("^%.env%.") then return true end
		if lower == ".npmrc" or lower == ".pypirc" or lower == ".netrc" then return true end
		return lower == "id_rsa" or lower == "id_ed25519" or lower:match("%.pem$") ~= nil
			or lower:match("%.p12$") ~= nil or lower:match("%.pfx$") ~= nil or lower:match("%.key$") ~= nil
	end

	local function Scan(directory, relative)
		local handle, err = uv.fs_scandir(directory)

		if not handle then
			errors[#errors + 1] = tostring(err)
			return
		end

		while true do
			local name, kind = uv.fs_scandir_next(handle)

			if not name then
				break
			end

			local metadata_path = name == ".git" or name == ".hmc"
			if not metadata_path and not (kind == "directory" and IGNORED_DIRECTORIES[name]) then
				local relative_path = relative == "" and name or relative .. "/" .. name

				local full_path = Join(directory, name)

				if kind == "directory" then
					entries[#entries + 1] = {
						path = relative_path,
						type = "directory",
					}

					Scan(full_path, relative_path)
				elseif kind == "file" then
					local stat = uv.fs_stat(full_path)

					local entry = {
						path = relative_path,
						type = "file",
						content_saved = false,
					}

					if Is_Sensitive_File(name) then
						entry.skip_reason = "Potential secret or credential file"
					elseif not stat then
						entry.skip_reason = "Could not inspect file"
					elseif stat.size > MAX_LAYOUT_FILE_SIZE then
						entry.skip_reason = "File exceeds 4 MiB capture limit"
					else
						local content = Read_File(full_path)
						-- Avoid saving likely binary files as text.
						if content and not content:find("\0", 1, true) then
							entry.content = content
							entry.content_saved = true
						else
							entry.skip_reason = "Binary or unreadable file"
						end
					end

					entries[#entries + 1] = entry
				end
			end
		end
	end

	Scan(project_root, "")

	table.sort(entries, function(a, b)
		return a.path < b.path
	end)

	return {
		version = DATA_VERSION,
		entries = entries,
		capture_errors = errors,
		captured_at = os.time(),
	}
end

-- =========================================================
-- DEFAULT CONFIGURATIONS
-- =========================================================

local function Default_Project_Config()
	return {
		version = DATA_VERSION,
		settings = {},
	}
end

local function Default_Basics(metadata)
	local project_name = metadata.name or vim.fs.basename(metadata.root)
	local git_marker = metadata.root .. "/.git"
	-- Git worktrees and submodules may use a .git *file*, not a directory.
	local git_enabled = vim.fn.isdirectory(git_marker) == 1 or vim.fn.filereadable(git_marker) == 1

	return {
		version = DATA_VERSION,
		project = {
			id = metadata.id or (vim.fn.sha256(metadata.root .. "|" .. tostring(os.time())):sub(1, 16)),
			name = project_name,
			root = metadata.root,
			language = metadata.language or "unknown",
			manager = metadata.manager or "native",
			creator = metadata.creator or os.getenv("USER") or "unknown",
			created_at = os.time(),
			entry_point = {
				file = metadata.entry_file or "",
				["function"] = metadata.entry_function or "main",
			},
		},
		git = {
			enabled = git_enabled,
		},
		conversion = metadata.conversion and {
			kind = metadata.conversion.kind or "folder_conversion",
			created_by = "hypermax",
			created_at = os.time(),
		} or nil,
	}
end

local function Default_Global_Config()
	return {
		version = DATA_VERSION,
		preferred_language = "c",
		base_location = Join(vim.fn.expand("~"), "Code"),
		preferred_manager = "native",
		settings = {},
		projects = {},
		last_project = "",
	}
end

-- =========================================================
-- PUBLIC PATH AND EXISTENCE FUNCTIONS
-- =========================================================

function Project_Config.Get_Paths(project_root)
	project_root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(project_root, ":p")
	return Get_HMC_Paths(project_root)
end

-- Checks whether the project's .hmc directory exists.
function Project_Config.Exists(project_root)
	project_root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(project_root, ":p")

	local hmc_directory = Get_HMC_Directory(project_root)

	return vim.fn.isdirectory(hmc_directory) == 1
end

-- =========================================================
-- GLOBAL CONFIGURATION
-- =========================================================

function Project_Config.Get_Global()
	local path = Project_Config.global_path or Get_Global_Config_Path()
	local parent = vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":h")

	local ok, err = Ensure_Directory(parent)

	if not ok then
		return nil, err
	end

	if vim.fn.filereadable(path) == 0 then
		local saved, save_err = Write_JSON(path, Default_Global_Config())

		if not saved then
			return nil, save_err
		end
	end

	local data, read_err = Read_JSON(path, Default_Global_Config())

	if not data then
		return nil, read_err
	end

	data.projects = type(data.projects) == "table" and data.projects or {}
	data.last_project = type(data.last_project) == "string" and data.last_project or ""
	data.settings = type(data.settings) == "table" and data.settings or {}

	return data
end

function Project_Config.Save_Global(data)
	local path = Project_Config.global_path or Get_Global_Config_Path()
	local ok, err = Ensure_Directory(vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":h"))

	if not ok then
		return false, err
	end

	data.version = DATA_VERSION
	data.projects = type(data.projects) == "table" and data.projects or {}
	data.last_project = type(data.last_project) == "string" and data.last_project or ""
	data.settings = type(data.settings) == "table" and data.settings or {}

	return Write_JSON(path, data)
end

-- =========================================================
-- CREATE PROJECT CONFIGURATION
-- =========================================================

function Project_Config.Create(project_root, metadata)
	project_root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(project_root, ":p")
	metadata = vim.deepcopy(metadata or {})
	metadata.root = project_root

	local paths = Get_HMC_Paths(project_root)

	if vim.fn.isdirectory(project_root) ~= 1 then
		return false, "Project directory does not exist: " .. project_root
	end

	if Project_Config.Exists(project_root) then
		return false, "This project already has a .hmc directory"
	end

	local ok, err = Ensure_Directory(paths.directory)

	if not ok then
		return false, err
	end

	local files = {
		{
			path = paths.basics,
			data = Default_Basics(metadata),
		},
		{
			path = paths.config,
			data = Default_Project_Config(),
		},
		{
			path = paths.layout,
			data = Capture_Directory(project_root),
		},
	}

	for _, item in ipairs(files) do
		local saved, save_err = Write_JSON(item.path, item.data)

		if not saved then
			pcall(vim.fn.delete, paths.directory, "rf")
			return false, save_err
		end
	end

	local history_saved, history_err = Write_File(paths.history, HISTORY_HEADER)

	if not history_saved then
		pcall(vim.fn.delete, paths.directory, "rf")
		return false, history_err
	end

	-- Project metadata is the durable project marker; the global index makes
	-- converted folders discoverable even when they are outside project_dir.
	local registered, register_error = Project_Config.Register_Project(project_root)
	if not registered then
		vim.notify("HyperMax: Project was created, but could not update the project index: " .. tostring(register_error), vim.log.levels.WARN)
	end

	return true, paths
end

-- =========================================================
-- LOAD PROJECT CONFIGURATION
-- =========================================================

local function Read_Legacy_Basics(paths)
	local candidates = {
		paths.basics,
		Join(paths.directory, "basic.json"),
		Join(paths.directory, "project.json"),
		Join(paths.directory, "metadata.json"),
		Join(paths.directory, "project_config.json"),
		Join(paths.directory, "hypermax.json"),
	}
	local empty_data
	for _, path in ipairs(candidates) do
		if vim.fn.filereadable(path) == 1 then
			local data, err = Read_JSON(path, {})
			if not data then return nil, err end
			if type(data.project) ~= "table" or next(data.project) == nil then
				local project_keys = { "name", "root", "language", "manager", "creator", "created_at", "entry_file", "entry_function", "entry_point", "project_name", "project_root" }
				local project = {}
				for _, key in ipairs(project_keys) do
					if data[key] ~= nil then project[key] = data[key] end
				end
				project.name = project.name or data.project_name
				project.root = project.root or data.project_root
				if next(project) then data.project = project end
			end
			if type(data.project) == "table" and next(data.project) then
				data.project.entry_point = data.project.entry_point or {
					file = data.project.entry_file or data.entry_file or "",
					["function"] = data.project.entry_function or data.entry_function or "main",
				}
				local git_marker = vim.fn.fnamemodify(paths.directory, ":h") .. "/.git"
				data.git = data.git or { enabled = vim.fn.isdirectory(git_marker) == 1 or vim.fn.filereadable(git_marker) == 1 }
				return data
			end
			empty_data = data
		end
	end
	return empty_data or {}, nil
end

local function Read_Legacy_Config(paths)
	if vim.fn.filereadable(paths.config) == 1 then
		return Read_JSON(paths.config, Default_Project_Config())
	end
	for _, path in ipairs({ Join(paths.directory, "settings.json"), Join(paths.directory, "options.json") }) do
		if vim.fn.filereadable(path) == 1 then
			local data, err = Read_JSON(path, Default_Project_Config())
			if not data then return nil, err end
			if type(data.settings) ~= "table" then data = { version = data.version or DATA_VERSION, settings = data } end
			return data
		end
	end
	return Default_Project_Config(), nil
end

local function Read_Legacy_Layout(paths)
	local candidates = { paths.layout, Join(paths.directory, "tree.json"), Join(paths.directory, "files.json"), Join(paths.directory, "project_layout.json") }
	for _, path in ipairs(candidates) do
		if vim.fn.filereadable(path) == 1 then
			local data, err = Read_JSON(path, { version = DATA_VERSION, entries = {} })
			if not data then return nil, err end
			if type(data.entries) ~= "table" and type(data.files) == "table" then data.entries = data.files end
			data.entries = data.entries or {}
			data.version = data.version or DATA_VERSION
			return data
		end
	end
	return { version = DATA_VERSION, entries = {} }, nil
end

function Project_Config.Load(project_root)
	project_root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(project_root, ":p")

	local paths = Get_HMC_Paths(project_root)

	if not Project_Config.Exists(project_root) then
		return nil, "No .hmc directory exists in this project"
	end

	local basics, basics_err = Read_Legacy_Basics(paths)
	local config, config_err = Read_Legacy_Config(paths)
	local layout, layout_err = Read_Legacy_Layout(paths)

	if not basics then
		return nil, basics_err
	end

	if not config then
		return nil, config_err
	end

	if not layout then
		return nil, layout_err
	end

	return {
		root = project_root,
		paths = paths,
		basics = basics,
		config = config,
		layout = layout,
	}
end

-- =========================================================
-- GLOBAL PROJECT REGISTRY
-- =========================================================

local function Normalize_Project_Root(project_root)
	if type(project_root) ~= "string" or project_root == "" then
		return nil
	end

	local normalized = vim.fn.fnamemodify(vim.fn.expand(project_root), ":p")
	if normalized ~= "/" then
		normalized = normalized:gsub("/+$", "")
	end
	return normalized
end

function Project_Config.Register_Project(project_root, metadata)
	project_root = Normalize_Project_Root(project_root)
	if not project_root or not Project_Config.Exists(project_root) then
		return false, "Cannot register a folder without a .hmc project marker"
	end

	local loaded, load_error = Project_Config.Load(project_root)
	if not loaded then
		return false, load_error
	end

	local project = (loaded.basics and loaded.basics.project) or {}
	metadata = vim.deepcopy(metadata or {})
	local global, global_error = Project_Config.Get_Global()
	if not global then
		return false, global_error
	end

	local now = os.time() + (((uv.hrtime and uv.hrtime() or os.clock() * 1000000000) % 1000000) / 1000000)
	local latest_opened = 0
	for _, item in ipairs(global.projects or {}) do
		if type(item) == "table" then latest_opened = math.max(latest_opened, tonumber(item.last_opened) or 0) end
	end
	if now <= latest_opened then now = latest_opened + 0.000001 end
	local entry = nil
	local projects = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(global.projects or {}) do
		if type(item) == "table" then
			local item_path = Normalize_Project_Root(item.path or item.root)
			if item_path == project_root then
				entry = item
			elseif item_path then
				projects[#projects + 1] = item
			end
		end
	end

	entry = entry or { added_at = now }
	entry.id = project.id or entry.id or vim.fn.sha256(project_root):sub(1, 16)
	entry.name = metadata.name or project.name or vim.fs.basename(project_root)
	entry.path = project_root
	entry.language = metadata.language or project.language or "unknown"
	entry.manager = metadata.manager or project.manager or "native"
	entry.created_at = project.created_at or entry.created_at or now
	entry.last_opened = now
	projects[#projects + 1] = entry

	table.sort(projects, function(a, b)
		return (a.name or a.path or ""):lower() < (b.name or b.path or ""):lower()
	end)

	global.projects = projects
	global.last_project = project_root
	return Project_Config.Save_Global(global)
end

function Project_Config.Mark_Project_Opened(project_root)
	return Project_Config.Register_Project(project_root)
end

function Project_Config.Unregister_Project(project_root)
	project_root = Normalize_Project_Root(project_root)
	if not project_root then return false, "Project root is not a valid path" end
	local global, err = Project_Config.Get_Global()
	if not global then return false, err end
	local projects = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(global.projects or {}) do
		if type(entry) == "table" and Normalize_Project_Root(entry.path or entry.root) ~= project_root then
			projects[#projects + 1] = entry
		end
	end
	global.projects = projects
	if Normalize_Project_Root(global.last_project) == project_root then global.last_project = "" end
	return Project_Config.Save_Global(global)
end

function Project_Config.Get_Last_Project()
	local global, err = Project_Config.Get_Global()
	if not global then return nil, err end
	local path = Normalize_Project_Root(global.last_project)
	if path and Project_Config.Exists(path) then return path end

	local latest
	for _, entry in ipairs(global.projects or {}) do
		if type(entry) == "table" and Project_Config.Exists(entry.path) then
			if not latest or (entry.last_opened or 0) > (latest.last_opened or 0) then latest = entry end
		end
	end
	return latest and latest.path or nil
end

function Project_Config.List_Projects(project_directory)
	local global, err = Project_Config.Get_Global()
	if not global then return nil, err end
	local found = {}

	local function Add(path, registry_entry)
		path = Normalize_Project_Root(path)
		if not path or found[path] or not Project_Config.Exists(path) then return end
		local loaded = Project_Config.Load(path)
		if not loaded then return end
		local project = (loaded.basics and loaded.basics.project) or {}
		found[path] = {
			id = project.id or vim.fn.sha256(path):sub(1, 16),
			name = project.name or vim.fs.basename(path),
			path = path,
			language = project.language or "unknown",
			manager = project.manager or "native",
			created_at = project.created_at,
			added_at = type(registry_entry) == "table" and registry_entry.added_at or nil,
			last_opened = type(registry_entry) == "table" and registry_entry.last_opened or nil,
		}
	end

	for _, entry in ipairs(global.projects or {}) do
		if type(entry) == "table" then Add(entry.path or entry.root, entry) end
	end

	-- Discover direct children as a recovery path for projects created before
	-- the index existed or copied from another machine.
	if type(project_directory) == "string" and project_directory ~= "" then
		local directory = vim.fn.expand(project_directory)
		local scan = uv.fs_scandir(directory)
		if scan then
			while true do
				local name, kind = uv.fs_scandir_next(scan)
				if not name then break end
				if kind == "directory" and name ~= "." and name ~= ".." then Add(Join(directory, name)) end
			end
		end
	end

	local projects = {}
	for _, entry in pairs(found) do projects[#projects + 1] = entry end
	table.sort(projects, function(a, b)
		local at, bt = tonumber(a.last_opened) or 0, tonumber(b.last_opened) or 0
		if at ~= bt then return at > bt end
		local an, bn = (a.name or ""):lower(), (b.name or ""):lower()
		if an ~= bn then return an < bn end
		return a.path < b.path
	end)
	return projects
end

-- =========================================================
-- PROJECT CONVERSION / SCRAPING
-- =========================================================

function Project_Config.Convert_Folder(project_root, metadata)
	project_root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(vim.fn.expand(project_root or ""), ":p")
	if project_root == "" or vim.fn.isdirectory(project_root) ~= 1 then
		return false, "Choose an existing folder to convert"
	end
	if Project_Config.Exists(project_root) then return false, "Folder is already a HyperMax project" end
	metadata = vim.deepcopy(metadata or {})
	metadata.name = metadata.name or vim.fs.basename(project_root)
	metadata.language = metadata.language or "unknown"
	metadata.manager = metadata.manager or "native"
	metadata.entry_file = metadata.entry_file or ""
	metadata.entry_function = metadata.entry_function or "main"
	metadata.conversion = { kind = "folder_conversion" }
	return Project_Config.Create(project_root, metadata)
end

local function Remove_HMC(project_root, require_conversion)
	project_root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(vim.fn.expand(project_root or ""), ":p")
	local loaded, err = Project_Config.Load(project_root)
	if not loaded then return false, err end
	if require_conversion and not (loaded.basics.conversion and loaded.basics.conversion.kind == "folder_conversion") then
		return false, "This project was not created by folder conversion; refusing to undo it"
	end
	local directory = loaded.paths.directory
	local stat = uv.fs_lstat(directory)
	if not stat or stat.type ~= "directory" then return false, "The .hmc metadata path is not a real directory" end
	local backup = directory .. ".backup-" .. os.date("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
	local renamed, rename_err = uv.fs_rename(directory, backup)
	if not renamed then return false, "Could not safely back up .hmc: " .. tostring(rename_err) end
	local unregistered, unregister_error = Project_Config.Unregister_Project(project_root)
	if not unregistered then
		vim.notify("HyperMax: Metadata was backed up, but the global project index could not be updated: " .. tostring(unregister_error), vim.log.levels.WARN)
	end
	return true, backup
end

function Project_Config.Undo_Conversion(project_root)
	return Remove_HMC(project_root, true)
end

function Project_Config.Scrape(project_root)
	return Remove_HMC(project_root, false)
end

-- =========================================================
-- PROJECT SETTINGS
-- =========================================================

function Project_Config.Save_Project_Settings(project_root, settings)
	local paths = Get_HMC_Paths(vim.fn.fnamemodify(project_root, ":p"))

	if not Project_Config.Exists(project_root) then
		return false, "This project has no .hmc directory"
	end

	local config, err = Read_JSON(paths.config, Default_Project_Config())

	if not config then
		return false, err
	end

	config.settings = config.settings or {}

	for key, value in pairs(settings) do
		config.settings[key] = value
	end

	return Write_JSON(paths.config, config)
end

function Project_Config.Save_Setting(project_root, key, value)
	vim.ui.select({
		"This project only",
		"Global HyperMax defaults",
		"Cancel",
	}, {
		prompt = "Where should this setting be saved?",
	}, function(choice)
		if choice == "This project only" then
			local ok, err = Project_Config.Save_Project_Settings(project_root, { [key] = value })

			if not ok then
				vim.notify("HyperMax: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
				return
			end

			vim.notify("Saved to project configuration")
		elseif choice == "Global HyperMax defaults" then
			local global, err = Project_Config.Get_Global()

			if not global then
				vim.notify("HyperMax: " .. tostring(err), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
				return
			end

			global.settings = global.settings or {}
			global.settings[key] = value

			local ok, save_err = Project_Config.Save_Global(global)

			if not ok then
				vim.notify("HyperMax: " .. tostring(save_err), vim.log.levels.ERROR)
				return
			end

			vim.notify("Saved to global HyperMax configuration")
		end
	end)
end

return Project_Config

local Config = require("hypermax.config")
local Languages = require("hypermax.languages")

local Settings = {}

local Boolean_Settings = {
	create_missing_dir = "Create missing project directories",
	open_after_create = "Open project after creation",
	show_progress = "Show progress window",
	show_command_output = "Show command output",
	confirm_before_create = "Confirm before creating projects",
	create_readme = "Generate README.md",
	create_gitignore = "Generate .gitignore",
	create_credits = "Generate CREDITS.md",
	create_default_directories = "Generate default directories",
	remember_last_language = "Remember last language",
	remember_last_manager = "Remember last manager",
}

local function Notify(message)
	vim.notify("HyperMax: " .. message)
end

local function Save(key, value)
	Config.set(key, value)
	Notify("Saved " .. key .. ".")
end

local function Edit_Text(key, label)
	vim.ui.input({
		prompt = label .. ": ",
		default = tostring(Config.get(key) or ""),
	}, function(value)
		if value == nil then
			return
		end

		Save(key, value)
	end)
end

local function Edit_Boolean(key, label)
	local current = Config.get(key)

	vim.ui.select({ "Yes", "No" }, {
		prompt = label,
		format_item = function(item)
			if (item == "Yes") == current then
				return item .. "  (current)"
			end

			return item
		end,
	}, function(choice)
		if choice == nil then
			return
		end

		Save(key, choice == "Yes")
	end)
end

local function Edit_Language()
	local ids = Languages.Get_IDs()
	local favourites = Config.get("favourite_languages") or {}

	table.sort(ids, function(a, b)
		local function Is_Favourite(id)
			return vim.tbl_contains(favourites, id)
		end

		if Is_Favourite(a) ~= Is_Favourite(b) then
			return Is_Favourite(a)
		end

		return a < b
	end)

	vim.ui.select(ids, {
		prompt = "Choose default language",
		format_item = function(id)
			if vim.tbl_contains(favourites, id) then
				return "★ " .. id
			end

			return id
		end,
	}, function(choice)
		if choice then
			Save("default_language", choice)
		end
	end)
end

local function Edit_Favourites()
	local current = table.concat(Config.get("favourite_languages") or {}, ", ")

	vim.ui.input({
		prompt = "Favourite languages (comma-separated): ",
		default = current,
	}, function(value)
		if value == nil then
			return
		end

		local favourites = {}
		local seen = {}

		for id in value:gmatch("[^,]+") do
			id = vim.trim(id)

			if Languages.Exists(id) and not seen[id] then
				favourites[#favourites + 1] = id
				seen[id] = true
			elseif id ~= "" and not Languages.Exists(id) then
				Notify("Unknown language ignored: " .. id)
			end
		end

		Save("favourite_languages", favourites)
	end)
end

local function Edit_Manager()
	local Managers = require("hypermax.managers")
	local language = Config.get("default_language")
	local managers = Managers.Get_IDs(language)

	if #managers == 0 then
		Notify("No managers registered for " .. language .. ".")
		return
	end

	vim.ui.select(managers, {
		prompt = "Default manager for " .. language,
	}, function(choice)
		if choice then
			Save("default_manager", choice)
		end
	end)
end

local function Edit_Setting(key, label)
	if Boolean_Settings[key] then
		Edit_Boolean(key, label)
	elseif key == "default_language" then
		Edit_Language()
	elseif key == "favourite_languages" then
		Edit_Favourites()
	elseif key == "default_manager" then
		Edit_Manager()
	elseif key == "project_dir" then
		Edit_Text(key, label)
	elseif key == "default_layout" then
		Edit_Text(key, label)
	end
end

function Settings.Open()
	local entries = {
		{ label = "Default language", key = "default_language" },
		{ label = "Project starting location", key = "project_dir" },
		{ label = "Favourite languages", key = "favourite_languages" },
		{ label = "Default manager", key = "default_manager" },
		{ label = "Default layout ID", key = "default_layout" },
	}

	for key, label in pairs(Boolean_Settings) do
		entries[#entries + 1] = {
			label = label,
			key = key,
		}
	end

	table.sort(entries, function(a, b)
		return a.label < b.label
	end)

	local choices = {}

	for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
		local value = Config.get(entry.key)

		if type(value) == "table" then
			value = table.concat(value, ", ")
		end

		choices[#choices + 1] = {
			entry = entry,
			text = entry.label .. " = " .. tostring(value),
		}
	end

	choices[#choices + 1] = {
		reset = true,
		text = "Reset all settings to defaults",
	}

	vim.ui.select(choices, {
		prompt = "HyperMax Settings",
		format_item = function(item)
			return item.text
		end,
	}, function(choice)
		if not choice then
			return
		end

		if choice.reset then
			vim.ui.select({ "Cancel", "Reset" }, {
				prompt = "Reset all HyperMax settings?",
			}, function(answer)
				if answer == "Reset" then
					Config.reset()
					Notify("Settings reset.")
					Settings.Open()
				end
			end)

			return
		end

		Edit_Setting(choice.entry.key, choice.entry.label)
	end)
end

return Settings

-- HyperMax workspace home, command palette, project search and navigation.
local Workspace = {}

local Flow = require("hypermax.flow")
local Git = require("hypermax.git")
local Project_Config = require("hypermax.project_config")

local State = { buffer = nil, window = nil, root = nil, recent_projects = {}, recent_project_lines = {} }

local function Notify(message, level)
	vim.notify("HyperMax: " .. message, level or vim.log.levels.INFO)
end

local function Join(...)
	return table.concat({ ... }, "/"):gsub("/+", "/")
end

local function Normalize(path)
	if not path or path == "" then
		local current_buffer = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_name(0)
		path = current_buffer ~= "" and current_buffer or vim.fn.getcwd()
	end
	local absolute = vim.fn.fnamemodify(vim.fn.expand(path), ":p"):gsub("\\", "/")
	if absolute == "/" or absolute:match("^%a:/$") then return absolute end
	return absolute:gsub("/+$", "")
end

local function Find_Project_Root(path)
	path = Normalize(path)
	if vim.fn.filereadable(path) == 1 then path = vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":h") end
	while path and path ~= "" do
		if Project_Config.Exists(path) then return path end
		local parent = vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":h")
		if parent == path then break end
		path = parent
	end
	return nil
end

local function Close()
	if State.window and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(State.window) then
		local win = State.window
		State.window = nil
		pcall(vim.api.nvim_win_close, win, true)
	end
end

local function Open_Window()
	Close()
	local width = math.max(24, math.min(108, vim.o.columns - 4))
	local height = math.min(28, math.max(12, vim.o.lines - 6))
	local buf = vim.api.nvim_create_buf(false, true)
	vim.bo[buf].buftype = "nofile"
	vim.bo[buf].bufhidden = "wipe"
	vim.bo[buf].swapfile = false
	vim.bo[buf].filetype = "hypermaxworkspace"
	local win = vim.api.nvim_open_win(buf, true, {
		relative = "editor", style = "minimal", border = "rounded",
		width = width, height = height,
		row = math.max(1, math.floor((vim.o.lines - height) / 2) - 1),
		col = math.max(1, math.floor((vim.o.columns - width) / 2)),
		title = "  HYPERMAX  /  WORKSPACE  ", title_pos = "center",
	})
	vim.wo[win].number = false
	vim.wo[win].relativenumber = false
	vim.wo[win].signcolumn = "no"
	vim.wo[win].wrap = false
	vim.wo[win].cursorline = true
	vim.wo[win].winhl = "Normal:NormalFloat,FloatBorder:FloatBorder,CursorLine:CursorLine"
	State.buffer, State.window = buf, win
	return buf
end

local function Set_Lines(lines)
	if not State.buffer or not vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(State.buffer) then return end
	vim.api.nvim_set_hl(0, "HyperMaxWorkspaceTitle", { link = "Title", default = true })
	vim.api.nvim_set_hl(0, "HyperMaxWorkspaceSection", { link = "Special", default = true })
	vim.api.nvim_set_hl(0, "HyperMaxWorkspaceMuted", { link = "Comment", default = true })
	vim.api.nvim_set_hl(0, "HyperMaxWorkspaceKey", { link = "DiagnosticInfo", default = true })
	vim.bo[State.buffer].modifiable = true
	vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(State.buffer, 0, -1, false, lines)
	vim.bo[State.buffer].modifiable = false
	vim.bo[State.buffer].modified = false
	local namespace = vim.api.nvim_create_namespace("HyperMaxWorkspaceHighlights")
	vim.api.nvim_buf_clear_namespace(State.buffer, namespace, 0, -1)
	for index, line in ipairs(lines) do
		local group
		if index == 1 then group = "HyperMaxWorkspaceTitle"
		elseif line:match("^  PROJECT") or line:match("^  WORKSPACE$") or line:match("^  CUSTOMIZE$") then group = "HyperMaxWorkspaceSection"
		elseif line:match("^  %-+") or line:match("^  ◆") then group = "HyperMaxWorkspaceMuted"
		elseif line:match("^%s+[a-zA-Z/ ]+%s+") then group = "HyperMaxWorkspaceKey" end
		if group then vim.api.nvim_buf_add_highlight(State.buffer, namespace, group, index - 1, 0, -1) end
	end
end

local function Map(key, callback, description)
	vim.keymap.set("n", key, callback, { buffer = State.buffer, silent = true, nowait = true, desc = description })
end

local function Focus_Editor_Window()
	for _, win in ipairs(vim.api.nvim_tabpage_list_wins(0)) do
		if vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(win) and win ~= State.window then
			local config = vim.api.nvim_win_get_config(win)
			if not config.relative or config.relative == "" then
				vim.api.nvim_set_current_win(win)
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function Ensure_Editor_Window()
	local focused = Focus_Editor_Window()
	-- A dashboard floating over a terminal, edited file or quickfix list is
	-- confusing. Close the home screen as part of every navigation transition.
	Close()
	if focused then return true end
	local current = vim.api.nvim_get_current_win()
	if not current or not vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(current) then return false end
	local config = vim.api.nvim_win_get_config(current)
	return not config.relative or config.relative == ""
end

function Workspace.Git_Status(root)
	root = Find_Project_Root(root) or Normalize(root)
	if vim.fn.executable("git") ~= 1 then Notify("Git is not installed", vim.log.levels.WARN); return false end
	if not Ensure_Editor_Window() then Notify("Could not find an editor window for Git status", vim.log.levels.ERROR); return false end
	vim.cmd("botright 12new")
	vim.fn.termopen({ "git", "-C", root, "status", "--short", "--branch" }, { cwd = root })
	vim.cmd("startinsert")
	return true
end

local function Fallback_Find(root)
	local results, count = {}, 0
	local ignored = { [".git"] = true, [".hmc"] = true, ["node_modules"] = true, ["vendor"] = true, ["build"] = true, ["dist"] = true, ["target"] = true }
	local function walk(directory, depth)
		if depth > 12 or count >= 3000 then return end
		local scanner = (vim.uv or vim.loop).fs_scandir(directory)
		if not scanner then return end
		while count < 3000 do
			local name, kind = (vim.uv or vim.loop).fs_scandir_next(scanner)
			if not name then break end
			if not ignored[name] then
				local path = Join(directory, name)
				if kind == "directory" then walk(path, depth + 1)
				elseif kind == "file" then
					results[#results + 1] = path:sub(#root + 2)
					count = count + 1
				end
			end
		end
	end
	walk(root, 0)
	table.sort(results)
	return results
end

function Workspace.Find_Files(root)
	root = Find_Project_Root(root) or Normalize(root)
	local files
	if vim.fn.executable("rg") == 1 then
		files = vim.fn.systemlist({ "rg", "--files", "--hidden", "--glob", "!.git/**", "--glob", "!.hmc/**", root })
		if vim.v.shell_error ~= 0 and #files == 0 then files = {} end
		for index, path in ipairs(files) do
			if path:sub(1, #root + 1) == root .. "/" then files[index] = path:sub(#root + 2) end
		end
	else
		files = Fallback_Find(root)
	end
	if #files == 0 then Notify("No files found in " .. root, vim.log.levels.WARN); return end
	vim.ui.select(files, { prompt = "Find file in " .. vim.fs.basename(root) }, function(choice)
		if not choice then return end
		if not Ensure_Editor_Window() then Notify("Could not find an editor window", vim.log.levels.ERROR); return end
		local path = Join(root, choice)
		vim.cmd("edit " .. vim.fn.fnameescape(path))
	end)
end

function Workspace.Scan_Todos(root)
	root = Find_Project_Root(root) or Normalize(root)
	if vim.fn.executable("rg") ~= 1 then
		Notify("TODO scanning requires ripgrep (rg)", vim.log.levels.WARN)
		return false
	end
	local output = vim.fn.systemlist({
		"rg", "--vimgrep", "--hidden", "--glob", "!.git/**", "--glob", "!.hmc/**",
		"--", "\\b(TODO|FIXME|BUG|HACK)\\b", root,
	})
	local items = {}
	for _, line in ipairs(output) do
		local path, row, col, text = line:match("^(.*):(%d+):(%d+):(.*)$")
		if path and row and col then
			items[#items + 1] = { filename = path, lnum = tonumber(row), col = tonumber(col), text = text }
		end
	end
	if #items == 0 then
		Notify("No TODO, FIXME, BUG or HACK markers found", vim.log.levels.INFO)
		return true
	end
	vim.fn.setqflist({}, " ", { title = "HyperMax project markers", items = items })
	if not Ensure_Editor_Window() then Notify("Could not open the quickfix list", vim.log.levels.ERROR); return false end
	vim.cmd("copen")
	return true
end

function Workspace.Search_Text(root, query)
	root = Find_Project_Root(root) or Normalize(root)
	if not query or vim.trim(query) == "" then
		vim.ui.input({ prompt = "Search project text: " }, function(value)
			if value and value ~= "" then Workspace.Search_Text(root, value) end
		end)
		return
	end
	if vim.fn.executable("rg") ~= 1 then
		Notify("Text search requires ripgrep (rg). File finding still works without it.", vim.log.levels.WARN)
		return false
	end
	local output = vim.fn.systemlist({ "rg", "--vimgrep", "--hidden", "--glob", "!.git/**", "--glob", "!.hmc/**", "--", query, root })
	local items = {}
	for _, line in ipairs(output) do
		local path, row, col, text = line:match("^(.*):(%d+):(%d+):(.*)$")
		if path and row and col then
			items[#items + 1] = { filename = path, lnum = tonumber(row), col = tonumber(col), text = text }
		end
	end
	if #items == 0 then
		Notify("No matches for: " .. query, vim.log.levels.INFO)
		return true
	end
	vim.fn.setqflist({}, " ", { title = "HyperMax search: " .. query, items = items })
	if not Ensure_Editor_Window() then Notify("Could not open the quickfix list", vim.log.levels.ERROR); return false end
	vim.cmd("copen")
	return true
end

local function Open_Buffers()
	local choices = {}
	for _, buffer in ipairs(vim.fn.getbufinfo({ buflisted = 1 })) do
		if buffer.name ~= "" then
			choices[#choices + 1] = { bufnr = buffer.bufnr, name = buffer.name, text = vim.fn.fnamemodify(buffer.name, ":~:.") }
		end
	end
	if #choices == 0 then Notify("No named buffers are open", vim.log.levels.WARN); return end
	vim.ui.select(choices, { prompt = "Switch buffer", format_item = function(item) return item.text end }, function(choice)
		if choice and Ensure_Editor_Window() then vim.api.nvim_set_current_buf(choice.bufnr) end
	end)
end

local function Project_Diagnostics(root)
	local result = { items = {}, errors = 0, warnings = 0, info = 0, hints = 0 }
	if not root or type(vim.diagnostic.get) ~= "function" then return result end
	local severity = vim.diagnostic.severity or {}
	for _, bufnr in ipairs(vim.api.nvim_list_bufs()) do
		if vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(bufnr) then
			local filename = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_name(bufnr)
			if filename ~= "" then
				filename = Normalize(filename)
				if filename == root or filename:sub(1, #root + 1) == root .. "/" then
					for _, diagnostic in ipairs(vim.diagnostic.get(bufnr)) do
						local level = diagnostic.severity or severity.INFO
						local kind = level == severity.ERROR and "E"
							or (level == severity.WARN and "W")
							or (level == severity.HINT and "H") or "I"
						if kind == "E" then result.errors = result.errors + 1
						elseif kind == "W" then result.warnings = result.warnings + 1
						elseif kind == "H" then result.hints = result.hints + 1
						else result.info = result.info + 1 end
						result.items[#result.items + 1] = {
							filename = filename,
							lnum = (diagnostic.lnum or 0) + 1,
							col = (diagnostic.col or 0) + 1,
							text = diagnostic.message or "Diagnostic",
							type = kind == "H" and "I" or kind,
						}
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(result.items, function(a, b)
		if a.filename ~= b.filename then return a.filename < b.filename end
		if a.lnum ~= b.lnum then return a.lnum < b.lnum end
		return a.col < b.col
	end)
	return result
end

function Workspace.Diagnostics(root)
	root = Find_Project_Root(root) or Normalize(root)
	local diagnostics = Project_Diagnostics(root)
	if #diagnostics.items == 0 then
		Notify("No diagnostics are currently reported for this project", vim.log.levels.INFO)
		return true
	end
	vim.fn.setqflist({}, " ", { title = "HyperMax project diagnostics", items = diagnostics.items })
	if not Ensure_Editor_Window() then
		Notify("Could not open the diagnostics list", vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return false
	end
	vim.cmd("copen")
	return true
end

local function Open_Recent_Project(index)
	local entry = State.recent_projects[index]
	if not entry or not entry.path then
		Notify("No project is assigned to shortcut " .. tostring(index), vim.log.levels.WARN)
		return false
	end
	Close()
	vim.cmd("tcd " .. vim.fn.fnameescape(entry.path))
	return require("hypermax.dashboard").Open(entry.path)
end

local function Load_Recent_Projects()
	local config_ok, Config = pcall(require, "hypermax.config")
	local directory = config_ok and Config.options and Config.options.project_dir or "~/Projects"
	local ok, projects = pcall(Project_Config.List_Projects, directory)
	State.recent_projects = {}
	State.recent_project_lines = {}
	if ok and type(projects) == "table" then
		for index = 1, math.min(3, #projects) do
			State.recent_projects[index] = projects[index]
		end
	end
end

function Workspace.Palette(root)
	root = Find_Project_Root(root) or Normalize(root)
	local actions = Actions(root)
	vim.ui.select(actions, {
		prompt = "HyperMax Command Palette",
		format_item = function(item) return item.label .. "  —  " .. item.detail end,

			Close()

		end

local function Render()
	local root = State.root
	Load_Recent_Projects()
	local lines = {
		"  ◆  HYPERMAX",
		"  One workspace for projects, code, builds and delivery.",
		"",
	}
	if root then
		local git = Git.Snapshot(root)
		local summary = Flow.Get_Summary(root) or { todo = 0, doing = 0, done = 0, runners = 0, total = 0 }
		local diagnostics = Project_Diagnostics(root)
		local name = vim.fs.basename(root)
		lines[#lines + 1] = "  PROJECT  /  " .. name
		lines[#lines + 1] = "  " .. root
		lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("  %s  ·  %d changed files  ·  %d tasks open  ·  %d run configs",
			git.available and ("Git " .. (git.branch or "")) or "Git not initialized",
			vim.tbl_count(git.statuses or {}), summary.todo + summary.doing, summary.runners)
		local percent = summary.total > 0 and math.floor((summary.done / summary.total) * 100) or 0
		local filled = math.floor((percent / 100) * 12)
		local progress = string.rep("█", filled) .. string.rep("░", 12 - filled)
		lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("  Diagnostics: %d errors · %d warnings · %d other   Tasks: %d/%d [%s] %d%%",
			diagnostics.errors, diagnostics.warnings, diagnostics.info + diagnostics.hints,
			summary.done, summary.total, progress, percent)
	else
		lines[#lines + 1] = "  No HyperMax project is active. Create, convert or switch to a project to unlock project tools."
	end
	if #State.recent_projects > 0 then
		lines[#lines + 1] = ""
		lines[#lines + 1] = "  RECENT PROJECTS  /  SELECT A ROW AND PRESS ENTER"
		for index, project in ipairs(State.recent_projects) do
			local language = project.language and project.language ~= "unknown" and (" · " .. project.language) or ""
			lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("   %d   %s%s   —   %s", index, project.name or vim.fs.basename(project.path), language, vim.fn.fnamemodify(project.path, ":~"))
			State.recent_project_lines[#lines] = index
		end
	end
	lines[#lines + 1] = ""
	lines[#lines + 1] = "  WORKSPACE"
	lines[#lines + 1] = "  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────"
	lines[#lines + 1] = "   p   Switch project                 n   New project"
	lines[#lines + 1] = "   e   Project explorer               o   Open recent project"
	lines[#lines + 1] = "   t   Task board                     w   Run configurations"
	lines[#lines + 1] = "   f   Find files                     /   Search project text"
	lines[#lines + 1] = "   d   Find TODO / FIXME markers      x   Project diagnostics"
	lines[#lines + 1] = "   g   Git status                     b   Switch buffer"
	lines[#lines + 1] = ""
	lines[#lines + 1] = "  CUSTOMIZE"
	lines[#lines + 1] = "  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────"
	lines[#lines + 1] = "   l   Save layout                    L   Apply layout"
	lines[#lines + 1] = "   s   Settings                       h   Health checks"
	lines[#lines + 1] = ""
	lines[#lines + 1] = "  SPACE  Command palette              q   Close workspace"
	Set_Lines(lines)
	if State.window and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(State.window) then
		local first_recent_line
		for line in pairs(State.recent_project_lines) do
			if not first_recent_line or line < first_recent_line then first_recent_line = line end
		end
		if first_recent_line then vim.api.nvim_win_set_cursor(State.window, { first_recent_line, 0 }) end
	end
end

function Workspace.Open(root)
	State.root = Find_Project_Root(root) or Find_Project_Root(vim.fn.getcwd()) or nil
	if State.root then
		local marked, mark_error = Project_Config.Mark_Project_Opened(State.root)
		if not marked then Notify("Workspace opened, but recent-project history could not be updated: " .. tostring(mark_error), vim.log.levels.WARN) end
	end
	Open_Window()
	Map("q", Close, "Close HyperMax workspace")
	Map(" ", function() Workspace.Palette(State.root or vim.fn.getcwd()) end, "Open command palette")
	Map("p", function() Close(); require("hypermax.project").List() end, "Switch project")
	Map("n", function() Close(); require("hypermax.project").Create(require("hypermax.config").options) end, "Create project")
	Map("o", function() Close(); require("hypermax.project").Open_Last() end, "Open recent project")
	Map("e", function() local root = State.root; Close(); if root then require("hypermax.dashboard").Open(root) else Notify("Choose a project first", vim.log.levels.WARN) end end, "Open project explorer")
	Map("t", function() local root = State.root; Close(); Flow.Open_Tasks(root) end, "Open task board")
	Map("w", function() local root = State.root; Close(); Flow.Open_Runners(root) end, "Open run configurations")
	Map("f", function() Workspace.Find_Files(State.root or vim.fn.getcwd()) end, "Find project file")
	Map("/", function() Workspace.Search_Text(State.root or vim.fn.getcwd()) end, "Search project text")
	Map("d", function() Workspace.Scan_Todos(State.root or vim.fn.getcwd()) end, "Find TODO and FIXME markers")
	Map("x", function() Workspace.Diagnostics(State.root or vim.fn.getcwd()) end, "Show project diagnostics")
	Map("g", function() Workspace.Git_Status(State.root or vim.fn.getcwd()) end, "Show Git status")
	Map("b", Open_Buffers, "Switch buffer")
	Map("<CR>", function()
		if not State.window or not vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(State.window) then return end
		local line = vim.api.nvim_win_get_cursor(State.window)[1]
		local index = State.recent_project_lines[line]
		if index then Open_Recent_Project(index)
		else Notify("Move the cursor to a recent-project row, or press p to open the project picker", vim.log.levels.INFO) end
	end, "Open the selected recent project")
	Map("l", function() Close(); require("hypermax.project").Save_Layout() end, "Save current directory as a layout")
	Map("L", function() Close(); require("hypermax.project").Load_Layout() end, "Apply a project layout")
	Map("s", function() Close(); require("hypermax.settings").Open() end, "Open settings")
	Map("h", function() Close(); require("hypermax.keymaps").Run_Health_Check() end, "Run health checks")
	Render()
	return true
end

function Workspace.Close()
	Close()
end

function Workspace.Get_State()
	return State
end

-- HYPERMAX DASHBOARD RUNTIME TESTS
-- =========================================================
--
-- Run from the repository root:
-- nvim --headless -u NONE -c "set rtp+=." -c "luafile tests/test_dashboard.lua"
--
-- These tests exercise real Neovim buffers and keymaps.
-- They are not substitutes for testing with your normal UI
-- plugin configuration (such as dressing.nvim).
-- =========================================================

local Passed = 0
local Failed = 0
local Failures = {}

-- Keep dashboard/project metadata tests isolated from the user's real global
-- project registry, and restore the original path after this file completes.
local Project_Config = require("hypermax.project_config")
local original_global_path = Project_Config.global_path
local test_global_root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(vim.fn.tempname(), ":p")
Project_Config.global_path = test_global_root .. "/hypermax/config.json"

local function Test(Name, Callback)
	local ok, err = xpcall(Callback, debug.traceback)

	if ok then
		Passed = Passed + 1
		print("[PASS] Dashboard: " .. Name)
	else
		Failed = Failed + 1
		Failures[#Failures + 1] = {
			name = Name,
			error = tostring(err),
		}

		print("[FAIL] Dashboard: " .. Name)
		print(tostring(err))
	end
end

local function Assert(Value, Message)
	if not Value then
		error(Message or "Assertion failed", 2)
	end
end

local function Assert_Valid_Buffer(Buffer, Message)
	Assert(type(Buffer) == "number" and vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(Buffer), Message or "Expected a valid Neovim buffer")
end

local function Flush_Scheduled_Callbacks()
	-- Let queued Neovim callbacks run.
	vim.wait(100, function()
		return false
	end)
end

local function Create_Test_Directory()
	local Path = vim.fn.fnamemodify(vim.fn.tempname(), ":p")
	vim.fn.mkdir(Path .. "/.hmc", "p")

	local Basics = {
		version = 1,
		project = {
			name = "DashboardTest",
			root = Path,
			language = "c",
			manager = "native",
			creator = "tests",
			created_at = os.time(),
			entry_point = {
				file = "src/main.c",
				["function"] = "main",
			},
		},
		git = { enabled = false },
	}

	vim.fn.mkdir(Path .. "/src", "p")

	local config_file = assert(io.open(Path .. "/.hmc/basics.json", "w"))
	config_file:write(vim.json.encode(Basics))
	config_file:close()

	local main_file = assert(io.open(Path .. "/src/main.c", "w"))
	main_file:write("int main(void) { return 0; }\n")
	main_file:close()

	return Path
end

local function Remove_Test_Directory(Path)
	if Path and Path ~= "" then
		vim.fn.delete(Path, "rf")
	end
end

-- Simulate a dashboard buffer being deleted and then opened
-- again. This helps detect stale buffer IDs in keymap setup.
local Dashboard = require("hypermax.dashboard")
Test("Dashboard: dashboard can reopen after its buffer is deleted", function()
	local Root = Create_Test_Directory()
	local ok, err = pcall(Dashboard.Open, Root)
	Assert(ok, "Dashboard open failed: " .. tostring(err))

	local state = Dashboard.Get_State()
	local old_buffer = state.buffer
	local old_window = state.window

	Assert(vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(old_buffer), "Dashboard buffer should initially be valid")
	Assert(vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(old_window), "Dashboard panel window should initially be valid")

	local editor_window
	for _, win in ipairs(vim.api.nvim_tabpage_list_wins(0)) do
		if win ~= old_window then
			editor_window = win
			break
		end
	end
	Assert(editor_window ~= nil, "Dashboard should leave an editor window beside the panel")
	vim.api.nvim_set_current_win(editor_window)
	-- Neovim will keep a buffer alive while a window still displays it.
	-- Replace the panel's buffer first, then verify the old one can be wiped.
	local replacement_buffer = vim.api.nvim_create_buf(false, true)
	vim.api.nvim_win_set_buf(old_window, replacement_buffer)
	vim.api.nvim_buf_delete(old_buffer, { force = true })

	Assert(not vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(old_buffer), "Old dashboard buffer should be deleted")

	local reopened, reopen_err = pcall(Dashboard.Open, Root)
	Assert(reopened, "Dashboard should reopen after deletion: " .. tostring(reopen_err))
	Assert(vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf()), "Current buffer should be valid after reopening")
	if vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(replacement_buffer) then
		pcall(vim.api.nvim_buf_delete, replacement_buffer, { force = true })
	end

	Remove_Test_Directory(Root)
end)

local function New_Project()
	local root = vim.fn.fnamemodify(vim.fn.tempname(), ":p")
	vim.fn.mkdir(root .. "/.hmc", "p")
	vim.fn.mkdir(root .. "/src", "p")
	local basics = {
		version = 1,
		project = { name = "DeepTest", root = root, language = "c", manager = "native", creator = "tests", created_at = os.time(), entry_point = { file = "src/main.c", ["function"] = "main" } },
		git = { enabled = false },
	}
	local config = assert(io.open(root .. "/.hmc/basics.json", "w")); config:write(vim.json.encode(basics)); config:close()
	local main = assert(io.open(root .. "/src/main.c", "w")); main:write("int main(void) { return 0; }\n"); main:close()
	return root
end
local function Cleanup(root) if root then pcall(vim.fn.delete, root, "rf") end end
local function Open(root)
	local ok = Dashboard.Open(root)
	Test.True(ok, "Dashboard failed to open project")
	return Dashboard.Get_State()
end

local invalid_create_paths = {
	"", " ", ".", "..", "./x", "../x", "../../x", "/tmp/x", "~/x", "C:/x",
	"src/../x", "src/./x", "a/../../x", "\\\\server\\share", "C:\\temp\\x",
	"x\0y", "x\ny", "x\ty", "   /tmp/x", "~user/file", "//tmp/x", "../project/file",

		local root = New_Project(); Open(root)

local valid_create_paths = {

	{ ".hidden", "file" }, { "folder.with.dots/file.ext", "file" }, { "unicode/é.txt", "file" },
}

	Test.Run("Dashboard creates valid path " .. i, function()

Test.Run("Dashboard sort cycling wraps and keeps mode names valid", function()

	-- Sorting mode is intentionally persistent across projects. Reset it here

local function Cleanup(root) if root then pcall(vim.fn.delete, root, "rf") end end

local unsafe = {

	{ "windows drive lower", "d:\\escape" }, { "backslash traversal", "..\\escape" },
	{ "embedded traversal", "src/../escape" }, { "nested dot", "src/./file" },
	{ "nul byte", "src/\0bad" }, { "newline", "src/bad\nname" }, { "tab", "src/bad\tname" },
	{ "escape twice", "../../../../escape" }, { "leading whitespace absolute", " /tmp/escape" },
	{ "only slash", "/" }, { "root slash", "//server/share" },
}
for _, case in ipairs(unsafe) do

local Test = require("tests.testlib")
local Languages = require("hypermax.languages")
local Managers = require("hypermax.managers")

local Version_Flags = {
	"--version",
	"-v",
	"-V",
}

local No_Version_Check = {
	html = true,
	sql = true,
	assembly = true,
	tcl = true,
}

local No_Manager_Version_Check = {
	tclsh = true,
}

local function Is_Executable(executable)
	return executable ~= nil and executable ~= "" and vim.fn.executable(executable) == 1
end

local function Get_Version(executable)
	for _, flag in ipairs(Version_Flags) do
		local output = vim.fn.systemlist({ executable, flag })
		local exit_code = vim.v.shell_error

		if exit_code == 0 and output and #output > 0 then
			return true, table.concat(output, "\n"), flag
		end
	end

	return false, nil, nil
end

local function First_Line(text)
	if not text then
		return ""
	end

	return text:match("([^\n]*)") or ""
end

-- =========================================================
-- INSTALLED LANGUAGE ENVIRONMENT
-- =========================================================

Test.Run("Environment: inspect registered language executables", function()
	local installed = 0
	local missing = 0
	local skipped = 0
	local version_failed = 0

	for _, id in ipairs(Languages.Get_IDs()) do
		local executable = Languages.Get_Executable(id)

		if No_Version_Check[id] then
			skipped = skipped + 1
			print("[NO VERSION CHECK] " .. id)
		elseif not executable or executable == "" then
			skipped = skipped + 1
			print("[UNCONFIGURED] " .. id .. " has no executable")
		elseif not Is_Executable(executable) then
			missing = missing + 1
			print("[MISSING] " .. id .. " -> " .. executable)
		else
			installed = installed + 1

			local ok, version, flag = Get_Version(executable)

			if ok then
				print("[INSTALLED] " .. id .. " -> " .. executable .. " [" .. flag .. "] " .. First_Line(version))
			else
				version_failed = version_failed + 1

				print("[VERSION FAILED] " .. id .. " -> " .. executable .. " (tried --version, -v, -V)")
			end
		end
	end

	print("")
	print("Language environment summary:")
	print("  Installed:       " .. installed)
	print("  Missing:         " .. missing)
	print("  Skipped:         " .. skipped)
	print("  Version failures:" .. version_failed)
end)

Test.Run("Environment: inspect registered manager executables", function()
	local seen = {}
	local installed = 0
	local missing = 0
	local skipped = 0
	local version_failed = 0

	for language_id, manager_entries in pairs(Managers.registry) do
		for manager_id, manager in pairs(manager_entries) do
			local executable = manager.executable

			if not executable or executable == "" then
				skipped = skipped + 1
			elseif seen[executable] then
				-- Test each unique executable only once.
			else
				seen[executable] = true

				if not Is_Executable(executable) then
					missing = missing + 1

					print(
						"[MISSING MANAGER] "
							.. manager_id
							.. " -> "
							.. executable
							.. " (language: "
							.. language_id
							.. ")"
					)
				elseif No_Manager_Version_Check[executable] then
					skipped = skipped + 1

					print("[NO VERSION CHECK] " .. executable .. " (manager)")
				else
					installed = installed + 1

					local ok, version, flag = Get_Version(executable)

					if ok then
						print(
							"[INSTALLED MANAGER] "
								.. manager_id
								.. " -> "
								.. executable
								.. " ["
								.. flag
								.. "] "
								.. First_Line(version)
						)
					else
						version_failed = version_failed + 1

						print("[MANAGER VERSION FAILED] " .. executable .. " (tried --version, -v, -V)")
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	print("")
	print("Project manager environment summary:")
	print("  Installed:       " .. installed)
	print("  Missing:         " .. missing)
	print("  Skipped:         " .. skipped)
	print("  Version failures:" .. version_failed)
end)

-- Tiny pure-Lua test runner for HyperMax.
-- No third-party test framework.

local Test = {
	passed = 0,
	failed = 0,
	total = 0,
	failures = {},
}

-- =========================================================
-- TERMINAL COLORS
-- =========================================================

local Colors = {
	Reset = "\27[0m",
	Red = "\27[31m",
	Green = "\27[32m",
	Yellow = "\27[33m",
	Blue = "\27[34m",
	Magenta = "\27[35m",
	Cyan = "\27[36m",
	Gray = "\27[90m",
}

-- =========================================================
-- STATUS COLORS
-- =========================================================

local Status_Colors = {
	["[PASS]"] = Colors.Green,
	["[FAIL]"] = Colors.Red,

	["[INSTALLED]"] = Colors.Green,
	["[MISSING]"] = Colors.Red,
	["[UNCONFIGURED]"] = Colors.Yellow,
	["[SKIPPED]"] = Colors.Yellow,

	["[NO VERSION CHECK]"] = Colors.Gray,
	["[VERSION FAILED]"] = Colors.Magenta,
	["[MANAGER VERSION FAILED]"] = Colors.Magenta,

	["[INSTALLED MANAGER]"] = Colors.Green,
	["[MISSING MANAGER]"] = Colors.Red,

	["[INFO]"] = Colors.Blue,
	["[WARNING]"] = Colors.Yellow,
	["[ERROR]"] = Colors.Red,
}

-- Longest tags first, so manager statuses are matched correctly.
local Status_Tags = {
	"[MANAGER VERSION FAILED]",
	"[INSTALLED MANAGER]",
	"[MISSING MANAGER]",
	"[NO VERSION CHECK]",
	"[VERSION FAILED]",
	"[UNCONFIGURED]",
	"[INSTALLED]",
	"[MISSING]",
	"[SKIPPED]",
	"[WARNING]",
	"[ERROR]",
	"[INFO]",
	"[PASS]",
	"[FAIL]",
}

-- =========================================================
-- OUTPUT HELPERS
-- =========================================================

local function Write_Line(message)
	io.stdout:write(tostring(message), "\n")
	io.stdout:flush()
end

local function Color_Status(message)
	for _, tag in ipairs(Status_Tags) do
		local color = Status_Colors[tag]

		if message:sub(1, #tag) == tag then
			return color .. tag .. Colors.Reset .. message:sub(#tag + 1)
		end
	end

	return message
end

-- Color status tags from all test files automatically.
-- Existing print("message") calls continue to work.
_G.print = function(...)
	local values = {}

	for i = 1, select("#", ...) do
		values[i] = tostring(select(i, ...))
	end

	local message = table.concat(values, "\t")
	Write_Line(Color_Status(message))
end

local function Value(value)
	if type(value) == "string" then
		return string.format("%q", value)
	end

	return tostring(value) .. " (" .. type(value) .. ")"
end

local function Print_Status(color, status, message)
	Write_Line(color .. "[" .. status .. "]" .. Colors.Reset .. " " .. message)
end

-- =========================================================
-- TEST RUNNER
-- =========================================================

function Test.Run(name, callback)
	Test.total = Test.total + 1

	local ok, err = xpcall(callback, debug.traceback)

	if ok then
		Test.passed = Test.passed + 1
		Print_Status(Colors.Green, "PASS", name)
		return true
	end

	Test.failed = Test.failed + 1

	Test.failures[#Test.failures + 1] = {
		name = name,
		error = tostring(err),
	}

	Print_Status(Colors.Red, "FAIL", name)

	Write_Line(Colors.Red .. "       " .. tostring(err):gsub("\n", "\n       ") .. Colors.Reset)

	return false
end

-- =========================================================
-- ASSERTIONS
-- =========================================================

function Test.Equal(expected, actual, message)
	if expected ~= actual then
		error(
			(message or "Values are not equal")
				.. "\n  expected: "
				.. Value(expected)
				.. "\n  actual:   "
				.. Value(actual),
			2
		)
	end
end

function Test.Not_Equal(expected, actual, message)
	if expected == actual then
		error(message or ("Expected values to differ, both were " .. Value(actual)), 2)
	end
end

function Test.True(value, message)
	if value ~= true then
		error((message or "Expected true") .. "; got " .. Value(value), 2)
	end
end

function Test.False(value, message)
	if value ~= false then
		error((message or "Expected false") .. "; got " .. Value(value), 2)
	end
end

function Test.Nil(value, message)
	if value ~= nil then
		error((message or "Expected nil") .. "; got " .. Value(value), 2)
	end
end

function Test.Not_Nil(value, message)
	if value == nil then
		error(message or "Expected a non-nil value", 2)
	end
end

function Test.Type(expected_type, value, message)
	if type(value) ~= expected_type then
		error((message or "Unexpected type") .. "; expected " .. expected_type .. ", got " .. type(value), 2)
	end
end

function Test.Error(callback, message)
	local ok, err = pcall(callback)

	if ok then
		error(message or "Expected function to raise an error", 2)
	end

	return err
end

-- =========================================================
-- TEST SUMMARY
-- =========================================================

function Test.Finish()
	Write_Line("")

	Write_Line(Colors.Cyan .. "============= HYPERMAX TEST RESULTS =============" .. Colors.Reset)

	Write_Line(Colors.Green .. "Passed: " .. Test.passed .. Colors.Reset)

	Write_Line((Test.failed > 0 and Colors.Red or Colors.Green) .. "Failed: " .. Test.failed .. Colors.Reset)

	Write_Line(Colors.Cyan .. "Total:  " .. Test.total .. Colors.Reset)

	Write_Line(Colors.Cyan .. "=================================================" .. Colors.Reset)

	if Test.failed > 0 then
		Write_Line(Colors.Red .. "Failures:" .. Colors.Reset)

		for _, failure in ipairs(Test.failures) do
			Write_Line(Colors.Red .. "- " .. failure.name .. ": " .. failure.error .. Colors.Reset)
		end

		return false
	end

	Write_Line(Colors.Green .. "All tests passed!" .. Colors.Reset)

	return true
end

return Test
